<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887"></a>
## Admission Cost And Recovery Detail V1

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/admission-cost-recovery-detail-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `c07f997e4adf59c48f3244d5cd1e5e055f653b12e539b2637589157b075ce358`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: 전투/작전 교차분야 상세 계약. 구형15wave/start package와 새 노드정책은 프로토콜 이행 대조 필요

<!-- source-body:source-4e1a948cfc112887:start -->
<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-admission-cost-and-recovery-detail-v1"></a>
### Admission Cost And Recovery Detail V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / proposed contract detail, not implemented or deployed.
Companion: predeparture-contract-source-audit-20260909.md.

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-source-check"></a>
#### Source Check

Searched active owner worktree attendance-pass-20260907/server TypeScript,
excluding *.test.ts, for INSERT INTO operation_previews, UPDATE fuel_state,
fuelCost and fuel_cost. The literal preview INSERT found is in
scripts/cloudflare/dev-remote-launch-smoke.ts:160, a direct fixture writer.
The fuel UPDATE match is game-api/src/index.ts:6529, refund processing.
This search does not rule out other languages, dynamic SQL or external producers.
No production preparation/debit path was established. Do not equate fixture
start/finish success with verified admission economy.

game-api/src/index.ts:1530 onward limits the inspected story refund candidate to
raid_raider_king_engine, matching raid metadata, FAILURE and bossDefeated=false.
ABANDONED is not covered by that condition. No API or script executed.

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-recommended-contract"></a>
#### Recommended Contract

- Preparation is free: selection, validation, cancel and preview expiry debit zero.
- Server quotes cost and policy version in a validated preview. No numeric cost
  invented here. Cost changes invalidate/requote before commitment; never silently
  charge a different price from the accepted preview.
- Start commits preview consumption, resolved loadout, run identity and one debit
  as a single logical operation. Each debit has a unique admission identity and
  account/resource/amount/policy references. Clients cannot supply authoritative cost.
- Insufficient balance, invalid ownership, expired preview or stale configuration
  rejects before charging. Duplicate start resolves the original operation.
- Timeout means unknown, not failed. Reconcile the original identity; disable a
  second admission until its outcome is known. Do not locally grant compensation.
- A failed partial commit requires deterministic server recovery with durable
  state, not solely best-effort reopening of a consumed preview.
- Successful admission followed by client crash is an existing run, not a new
  admission. Reconnect/abandon resolution follows mode rules, not automatic refund.

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-outcomes"></a>
#### Outcomes

| Situation | Recommended cost handling |
| --- | --- |
| Cancel before accepted start | No debit |
| Repeated request or lost response | Original run/debit only |
| Server proves admission never committed | No debit, or exactly-once reversal of the partial debit |
| Ordinary defeat | Keep admission cost; no new refund benefit proposed |
| Story raid eligible defeat | Existing failure-refund policy, linked to actual admission debit |
| Voluntary abandon | No new refund entitlement; do not relabel as eligible defeat |
| Client reports loading failure | Investigate/reconcile; report alone cannot authorize refund |

Refund eligibility and credited amount are separate. A refund must never exceed
the unrefunded original debit. The inspected fuel handler caps credits at max fuel;
whether to preserve that cap or guarantee full restoration requires an explicit
policy decision. Do not silently introduce overflow fuel, mailbox grants or a new
currency. Legacy fixture runs with no debit evidence must not become proof of
real debit-linked refunds; define compatibility before enabling the new invariant.

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-solo-and-coop-boundary"></a>
#### Solo And Coop Boundary

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-story-mutual-destruction-and-refund-proposal---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Story Mutual Destruction And Refund Proposal - 2026-09-09

Recommend treating same-authority-tick boss/train destruction as a verified combat
FAILURE, with the same debit-linked refund eligibility as other validated story raid
combat defeats. This is a NEW recommendation to reconcile the earlier tie candidate
with the inspected bossDefeated=false predicate, not existing API behavior or approval
to broaden a production refund route. Ordinary operations and World are unchanged.

Keep observed boss destruction, final outcome, end reason and refund eligibility
semantically separate. Never lie that boss survived to satisfy a legacy predicate.
Exact schema belongs to Server. If the current contract cannot express this case,
record contract-blocked evidence rather than submit fabricated finish metadata.

| Situation | Proposed result/reward | Proposed cost decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boss destroyed, train alive at terminal check | Story success, normal server settlement | Normal consumed cost |
| Train destroyed, boss alive | Combat failure, no clear/progress reward | Verified original cost refund |
| Both destroyed in same authoritative tick | Combat failure, no clear/progress reward | Same combat-failure refund |
| User abandons before authoritative terminal event | Abandon, no clear reward | No new refund |
| Terminal defeat already committed, then user closes screen | Preserve committed defeat | Preserve original eligibility; do not relabel abandonment |
| Connection lost/result unknown | Pending until reconciled | No speculative credit or second debit |

Only an actually recorded, unrefunded admission debit can fund this restoration.
No compensating fixed amount, duplicate refund, generated ticket or currency switch.
Failed runs do not grant first-clear rewards, story unlock or success quest progress.
Participation-only quest counting follows its separate policy; no blanket change.

Recommend full restoration of the original debit even if natural regeneration made
fuel reach cap: permit the refund portion above cap, pause natural regeneration while
at/above cap and resume under the existing cadence rule after falling below cap.
Do not cash out overflow, add mailbox currency or grant missed regeneration ticks.
This is an explicit cap-policy CHANGE proposal, not an inference from World tickets.
Alternative is retaining cap-truncated refunds; simpler but fails to return the full
entry cost. User acceptance and Server ledger/cap review required before adoption.

Freeze refund policy version with the attempt. Reconnect/retry does not apply a newly
published rule to reinterpret that debit. Any historical correction needs separate
authorization; no old fixture run without debit evidence receives an automatic grant.
Before server confirmation show pending settlement; after confirmation show the
actual restored amount, never the client-calculated expected amount as a receipt.

Future tests: mutual destruction truthful metadata, no first-clear on failure,
concurrent retry one credit, regen-to-cap then refund, zero-debit legacy fixture,
quit-before/after committed terminal result and policy version change. Not executed.

Keep the approved shared solo/coop allowance and same ticket type. Recommended:
each participant pays their own quoted cost once, neither implicitly pays for the
partner. Both readiness states and both balances must validate before a shared
run starts. Partial reservation failure releases all reservations; no single-sided
charge for a battle that never starts. This per-participant charging recommendation
is not treated as a previously approved numeric economy rule.

Do not assume a solo database transaction is enough for a realtime coop service;
the owner must select an atomic or durable reservation/commit protocol. World
boss participation and scoring remain separate from admission/payment completion.

<a id="source-4e1a948cfc112887-required-evidence-before-completion"></a>
#### Required Evidence Before Completion

1. Locate real preparation producer, debit ledger and loadout persistence.
2. Repeated and parallel start: one run and one debit per paying account.
3. Inject failure at consume/debit/run persistence boundaries: no stranded charge.
4. Timeout after commit: original result returned without a second debit.
5. Eligible refund repeated: one credit, bounded by original debit and explicit cap.
6. Coop one-account rejection: no committed cost for either participant.

All above are future acceptance cases, NOT run tests. No runtime changes, owner
orders, remote writes, video or deploy. Exact routes/schema and cap policy remain
open. Next design checkpoint: resolve refund-cap semantics and coop per-participant
payment recommendation, then owner confirmation of actual preparation/debit paths.

<!-- source-body:source-4e1a948cfc112887:end -->


<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91"></a>
## Battle Connection Recovery V1

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/battle-connection-recovery-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `9792fd67e44795460f3ba3b1666e7ac5b5da928442826ae785e95e657bb5b88f`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Online combatcontinues/disconnect; reconcileidentity/currentgenerationcomplete snapshot nooldtap/effect replay;no role takeover. World180/30/60/90 values firsttest/separateworldauthority; storypause unresolved; ticketoverflow notfuelpolicy.

<!-- source-body:source-9e22320e57141e91:start -->
<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-battle-connection-recovery-v1"></a>
### Battle Connection Recovery V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / design-only refinement, not runtime verification.
Sources: world-raid-rules.md (Eligibility And Exceptional Settlement),
online-coop-mode-policy.md, player-input-cooperation-detail-v1.md and
combat-result-retry-flow-v1.md. Existing policies take precedence over new examples.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-scope"></a>
#### Scope

Online authoritative battles continue when a client disconnects or opens a menu.
World Raid solo and coop retain server time and score. Solo ordinary/story pause
or restart persistence is not decided by this document; confirm its own authority
contract. No automatic expansion of World Raid to Act 1 launch scope.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-commands-and-presentation"></a>
#### Commands And Presentation

1. Input acknowledgment pending: retain command identity, show pending as already
   specified after 1 second; do not infer rejection or refund from client time.
2. Confirmed transport loss: block new remote combat commands and discard local
   unsubmitted gestures. Do not simulate authoritative HP, score or cooldown results.
3. Server-accepted commands keep their normal execution/expiry rules. Disconnect
   cannot cancel a committed attack for cooldown recovery. Uncertain commands are
   reconciled by identity, never recreated as new casts.
4. Reconnect original authenticated membership and fetch current complete state:
   run lifecycle, revision/sequence, remaining time, entities/HP, recovery timers,
   cooldowns, current mechanic and authoritative pending command outcomes.
5. Replace stale presentation with current state. Do not replay old taps, historical
   damage animations or every missed effect. Restore input only after reconciliation.
6. If already ended, go to result recovery rather than reopening combat. Existing
   explicit battle reward claim policy remains unchanged.

Backgrounding is not voluntary abandonment. Returning to foreground follows the
same reconciliation even when the socket appears alive. Old connection messages
must not overwrite a newer connection's snapshot. Exact transport schema remains
an owner contract task, not an invented implemented endpoint.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-baseline-behavior-while-unavailable"></a>
#### Baseline Behavior While Unavailable

Recommended explicit baseline: existing basic attacks/passive device cycles continue;
no automatic manual skill, ultimate, repair button, new focus command or mechanic
completion. Existing server-accepted effects resolve normally. This is not superior
AI and must not make deliberate disconnect increase damage or buff opportunities.
Other player never gains the absent role's controls; roles stay fixed. No substitute
player joins an active attempt. Host connection loss does not destroy the battle.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-existing-world-raid-timing-and-settlement"></a>
#### Existing World Raid Timing And Settlement

- Retain first-test values: 180-second attempt; grace up to 30 seconds per loss,
  total 60 seconds per account/attempt; eligible presence threshold 90 seconds.
  Grace does not stop combat, grant activity credit or reset on repeated reconnects.
- Grace exhaustion changes fallback/early-end availability, not membership. Original
  account may reconnect until the attempt deadline. Do not apply a new permanent
  disqualification solely because the grace allowance was exhausted.
- Eligible connected recovery/support time counts under the source policy. Disconnected
  auto-play time does not count. Damage share is not an eligibility threshold.
- After partner grace expires, remaining eligible player can continue or use the
  existing early-end offer. Early end yields no ranking or score-tier reward;
  at least 90 eligible seconds allows only weekly participation entitlement.
- Normal completion preserves team record when at least one account is eligible;
  rewards individually exclude ineligible accounts. No conversion to solo ranking.
- Only explicit confirmed voluntary abandonment follows its forfeiture policy.
  User-reported connectivity problems alone cannot invalidate/refund an attempt.
- Server-invalid attempt: existing once-only ticket restoration and no rewards.
  A valid retained result cannot simultaneously receive invalid-attempt refund.

Important distinction: source world-raid-rules.md already permits ticket refund
overflow above stock ten with paused regeneration. The separate proposed STORY FUEL
overflow rule must not be reported as already approved just because tickets allow it.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-player-copy-proposals"></a>
#### Player Copy Proposals

Connection lost: "연결을 복구하고 있습니다. 전투는 계속 진행됩니다."
Partner missing: "동료의 연결을 기다리고 있습니다."
Already ended: "전투가 종료되었습니다. 결과를 확인합니다."
Strings need existing localization IDs before implementation; no raw account/run IDs.
Never label these states as a turn wait or offer an online pause button.

<a id="source-9e22320e57141e91-future-verification"></a>
#### Future Verification

Lost ack/accepted skill, repeated backgrounding, reconnect during mechanic warning,
reconnect after end, exhausted grace followed by reconnect, zero-damage eligible
support, old socket snapshot, both disconnected and host disconnected. Verify no
timer reset, duplicate effect/charge, free cooldown, extra participation or role swap.

Only source-policy reads and document readback performed; no runtime tests, builds,
simulation, deployments, video or owner assignments. Local/uncommitted. Next design:
player-facing partner status/role signals using existing signal limits, or owner
contract mapping before implementation. No new tuning values introduced here.

<!-- source-body:source-9e22320e57141e91:end -->


<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8"></a>
## Battle Entry Readiness V1

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/battle-entry-readiness-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `a33d55c85de604e8800483b8c627ab1365e4c8763b683fc54ee9942a8131afa1`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Adopted preservevaliddraft/recoveruncertain sameidentity; proposed lifecycle ContentPrepared/AdmissionCommitted/etc notwireenum;3scountdown60sdeadline/refund proposal. Readyrevision/contentpins, scheduledstart vs cancelexclusive.

<!-- source-body:source-db19867c39371fb8:start -->
<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-battle-entry-readiness-v1"></a>
### Battle Entry Readiness V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / design only, not implemented. No new launch scope.

<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-previous-ux-approval-recorded"></a>
#### Previous UX Approval Recorded

User go-ahead follows preparation error/retry flow: retain valid draft choices,
show invalid slots/entry conditions/cost shortage, revalidate expired previews,
disable duplicate starts, reconcile uncertain admission with the same identity.
Returning to lobby is neither cancellation nor refund. Account-bound unresolved
admission recovery is required before making the pending screen dismissible.
If recovery capability is unavailable, mark a contract gap rather than lose the run.
Coop both-ready plus host start; draft edits clear both readiness flags. Departure
before commitment must race safely with start so only one authoritative outcome wins.
After commitment reconnect refers to the existing battle. This approves UX direction,
not a new API, cost schedule, refund overflow or deployment.

<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-new-recommended-entry-phases"></a>
#### New Recommended Entry Phases

Draft -> ContentPrepared -> ValidatedReady -> AdmissionCommitted -> SceneReady
-> ScheduledStart -> Fighting. Names are design states, not existing wire enums.

1. Before admission: obtain compatible content identities, download required battle
   dependencies under the existing network-consent policy and verify availability.
   Do not debit for download failures. Server revalidates preview after long downloads.
2. Admission: keep validated preview and exactly-once debit/run protocol. The run
   freezes content/config versions; a new catalog must not replace its assets midway.
3. Scene preparation: instantiate actors and environment, bind assigned formation,
   load required animation/effect references and initial authoritative state.
   Readiness means usable controls/render state, not merely a closed progress bar.
4. Start: server-authoritative modes wait for server scheduled start. Candidate
   visible countdown is 3 seconds, with inputs/damage/waves and scoring disabled
   beforehand. Countdown uses server time, not independent per-phone timers.
5. Fighting: reconnect obtains current state and remaining time. Never restart the
   countdown, refill health or extend world-boss duration through reconnect.

Keep countdown minimal and non-turn-based; it happens once at entry, not per wave.
Solo ordinary/story authority must follow their actual contract. Do not assert
they already have the same realtime authority as solo/coop World Raid.

<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-coop-readiness-and-failure"></a>
#### Coop Readiness And Failure

- Each participant confirms readiness for the same run and content/config revision.
  Server validates participant identity and run state; client-ready alone is not
  authoritative proof of correct combat simulation.
- Server schedules one start only after both are ready. Before that, no boss timer,
  damage, score, wave progress or participation quest credit is earned.
- Candidate readiness deadline: 60 seconds from admission, no heartbeat extension.
  This is a first-test value, not verified against devices; required downloads should
  already be complete before admission. A disconnected participant can recover within
  the original deadline, without creating a new admission.
- If deadline elapses before a start is scheduled, proposed server resolution is
  cancelled-before-battle with exactly-once debit reversal for both participants.
  No victory/defeat/participation reward. Do not expose a client self-refund command.
- Scheduling start and cancellation must be mutually exclusive. Once start is
  committed, the before-battle refund path is unavailable even if a client misses
  the scheduled timestamp. Apply existing in-battle reconnect/exit policy.
- Repeated intentional preparation failures may need matchmaking backoff; no new
  penalty duration or automatic account ban is approved by this document.

This proposed prebattle reversal differs from eligible story defeat refund.
Its treatment at fuel capacity must be resolved with the open refund-cap policy.
No claim that the current start endpoint supports these extra lifecycle states.

<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-ui-and-recovery"></a>
#### UI And Recovery

- Download UI uses actual remaining bytes; scene initialization uses step states
  rather than fake byte progress. Partner waiting shows waiting, not a frozen 99%.
- Background/suspend before readiness does not auto-confirm readiness. Rejoining
  rechecks current server lifecycle before showing countdown or cancellation.
- Wrong/missing content revision blocks ready; never silently use another version.
- Only server-confirmed reversal updates balances and refund copy.
- App restart checks unresolved admission before permitting another start. Durable
  account-scoped lookup is a backend prerequisite, not assumed present.

<a id="source-db19867c39371fb8-acceptance-and-limits"></a>
#### Acceptance And Limits

Future tests: slow client, missing asset, stale ready revision, ready/deadline race,
scheduled-start/disconnect race, duplicate ready/cancel, response lost after commit,
restart recovery, no prestart score/quest credit, no second debit on reconnection.
No tests executed. Compared against combat-result-retry-flow-v1.md and prior admission
design. Documentation only, local/uncommitted; no owner assignment/build/video/deploy.
Next: approve lifecycle/deadline/reversal recommendation, then map owner-supported
recovery and battle-start capabilities before writing runtime contracts.

<!-- source-body:source-db19867c39371fb8:end -->

## Carriage Device Functions

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/carriage-device-function-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `9f003fe0999bdbd6af5972bd1e4415735fa5aad1f851068dd11e399c21a944a8`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Accepted5carfunctiondirection notcoefficients; disabledstopsnewcasts preservescommitted; cooldowndeadline no catchupburst; automaticdevice/manualsupport3 separate; baseline repair independenthardware.

<!-- source-body:source-1422c7ea457550ec:start -->
<a id="source-1422c7ea457550ec-carriage-device-functions"></a>
### Carriage Device Functions

Status: USER ACCEPTED FUNCTION DIRECTION on2026-09-09, not proof of existing
implemented effects. Exact amounts, stacking and catalog reconciliation remain.
Read actual CarriageType, durability and loadout source. Five known types are
Medical/Combat/Cargo/Gun/Defense. Preserve existing slot limits, unlocks and weight
until separately reviewed; reading enums does not authorize every car at start.

| Type | Recommended device | Disabled behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Medical | Periodic healing of living allied operator with greatest missingHP ratio | No new heal pulses; already accepted heal retained |
| Combat | Interior suppression device attacks valid intruder | Stops device shots, not operator attacks or stats |
| Cargo | Supply relay gives bounded temporary weapon firing support | Stops future supply pulses, no inventory/reward loss |
| Gun | Exterior weapon attacks selected eligible external threat | Stops future weapon shots, committed projectiles continue |
| Defense | Periodic barrier generator for train integrity | Stops generation, existing barrier expires/absorbs normally |

Cargo support is a NEW candidate, not permanent resource income or an implied
ammo-inventory mechanic. Audit prior cargo function before adoption; no extra
crystals/offline multiplier/reward changes. Firing support cannot reset attacks
or produce infinite cooldown loops; cap and precise affected weapons required.
Medical does not revive and cannot heal train. Shields do not heal or restore
disabled devices. Combat car does not grant ownership of additional operators.

<a id="source-1422c7ea457550ec-manual-and-automatic-separation"></a>
#### Manual And Automatic Separation

Car device functions above are automatic baseline. Manual train commands select
from actually equipped abilities before departure, up to three visible slots
proposed. Multiple identical cars must not create unlimited UI buttons.
Basic emergency repair is independent of damaged car hardware; no circular
dependency. Differentiate this baseline recovery from fitted enhanced repair.
Operator ultimate choice remains independent of car choice.

<a id="source-1422c7ea457550ec-runtime-mapping-plan"></a>
#### Runtime Mapping Plan

Existing loadout snapshot -> validated car instance IDs -> device definition IDs
-> active actor systems. DeviceEnabled follows owner car state, not view visibility.
Each device has nextPulseAt/attackPeriod/targetRule/effectID; no global per-frame
Find scan or animator damage event. Candidate target lists maintained by state
events, stable tie-break. Skill/source versions pinned for whole attempt.
On disable, stop new scheduled activation; on restore preserve existing cooldown
deadline, no accumulated missed-pulse burst. If ready while disabled, at most one
normal activation after restore then schedule next interval. No catch-up healing.
Existing ongoing buffs follow their original expiry; no immediate revoke causing
HP collapse and no indefinite extension from repair/reconnect.

<a id="source-1422c7ea457550ec-balance-and-scope"></a>
#### Balance And Scope

Actual source durability values are historical implementation references, not new
approved balance. Exact heal/shot/barrier amounts, periods, supply cap and recovery
timing remain to be set after encounter damage budget. No changes made here.
No car type is mandatory for all progress: baseline abilities/initial kit must
handle required patterns. Different builds trade damage/sustain/protection rather
than become unable to finish a compulsory mechanic.
Tests needed: no reward loss, own-disabled repair still works, multiplecar caps,
no burst on restore, committed projectile continuity, eligibility and separateHP.
No tests executed. Next car recovery/timing and15wave encounter budget design.

<!-- source-body:source-1422c7ea457550ec:end -->


<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451"></a>
## Carriage Disable And Repair Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/carriage-disable-repair-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `27efbda9f4554600616e9ada32436a23c81069d36cf720d051d0839bdf52f3f8`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Disable/repair direction accepted; oldoverkill30%postdefense proposal explicitly superseded actualHPclamp52. SeparateHP no cascade, no inventoryloss, recovery independentdevice; numbers open.

<!-- source-body:source-ea7ae0446f7c3451:start -->
<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451-carriage-disable-and-repair-proposal"></a>
### Carriage Disable And Repair Proposal

Status: DISABLE/REPAIR DIRECTION ACCEPTED by user2026-09-09; no runtime changes.
Exact damage-edge semantics and recovery numbers still need review. Retain separate operator/carriage/trainHP
and explicit30percent carriage transfer baseline; total train0 fails ordinary/story.

<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451-state-and-effects"></a>
#### State And Effects

Operational whileHP>0, Disabled at0, Recovering on automatic emergency system,
then Operational. Optional damaged appearance below threshold does not secretly
reduce performance; any reduced output needs explicitly authored rule/UI.
Only disable configured active devices in that carriage. Do not despawn operators,
delete their ownership/equipment or inflict automatic squad damage. Do not strip
maxHP granted by equipped items midbattle and create cascading total-train death.
Already committed projectiles/effects follow original lifetime; stop future device
casts/shots. Cargo disable does not delete earned rewards/inventory. Each actual
carriage type maps to explicit device IDs, not a guessed all-stats penalty.

<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451-repair"></a>
#### Repair

Automatic emergency recovery available independently of damaged carriage devices
or selected operator. Baseline recovery time/HP amount remains open pending pacing.
Manual repair reduces current damage when operational and may accelerate disabled
recovery only via explicit approved skill; no zero-time repair loop. All timing
server/model-owned by mode, not animation complete callbacks.
Repair source declares CarriageHP OR TrainTotalHP. Repairing carriage never
automatically refunds transferred total-train damage. No persistent currency cost
or compulsory repair purchase. Failed attempt cannot be revived by late repair.
No wave/reconnect full repair, cooldown reset or repeated down event atHP0.

<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451-no-damage-sink-exploit"></a>
#### No Damage-Sink Exploit

Disabled carriage must not absorb endless attacks for zero train damage. Future
target selection skips disabled carriage as ordinaryHP target. Enemies with direct
train attack can select train via explicit behavior; others acquire a legal target.
Projectile already committed to a carriage uses its declared impact policy; proposed
one30percent transfer from resolved post-defense hit even if carriage has insufficient
HP, no second direct hit. This differs from clamping transfer to remainingHP and
needs caller/tests before adoption. Do not repeat the down event or reapply armor.
Mandatory counterplay must remain possible when a carriage is disabled. Telegraph
direct attacks and preserve basic emergency recovery even on total device outage.

<a id="source-ea7ae0446f7c3451-presentation-and-tests"></a>
#### Presentation And Tests

Exterior carriage damage/smoke and small labelled status; detail displays recovery
time and affected functions. Interior stage stays intact, no floating floor or
unapproved alternate character layout. Avoid constant flashing/fullscreen notices.
Test active projectiles at disable, overkill/disabled target transfer, zeroHP repeated
events, repair with own source disabled, all devices unavailable, missed connection,
wave continuity, no reward deletion and train0 vs repair ordering. No tests run.
World Raid total-train recovery stays separate; carriage adoption needs mode review.

<!-- source-body:source-ea7ae0446f7c3451:end -->


<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840"></a>
## Chapter 1 Encounter Curve

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/chapter1-encounter-curve-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `0db78707625038c6526d582f769d108150a5f91dac42bdef97d463589c0918cb`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Chapter1 sixmissions15waves authorednumericcandidate1.30once/cap4; storyraidseparate; unlock afterM3/M5 notrequireownunlock; allJ04counts unapproved latest; no hiddenplayeradaptation.

<!-- source-body:source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840:start -->
<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-chapter-1-encounter-curve"></a>
### Chapter 1 Encounter Curve

2026-09-09 Plan. AUTHORED TEST CANDIDATE ONLY, not runtime configuration.
Sources: act1-story-outline.md, combat-stats-v1, encounter-budget-pressure-v1,
train-combat-test-profile-v1 and train-loadout-speed-detail-v1.
Six ordinary missions plus existing story raid are Chapter1, not all three chapters.
No new operation IDs, first-clear payouts, unlocks, tutorials or release expansion.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-fixed-authoring-not-player-auto-scaling"></a>
#### Fixed Authoring, Not Player Auto Scaling

Base ordinary budget is the proposed1.30 table: per3-wave block interior1040/1300/
1560/1820/2080 and exterior624/780/936/1092/1248. Multiply by mission columns below
once, then difficultyHP once. IncomingATK uses missionATK*difficultyATK, not HP factor.
Reference difficultyI. Existing risk reward factors remain untouched.

| Mission ID | Suggested five-slot level | Train | Kit rank | InteriorHP factor | ExteriorHP factor | IncomingATK factor |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| opn_01_last_departure | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| opn_02_first_signal | 5 | 2 | 1 | 1.10 | 1.08 | 1.10 |
| opn_03_water_stop | 10 | 3 | 1 | 1.25 | 1.16 | 1.20 |
| opn_04_scrapstar_show | 15 | 4 | 1 | 1.40 | 1.24 | 1.30 |
| opn_05_night_boarders | 20 | 5 | 2 | 1.55 | 1.32 | 1.40 |
| opn_06_broken_line | 25 | 6 | 2 | 1.70 | 1.40 | 1.55 |

These levels are recommendations for comparison, NOT admission gates or promised
days-to-clear. Promotion0/research0 throughout. Equipment disabled in this baseline
because its entitlement is still a proposal. This removes equipment2 as a required
reference assumption for missions5/6/raid from the earlier growth suggestion;
equipment2 remains optional sensitivity only, not removed from future design.
No player-specific scaling after observing the loadout. Stronger builds may clear
faster. Per-mission damage/range/cadence stays identifiable, not random hidden spikes.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-spawn-composition-by-three-wave-block"></a>
#### Spawn Composition By Three-Wave Block

Legend maps existing IDs ONLY:
S=enemy_raider_scout, G=enemy_spike_cart_gunner, J=enemy_signal_jammer_drone,
H=enemy_cinder_hound_mech, B=enemy_scrapshield_brute,
E=elite_broadcast_executioner, I=elite_ironclad_boarder.
Every ordinary wave also has one exterior enemy_railbike_marauder.
Entries are actual simultaneous roster counts, not five unrelated choice lists.

| Mission | W1-3 | W4-6 | W7-9 | W10-12 | W13-15 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | SS | SSG | SSG | SSSG | SSGG |
| 2 | SS | SSJ | SGJ | SSGJ | SGGJ |
| 3 | SS | SSG | SGH | SSGH | SBGH |
| 4 | SG | SGJ | SBJ | SBGJ | SBGJ |
| 5 | SG | SGH | SBH | SBGH | BGHJ |
| 6 | SG | SBJ | SGH | BGHJ | BGHJ |

One replacement at final wave only: mission4 W15 J->E; mission6 W15 B->I.
Replace the row member, do NOT add a fifth unit or a separate boss wave.
Mission1 has no major control/sabotage mechanic; ordinary targeting and shielding
still matter. Mission2 introduces a visible single-target slow, not compulsory
cleanse. Mission3 introduces sabotage;4 combines jammer/heavy;5 emphasizes boarding;
6 combines already seen threats. Every composition obeys interior cap4.

Existing first generic wave plan in combat-stats-v1 remains an earlier reference.
This table is a new mission-specific alternative, not an additional spawn layer
stacked on it. Pin exactly one wave plan per attempt. Each ordinary stays15waves.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-narrative-and-combat-boundaries"></a>
#### Narrative And Combat Boundaries

The outline describes departure, signal restoration and protection objectives.
For this numeric test, retain15-wave validated completion. Narrative purposes do
not silently add relay HP, passenger deaths, capture points or alternative win
conditions. Such systems need explicit contracts and separate design approval.
Do not rewrite published dialogue or claim a narrative goal is already a mechanic.

Wave HP is armor-weighted as in budget spec. B/E/I have distinct mitigation and
behavior, but retain a share of their wave budget rather than full baseHP plus
that budget. Rounded HP and actual effective waveHP must be logged for comparison.
No extra first-clear reward for an elite. Corpses and visual finale cannot delay
authoritative victory after pending effects have resolved.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-correct-carriage-timing"></a>
#### Correct Carriage Timing

Missions1/2/3 start with default2 Combat+Gun. Cargo/default3 is available AFTER
accepted mission3 completion, so mission3 cannot require its own unlocked device.
Missions4/5 default3. Defense/default4 only after accepted mission5 completion;
mission6 and story raid use default4. No Medical assumption in required tests.
Slot grants remain existing server truth, not this document's local calculations.

With selected test core table the corresponding weights/speeds are:
M1:60/1.05, M2:60/1.08, M3:60/1.12, M4:74/1.01, M5:74/1.04, M6:96/0.86.
Pressure candidate can therefore ease M3 but increase M6 exterior basic cadence.
Treat that discontinuity as a review item alongside newly added Defense, not a
reason to hide a pressure jump or mandate purchasing an engine upgrade.
Test M6 with pressure off AND on to isolate the cause.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-per-mission-total-ehp-before-risk"></a>
#### Per-Mission Total EHP, Before Risk

| Mission | Interior | Exterior |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 23400 | 14040 |
| 2 | 25740 | 15163.2 |
| 3 | 29250 | 16286.4 |
| 4 | 32760 | 17409.6 |
| 5 | 36270 | 18532.8 |
| 6 | 39780 | 19656 |

Decimal EHP is an accounting quantity, not fractional saved HP. Allocate rawHP
with fixed precision then floor per enemy, recording residual. No integer truncation
of multiplier such as1.08->1. Higher mission totals alone do not establish rising
difficulty because player levels/devices also grow; measure actual trajectories.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-story-raid-separate-reference"></a>
#### Story Raid Separate Reference

raid_raider_king_engine / boss_raider_king_engine: finiteHP, boss-only, initial5,
reference L30/P0/kit2/train6/default4; no research/equipment required. Retain current
candidate24000HP/15%armor and published candidate phase60/30% for first comparison.
Do not multiply ordinary mission6 factors onto boss automatically. Boss uses its
own profile, no ordinary risk-pressure interpretation or15-wave loop.
Compare HP24000/36000/48000 only if event pacing warrants, keeping attack profile
fixed. No claim that24000 already delivers a full-length boss encounter.
First-clear/refund/end-state stay existing server policy; no World Raid infiniteHP
or score-rank behavior. Story mutual destruction policy remains pending acceptance.

<a id="source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840-acceptance-work"></a>
#### Acceptance Work

Required tests: all90 ordinary wave entries total; count<=4; legal IDs; final
replacement once; no early Cargo/Defense dependency; separate boss profile;
mission/difficulty multipliers each applied once; version freeze; no future-reward
growth; initial-five without cleanse-only premium counter. Higher-risk carry policy
and random-entry eligibility remain separate from these stat recommendations.

This work verifies table arithmetic and manual count/ID cross-check only, not90
executed waves or successful unlocks. No implementation, simulation, device tests,
video, grant, owner assignment or deployment. All rows new candidates.
Next: finalize story boss attack rotation and fair initial-five counter windows,
then run an explicitly authorized event simulation instead of declaring this
authored curve balanced from arithmetic. Chapter2/3 remain separate catalog work.

<!-- source-body:source-25e8ad2e0b6d2840:end -->

## Combat Control Detail: First Decision

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/combat-control-detail-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `7bd867791a7c79d6772511998caa8ddf222a09aaeb017aaf3da976e9dcc8f4c0`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Approved realtimeindependent actors,fixedformation, focusnextattackcommittedtarget, normalhitsnotinterrupt, previews; oldnocutscenepause superseded04§14 specific full-screen hold.

<!-- source-body:source-716afa118bd7a8bb:start -->
<a id="source-716afa118bd7a8bb-combat-control-detail-first-decision"></a>
### Combat Control Detail: First Decision

Status: INPUT AND TARGETING DESIGN APPROVED by user2026-09-09.
Not a final combat engine, stat sheet or implementation order.
Source: online-coop-mode-policy.md and existing accepted presentation boundaries.

<a id="source-716afa118bd7a8bb-retained-decisions"></a>
#### Retained Decisions

- User accepted response direction: focus changes next attack only, committed
  attacks keep their target, normal hits need not interrupt, explicit control
  effects interrupt, other actors continue during casts. Fixed-position hazards
  must be solvable through protection/interruption/control, not assumed dragging.

- User explicitly confirmed real-time, not turn-based, on2026-09-09. Operators,
  enemies and train act on independent overlapping timelines; no team turn or
  global action queue. Target selection does not pause combat. Fixed formation
  is spatial, not action order. Do not block battle for long skill cutscenes.

- Upper exterior: train moves right. Lower interior: five allies within LEFT
  region, left column3/right column2; enemies occupy RIGHT region.
- Train integrity and operator health separate. No new defeat threshold inferred.
- Solo story/story raid; ordinary story encounters15waves, story raid boss-only.
- Four basic operation categories and World Raid support solo/cooperative policy;
  exact category IDs must be recovered, not invented from six mission IDs.
- Solo focuses on squad commands plus train support; cooperative roles use each
  owner's assets, no mid-combat role swap. World Raid infiniteHP/timed score and
  separate solo/team rankings retained, not confused with story boss defeat.

<a id="source-716afa118bd7a8bb-recommended-input-proposal"></a>
#### Recommended Input Proposal

Automatic basic attacks for eligible train weapons/operators; player decisions
are skills, target priority and exterior/interior mechanics, not repeated tapping.
Solo controls squad skills and a compact train-support command group. Both panes
stay visible; no simultaneous two-player input requirement in solo mechanics.
Cooperative train player controls train commands/exterior mechanics; squad player
controls five operators/interior mechanics. Observe teammate state without taking
their command authority. Role emphasis may differ without hiding critical alerts.
Operator skills use five portrait buttons with cooldown/resource feedback;
train support via distinct compact commands. Do not invent costs, number of train
abilities, hitboxes or targeting rules before the next decisions.

Alternatives: manual aim/movement raises mobile dual-pane burden; fully automatic
skills reduce cooperation agency. Recommended middle option accepted by user.
Detailed auto-target priority, skill cancellation, shared vs
individual gauges, effects, recovery/failure conditions and boss specifics remain
open. Fixed formation as approved below supersedes earlier movement uncertainty.

Next: approve input model -> targeting/formation rules -> skill/resource economy ->
damage/health/recovery -> wave/enemy/boss mechanics -> actual tests -> tutorial.
No new implementation/recording/deployment or economic payout approved.

<a id="source-716afa118bd7a8bb-targeting-followup-proposal"></a>
#### Targeting Followup Proposal

Approved: pre-battle formation fixed during combat,
with local attack/return animations only, not free dragging of units. Default
target must be reachable/valid under each unit's skill rules; use unit-specific
priority, not unconditional geometric nearest across all classes.
Optional enemy tap sets squad focus request. Units unable to hit that enemy keep
their valid normal targets; support/healing AI does not attack instead of healing.
Defeated/untargetable focus clears with visible feedback. Threat/taunt mechanics
may override only when explicitly specified in later combat rules.
Skill input must preview target/area before irreversible activation when selection
is needed; instant/self skills may activate on portrait tap. Cooldowns/resources,
range/cancel/invalid-target rules remain to be specified, not hidden assumptions.

<!-- source-body:source-716afa118bd7a8bb:end -->


<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e"></a>
## Combat Damage Resolution Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/combat-damage-resolution-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `d36c186a96335dcbe98f197c924dd350efe8cafb5142d4ec7c61f3f91bf032cd`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Accepted damagepipeline typedoperator/carriage/trainHP, armoronce→shield→actualHP; transferactual adoptedlater; precision/caps proposed; World mechanic no doubletransfer; noimplicitcrit/dodge/min1.

<!-- source-body:source-55fa7474d833e11e:start -->
<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e-combat-damage-resolution-proposal"></a>
### Combat Damage Resolution Proposal

Status: PIPELINE/DAMAGE SEPARATION ACCEPTED by user2026-09-09; no final stats/formula
implementation. Existing carriage30percent retained as baseline pending caller
reconciliation; rounding/stack caps remain detailed proposals. Baseline excludes new
elemental matchups, random misses or critical assumptions until catalogs reviewed.

<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e-processing"></a>
#### Processing

1. Validate effect target/category, invulnerability and effect identity once.
2. Resolve source attack and explicit skill coefficient; no invented crit/dodge
   unless effect/catalog defines those rules and authoritative randomness.
3. Apply allowed outgoing/incoming modifiers by named categories; stacking/caps
   explicit, never multiply one modifier twice under different UI labels.
4. Apply armor once, then absorb with applicable shield, then subtract actualHP.
5. Emit applied/absorbed damage and down state; not attempted damage as actual loss.
6. Resolve mode-specific score from accepted boss damage only. Infinite World Raid
   bossHP means no finiteHP clamp; buffs applied once using existing hit-time rules.

Simple ordinary armor candidate: damage = base * (1 - reductionRatio), with
reduction bounded0..cap where final cap still open. Do not introduce numeric DEF
rating curve before actual progression stats established. Carry fixed precision,
round once at prescribed effect boundary; protect multi-hit against rounding bias
by deterministic remainder allocation when a total is split. Zero effective damage
must not be coerced to1 during invulnerability/shield-only effects.
Example no buffs/crit: attack100, coefficient2, reduction20percent gives160;
shield60 absorbs60, HP loss100. Illustration only, not an operator stat proposal.

<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e-three-health-categories"></a>
#### Three Health Categories

OperatorHP, carriageHP and trainTotalHP cannot be casually merged. Existing runtime
TrainDamageCalculator.cs takes carriageFinalDamage and returns30percent to total
trainHP; armor parameter validated but not reapplied. Source presence is not whole
caller-chain verification or approval to delete carriageHP.
Preserve explicit distinction: direct train damage applies once, carriage damage
may transfer once under accepted policy, operator damage never transfers merely
because operator stands in a carriage. Sabotage declares its target category.
Before code work trace callers/effect categories and decide whether existing30percent
remains; this proposal does not silently replace it. World Raid explicit mechanic
damage must not also trigger carriage transfer, as existing mode policy specifies.

<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e-healing-and-shields"></a>
#### Healing And Shields

Heal clamps to missing livingHP; train repair targets eligible train state.
Shield has source/target/value/expiry and consumption order, no implicit healing
or resurrection. Proposed same-source refresh/replace vs cross-source stacking
requires caps before final catalog. Show shield separate fromHP to avoid apparent
health jumps. Ordinary armor/shield rules do not override separately documented
World Raid mechanic penalties; UI identifies mechanic-specific damage.

<a id="source-55fa7474d833e11e-tests-before-adoption"></a>
#### Tests Before Adoption

Armor exactly once, shield partial/full, invalid target, duplicate event,
operator-to-train no transfer, carriage transfer exactly once, directtrain no
second transfer, heal overheal/down target, multi-hit rounding, damage-over-time,
buff expiry boundaries, simultaneous lethal, world deadline and no duplicated score.
No tests run. Next resolve carriage semantics and actual actor stats/skill scaling.

<!-- source-body:source-55fa7474d833e11e:end -->


<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de"></a>
## Combat Health And Recovery Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/combat-health-recovery-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `950fee5e6bd513f619c98d9dfbad48ab53333ab059cfab17829d5ecce95cd8b2`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Accepted structure and useraccepted TEST6/9/12s50%2s; notlaunchbalance. all5downnotfailure, train0failure ordinary/story, nohealrevive/wavereset. Worlddifferent and historical05KSTnotcalendar authority.

<!-- source-body:source-e7a419b8cc8f45de:start -->
<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de-combat-health-and-recovery-proposal"></a>
### Combat Health And Recovery Proposal

Status: HEALTH/FAILURE STRUCTURE APPROVED by user2026-09-09;
not implementation or damage certification. Numeric appendix user accepted as
initial TEST BASELINE on2026-09-09, not validated launch balance.
Retain independent train integrity/operator health. World Raid uses separate
world-raid-rules.md; do not replace its existing recovery bands or scoring here.

<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de-ordinary-and-story-recommendation"></a>
#### Ordinary And Story Recommendation

- Exterior attacks damage train integrity; interior attacks damage designated
  operators. No automatic double damage/sharedHP. Explicit sabotage attacks may
  target train integrity from inside only when clearly telegraphed and designed.
- Operator at0 becomes incapacitated, cannot act/receive further down events.
  Other operators and train continue. Automatic entity recovery, no required
  resurrection operator, consumable or crystal purchase. Recovery time/HP amount
  pending balance design, do not copy World Raid numbers silently.
- All five incapacitated: internal attacks stop while individual recovery clocks
  continue; no extra squad-wide recovery timer or immediate defeat solely for
  squad wipe. Train remains exposed to defined enemy sabotage, not invisible tax.
- Approved train integrity0 ends ordinary/story attempt as failure, not infinite
  train revival. Boss defeat succeeds in story raid; normal15wave win retains
  actual operation objectives. Existing story-raid failure stamina refund retained;
  no new ordinary failure/refund grant policy from this proposal.
- World Raid differs: infinite bossHP, train/operators recover per existing rules,
  time keeps moving, score freezes at deadline. Train0 is NOT early attempt failure.

<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de-healing-and-state-boundaries"></a>
#### Healing And State Boundaries

Ordinary healing targets living operators; train repair is separate ability type.
No revival from an ordinary heal. Revive interactions, if authored, need explicit
catalog rules. No passive full restoration on wave change, reconnect or UI reopen.
Keep health/cooldown/recovery state across waves; attempt initialization separate.
Recovery immunity, repeated downs and timeout require tuning after actual damage
model. Do not schedule unavoidable repeated mandatory tasks on unavailable units.
Precise simultaneous kill/defeat ordering remains engine contract work before
implementation; neither client animation nor response arrival order may decide.

<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de-source-caveat"></a>
#### Source Caveat

Existing World Raid document includes historical05KST reset text, while newer
global design uses04KST. Not resolved by this health proposal and not reused as
calendar policy; flag for source reconciliation before World Raid rollout.
No full combat tests or current runtime behavior verified in this planning unit.

<a id="source-e7a419b8cc8f45de-ordinarystory-recovery-numeric-candidates"></a>
#### Ordinary/Story Recovery Numeric Candidates

User-accepted test baseline, not final tested balance: per operator, first down6s,
second9s, subsequent12s cap
for whole attempt, not each wave. Return50percent maxHP. Protect against ordinary
incoming damage for2s; not immunity to explicit boss mechanics or a cleanse of
already committed outcomes. Do not schedule unavoidable mandatory actions while
recovering. No arbitrary immunity abuse through reconnect/phase change.
Cooldowns continue while down, no reset/full gauge reward on recovery. A recovered
unit may act if actually ready. Trial protection can permit action, but damage
uptime/intentional-down exploits must be measured before final acceptance.
No second team-wide timer on simultaneous downs. Ended attempt cancels pending
recovery without reopening rewards/state. Basic heals cannot target downed units.

Illustrative downtime: first three downs cost6+9+12=27s per operator, excluding
lost casts/attack windup. This is not DPS or clear-rate proof. At60/120/180s combat
durations it is45/22.5/15percent time lost, so encounter-duration tests are required.
Test repeated-down vs healing, full-team downs, wave transitions, reconnection,
end-at-recovery boundary and protection interactions; no tests run yet.

<!-- source-body:source-e7a419b8cc8f45de:end -->


<a id="source-4d37feef519db046"></a>
## Combat Result, Retry And Recovery Flow

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/combat-result-retry-flow-v1.md`

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-combat-result-retry-and-recovery-flow"></a>
### Combat Result, Retry And Recovery Flow

2026-09-09 Plan. DETAILED UX/CONTRACT PROPOSAL, no implementation or remote proof.
Read local server/docs/api/run-result-submit.md, run-reward-preview-claim.md and
raid-boss-run-contract.md under E:/Projects/LASTRAIL. These documents describe local
contracts and may lag the active owner/deployed snapshot; confirm before coding.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-end-state-separation"></a>
#### End State Separation

Fighting -> LocalEndObserved -> ResultPending -> ResultAccepted -> RewardReview
-> ClaimPending -> ClaimConfirmed. Rejected and transport-unknown are separate.
Online authoritative modes use server EndObserved, not a locally decided victory.
Do not label ResultPending a defeat or treat preview creation as currency received.

Ordinary victory requires accepted15 completed waves. Story boss victory requires
accepted bossDefeated, not a fabricated15-wave count. Existing raid permits0waves.
Train destruction submits proposed failure through the existing validation path;
client animation cannot force the server outcome. Same-tick boss/train destruction
tie remains a design decision pending contract adoption, not an existing rule.

Stop new commands on terminal state; allow noninteractive visual finish without
blocking submission. Proposed end emphasis<=1s, no mandatory long cinematic.
Never wait for animation callback to persist/submit the result. Opening system menu
or app suspension does not create another result or reset an active attempt.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-existing-contract-mapping"></a>
#### Existing Contract Mapping

| Stage | Existing documented path | Important meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Finish | POST /v1/runs/:runId/finish | Validates result, returns rewardPreviewId |
| Review | GET /v1/runs/:runId/reward-preview/:rewardPreviewId | Server display lines/status |
| Claim | POST /v1/runs/:runId/reward-preview/:rewardPreviewId/claim | Server commits reward transaction |
| Retry battle | New operation preview then POST /v1/runs/start | A NEW attempt, not finish retransmission |

Keep stable idempotency key for the SAME finish/claim/start request. Separate
operations have separate keys. Duplicate finish can return accepted:false plus
DUPLICATE_REPLAY; it is not combat rejection. Follow recorded preview/claim state.
HTTP200 alone is not success; decode domain status. Network timeout alone is not
failure, refund or proof no commit occurred. No client reward amounts in mutations.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-screen-states-and-buttons"></a>
#### Screen States And Buttons

| State | Display | Actions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ResultPending | 결과 확인 중 | Safe navigation only when recovery is durable |
| Accepted/preview loading | 보상 확인 중 | Retry read after error |
| ACTIVE preview | Server lines, not granted badge | 보상 받기 |
| ClaimPending | 지급 확인 중 | Prevent duplicate new claim intent |
| CLAIMED | 지급 완료, authoritative lines | 다시 도전 / 작전 선택 |
| Temporarily unavailable | 결과 확인을 다시 시도해 주세요 | 다시 확인 |
| EXPIRED/INVALIDATED | Server-classified unavailable state | 작전 선택 / 고객문의 if supported |

Copy is proposal/localization slot content, not string-ID publishing. Battle reward
claim is not attendance's automatic-grant/confirm-only policy. Retain documented
explicit claim until separately approved; never silently apply attendance rules.
When leaving an ACTIVE preview, disclose server expiry and unresolved claim;
no invented mailbox auto-payment, timeless reservation or client restoration.
Result recovery list/navigation requires actual backend read capability; if absent
do not ship a dismissible pending result that cannot be recovered. Mark that gate.

No raw run/account/token identifiers in player copy. Operator-visible sanitized
support correlation references may follow existing approved error contract.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-uncertain-requests-and-reopening"></a>
#### Uncertain Requests And Reopening

Proposed bounded automatic transport retry delays1/2/4s, same logical request/key;
honor server Retry-After if supplied and stop on fatal contract/auth errors.
After bounded retries show pending+manual status check, not automatic endless loop.
Persist only minimal recovery reference and same-account binding using reviewed
storage; do not persist auth in PlayerPrefs or log serialized combat/auth payloads.
Protected full submission recovery, if needed, requires explicit implementation
review. An unverified local file is not proof a combat result should be accepted.

On restart: establish auth/account first -> reconcile pending attempt via existing
server read/replay contract -> render accepted result/active attempt appropriately.
If account switched, never submit previous account's result with new credentials.
Do not invent a resume endpoint or assume local combat snapshots can resume
ordinary gameplay; mid-run solo resume remains a separate contract requirement.
In online modes reconnect authoritative state, no local timeline replay/HP reset.
World mode remains its established180s/reconnect policy, not converted to story.

Retryable validation rejection may require fresh authoritative state; do not send
same stale body forever. If correction changes canonical result, reconcile the
operation state/key contract first rather than create another outcome blindly.
Fatal rejection does not automatically accuse cheating; give neutral failure/help.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-defeat-withdrawal-and-refund"></a>
#### Defeat, Withdrawal And Refund

Actual defeat, explicit ABANDONED and lost connection are different states.
Withdrawal requires confirmation before terminal request; cancel retains battle.
Do not map app background/connection loss into a voluntary abandonment event.
Documented story failure refund is a separate committed marker. Show returned
stamina only after COMMITTED; don't derive amount from current stamina or local
run cost. Do not assume ABANDONED gets the same refund without owner confirmation.
Ordinary partial rewards are server-calculated, not all-zero inferred by UI.

No paid continue, ad resurrection, checkpoint rewind or free HP reset added.
Story raid retry creates fresh fullHP/cooldowns per new attempt AFTER legal new
start, not revival inside old attempt. Existing start cost/eligibility rechecked.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-retry-admission-and-result-races"></a>
#### Retry Admission And Result Races

Recommend resolve current result/claim before offering one-tap retry. Do not use
uncommitted preview items to meet stamina/ownership requirements. New preview may
use new balance/content version; old result remains pinned to its original version.
If new content incompatible, route to existing update/loading policy, not silently
start using old assets. Missing stamina shows actual server requirement; no forced
purchase UI or ad requirement created by this design.

Repeated retry taps use same pending start key. If start response lost, recover
that run instead of charging another. If exit/result/start race, terminal and
claim consistency belongs to server transactions, not the last visible screen.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-additional-source-gap-found"></a>
#### Additional Source Gap Found

Raid contract states boss starts with server-authored full augment/tactic package
that an ordinary run would accumulate. Previous bare initial-five boss stat draft
does not include those effects. It is ONLY a stripped reference, not full story
raid fidelity. Actual package choices/modifiers must be recovered and included
before claiming boss duration or difficulty verified. Never remove the package
to make a hand-calculated bossHP target fit. This is a simulation-input blocker,
not permission to add client-generated tactics or reward truth.

<a id="source-4d37feef519db046-verification-checklist-and-next-step"></a>
#### Verification Checklist And Next Step

Finish response lost after commit; duplicate accepted:false; preview refresh;
claim response lost/CLAIMED replay; expired preview; auth refresh/account switch;
restart during result pending; abandonment confirmation; refund pending/committed;
same-key start replay; no double cost; update-required retry; no reward amount in
request; boss0wave victory; unknown-resume contract; full-start-package modifiers.

Source/document review only. No endpoints called, runtime tests, migrations, build,
capture or deployment. Owner review must verify latest paths/statuses before
implementation. Next detailed gap: start augment/tactic package contents and
their combat modifier stacking, before any credible full boss simulation.

<!-- source-body:source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed:start -->
<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-combat-result-summary-detail-v1"></a>
### Combat Result Summary Detail V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / UI and metric semantics proposal, not implemented.
Sources: combat-result-retry-flow-v1.md, world-raid-rules.md,
online-coop-mode-policy.md. Existing result/claim and reward eligibility unchanged.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-presentation-hierarchy"></a>
#### Presentation Hierarchy

First view: authoritative outcome and operation/boss identity, elapsed battle time,
mode-appropriate progress, then server reward lines and existing claim controls.
Ordinary shows completed waves out of15; story shows boss outcome, never forces15
waves; World Raid shows combined team score/record status, not boss kill percentage.
Cancelled/invalid/pending is not a defeat. Early-end world result is not a ranked run.

Expandable battle detail appears below the essential result. No mandatory analytics
screen, forced chart animation or delay before reward claim. Missing analytics must
not prevent final result/claim where those are independently accepted. Show unavailable
rather than zero for absent fields. Pending reward differs from granted reward.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-metrics-and-attribution"></a>
#### Metrics And Attribution

| Metric | Meaning | Not included |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Damage dealt | Resolved effective target HP damage, partitioned boss/other targets | Overkill, immune hits, predicted damage or duplicate boss proxies |
| Effective operator healing | Actual living operator HP restored by healing effects | Overheal, automatic recovery HP, train repair |
| Effective train repair | Actual durability restored by repair effects | Over-repair, operator healing, initialization |
| Shield absorbed | Damage actually absorbed by that shield instance | Full issued shield amount, unused expired shield |
| Interrupts | Unique successfully cancelled interruptible actions/channels | Attempts, immune targets, duplicate events or remaining pulse count as extra interrupts |
| World mechanics completed | Shared mechanics resolved as success | Each subtask counted as separate team success, cancelled phase tasks or pings |

No single composite contribution score or damage-only MVP in this proposal.
The team summary comes first, role/entity breakdown second, in fixed role/formation
order rather than public damage ranking. No percentage used to gate carrier/support
rewards. Existing account participation eligibility still applies independently.

The source of a heal/shield/interrupt receives that metric once. Buff-enhanced damage
stays with the actual damage source; do not credit the same added damage again to
the buffer. Exact buff-contribution counterfactuals are excluded from this version.
Pre-deadline emitted damage that resolves after World Raid deadline cannot score.
Keep world fixed precision and final rounding policy; display rounding must not
change final team score. Detailed rows may be marked rounded if they do not sum
visually; do not fabricate balancing damage to force agreement.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-useful-feedback-without-blame"></a>
#### Useful Feedback Without Blame

Optional localizable factual lines can show actual repeated downs/late interruption
when verified in events; avoid invented reasons such as 'your healer is too weak'.
Prefer facts like a cancelled overload's remaining pulse count, not guessed advice
to buy a recruit. No partner blame badges, fail leaderboards or per-mistake penalties.
Keep detailed disconnect diagnostics private; use existing eligibility messages.

Single-player hides partner comparison. Coop displays the original two names/roles
and frozen equipped build, not later changed inventory. Rank publication uses the
existing public loadout policy; diagnostic logs/raw identifiers are not exposed.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-data-contract-boundary"></a>
#### Data Contract Boundary

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-defeat-feedback-and-re-preparation-proposal---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Defeat Feedback And Re-preparation Proposal - 2026-09-09

Extend existing optional factual feedback, not a new failure-scoring service. Use
up to two compact observations beneath the authoritative result/reward area. Label
observation separately from suggested response. Do not call the largest damage
source the proven sole cause of defeat or infer what an unselected operator would
have prevented. Claim/result controls remain usable without analytics.

| Accepted evidence | Possible advice, not guaranteed remedy |
| --- | --- |
| Sabotage pulses actually damaged train | Review interruption timing, source priority or train protection |
| Rear actors took traced gunner damage and went down | Review rear protection/recovery or priority-target damage |
| Interior finished earlier while exterior remained alive | Review exterior fire support; this is a lane-delay observation, not proof it caused defeat |
| A relevant defensive command was rejected for cooldown/invalid target | Review cooldown allocation or legal target; never count rejected input as defense |

Never infer a player ignored an available skill from absence of a cast alone. Input
availability, control/down, action queue and network uncertainty can differ. Without
accepted command evidence omit input-timing advice. Do not recommend healing from
issued shield value, or blame a healer solely from low healing totals.

Select deterministic observations: terminal train damage context first if available,
then one distinct supported recurring threat. Deduplicate the same warning/channel;
several pulses are not several failed mechanic attempts. No numeric severity weights
or arbitrary new statistical thresholds in this slice. If evidence is insufficient,
show normal result only, not fabricated zero counts or a generic power warning.

Recommend Reconfigure returning to preparation with the previous personal draft;
revalidate ownership, content, costs and package before a new departure. Focus the
relevant existing squad/train section without automatically replacing anyone. Retain
other user selections. Direct retry also follows existing new-admission/confirmation
rules; do not charge on opening preparation or interpreting advice.

Coop feedback is team-scoped with no blame labels or weakest-player ranking. Each
player edits only their role; a shared rematch requires existing mutual continuation
and renewed readiness. If the partner leaves, preserve own draft and offer valid
navigation, never start solo automatically or silently alter mode/difficulty.

World time completion is not defeat. Its optional performance observations follow
the same evidence rules but no boss-clear recommendation or mandatory higher score.
Cancelled/invalid/pending attempts do not receive combat-loss diagnosis. Advice has
no effect on reward eligibility, quests, refund or matchmaking eligibility.

Future checks: missing/partial evidence, duplicate channel pulses, rejected cast,
healer down, favorable lane split misread as defeat cause, long translated text,
partner exit and reconfiguration with stale content. No tests run or analytics API
assumed available. This is optional UI detail, not a gate before the first simulator.

Snapshot at accepted terminal resolution with run/rules/content identity internally.
Aggregate authoritative accepted events where authority exists; do not trust client
totals as world ranking evidence. Solo ordinary/story analytics may be unavailable
until its event-validation contract exists; don't silently promise equivalent data.
Names here are semantic fields, not invented API routes. No new telemetry stream,
full replay storage or indefinite retention is authorized. Storage/retention owner
review required before adding persisted analytics.

Double delivery or reopening result returns the same frozen summary. Result version
and displayed build remain pinned to the attempt. Settling stats cannot trigger a
second grant. Existing explicit battle claim remains; attendance auto-grant differs.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-verification-and-next"></a>
#### Verification And Next

Future cases: overheal, partial shield, interrupted4-pulse channel, duplicate event,
buff attribution, two boss proxies, zero-damage eligible support, expired/invalid
world attempt, display rounding, missing stats and account switch. None run.
Policy reads and document/handoff readback only. Local/uncommitted; no runtime code,
tests, deployment, new recording or owner assignment. Next contract review should
prioritize existing supported aggregates, not add an unbounded analytics subsystem.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-quest-and-pass-progress-display-proposal--2026-09-10"></a>
#### Quest And Pass Progress Display Proposal — 2026-09-10

다음 세부기획: 전투 결과 화면에서 이번 작전이 인정한 퀘스트·패스 진행을 보여준다.
본 절은 신규 UI/연동 제안이며 구현·배포 승인이 아니다. 직전 인정조건은 후속 사용자
'다음 세부 기획 ㄱㄱ'에 따라 설계 방향으로 채택하되 story15wave 패배의 비용/환급
계약 확인 조건과 기존 incremental-wave receipt 보존 조건을 유지한다.

Sources: [outcome qualification](47_ECONOMY_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-04d9d21432054734),
[pass and calendar policy](47_ECONOMY_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-901d352e4d663bd3),
[result and claim recovery](44_COMBAT_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-4d37feef519db046).

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-화면-순서와-노출량"></a>
##### 화면 순서와 노출량

1. 서버 확정 승패, 작전명, 완료 wave 또는 boss 결과.
2. 전투 보상과 기존 '보상 받기/지급 확인 중/지급 완료' 상태.
3. '이번 작전으로 진행한 목표' 요약. 변경된 목표 최대2행, 나머지는 '모두 보기'.
4. 선택형 전투 분석과 다시 도전/작전 선택. 긴 목표 애니메이션은 진행을 막지 않는다.

일반 및 story15wave는 완료wave/15, story boss-only는 boss 결과를 표시한다.
기존 본문의 story=boss 표현은 boss-only에 한정한다. 정상패배를 퀘스트 인정 때문에
승리로 바꾸지 않는다. 첫클리어·진행해금·전투보상은 각각 기존 자격을 따른다.

목표 행은 목표명, 이번 증가량, 반영 후 누적값, 상태를 포함한다.
예: '유효 작전 종료 · +1회 · 1/2'. 달성된 목표를 우선하고 같은 순위는 고정된
일일/주간 및 목표 순서로 표시한다. 일반 퀘스트와 패스에는 별도 구분을 붙인다.
목표 카운터는 목표치까지만 표시하고 실제 전투wave는 상단에서 보존한다.
이미 끝낸 목표에 진행/XP가 또 생긴 것처럼 표시하지 않는다.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-독립-상태와-행동"></a>
##### 독립 상태와 행동

| 서버 확인 상태 | 표시 제안 | 행동과 제한 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 전투 결과 미확정 | 결과 확인 중 | 목표 증가·완료·지급을 먼저 표시하지 않음 |
| 결과 확정, 목표 반영 미확인 | 목표 진행 확인 중 | 전투 보상은 자체 확정 상태에 따라 수령 가능 |
| 목표 진행 확정, 미달성 | +증가량 / 누적값 | 진행만 표시, 보상 지급 표현 없음 |
| 목표 달성, 지급 또는 수령 가능 상태 미확인 | 목표 달성 · 보상 확인 중 | 클라이언트에서 수령 가능/지급 완료를 추측하지 않음 |
| 서버가 수령 가능으로 확인 | 목표 달성 · 수령 가능 | 해당 임무/패스 화면으로 이동 |
| 서버 지급 내역 확인 | 지급 완료 또는 패스 XP +확정량 | 같은 내역 재열기로 재지급하지 않음 |
| 서버가 미인정으로 확정 | 이번 작전은 목표 진행 대상 아님 | 서버 사유를 쉬운 설명으로 제공 |
| 조회 오류/격리/연동 미지원 | 목표 진행을 확인할 수 없음 | 0회 확정으로 표현하지 않음; 지원되는 재조회 제공 |

일반 퀘스트 직접보상, 패스 목표XP, 패스 레벨보상은 서로 다른 상태다.
'패스 XP +80'은 해당 목표의 서버 확정 지급량일 때만 표시한다. 매작전80XP로
추정하지 않는다. 무료/프리미엄은 같은 XP 진행이며 프리미엄 구매를 진행 조건으로
제시하지 않는다. 레벨 도달만으로 레벨보상 지급 완료를 표시하지 않는다.

전투 '보상 받기'는 기존 전투 보상만 처리한다. 임무/패스 수령을 묵시적으로
합치거나 새 일괄수령 동작을 만들지 않는다. '임무 확인/패스 확인' 이동 후 돌아와도
미해결 전투 claim 상태를 보존해야 하며, 기존 서버 복구/만료 계약이 확인되어야 한다.
목표 반영 지연 자체는 확정 전투보상 수령을 막지 않는다. 다시 도전/이탈 가능 여부는
기존 전투 result/claim 복구 계약을 따른다. 복구 기능이 없으면 임의로 이동을 허용하지 않는다.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-인정-사유와-경계"></a>
##### 인정 사유와 경계

- 정상패배에서 유효wave가 인정되면 '패배 · 목표 진행 반영'으로 표현한다.
  협력 지원/낮은 개인딜을 미인정 사유로 사용하지 않는다.
- Boss 성공은 종료횟수만 증가하고 wave는 만들지 않는다. Boss 패배,0wave패배,
  포기/무효는 채택한 인정조건을 따른다. 기존 유효 incremental receipt를 취소하지 않는다.
- Story15wave 패배는 비용/환급 계약 확인 전 구현 차단 사항이다. 출시 UI에서 임의
  미인정 또는 영구 대기로 덮지 않고, owner 계약 확정 후 해당 상태를 연결한다.
- World는 기존 별도 참여트랙을 표시한다. 새 일일/주간 일반목표 또는 추가XP를 만들지 않는다.
- 이번 작전에 변경이 없다고 서버가 확인한 경우 간단한 '이번 작전의 추가 목표 진행 없음'.
  데이터가 없는 경우에는 같은 문구를 쓰지 않는다.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-04시주간시즌-경계와-재열기"></a>
##### 04시·주간·시즌 경계와 재열기

이번 결과의 최초 서버 확정시각에 고정된 기간과 receipt를 사용한다. 03:59확정 후
04:02응답이면 '이전 일일 기간에 반영'과 당시 결과를 보여주고, 현재 목표 화면의
새날 카운터를 덮어쓰지 않는다. 요청03:59/최초확정04:01이면 새날에 반영한다.
정확히04:00은 새 기간이다. 일반 주간 Monday04와 패스 시즌상대7일 구간은
독립 표기하며 하나의 '이번 주' 데이터로 합치지 않는다. 시즌 종료 후 조회도 원래
시즌 식별을 보존하고, 미수령 보상은 기존 시즌종료 정책에 따라 안내한다.

재열기에서는 같은 작전의 확정 반영내역을 보여주되 이후 다른 작전으로 늘어난 현재
누적값과 혼합하지 않는다. 불변 진행내역과 현재 지급/수령 상태는 구분하여 갱신한다.
정정/무효화 상태가 서버에 존재하면 최신 상태를 따른다. 중복응답·재시도·앱복귀는
증가 애니메이션/완료알림/보상지급의 새 사건이 아니다. 계정 전환 시 이전 계정의
표시·조회 상태를 제거하고, 원계정 복귀 시 그 계정의 서버 상태로 복구한다.

<a id="source-3d41221b4ed5c4ed-연동-최소-계약과-검토-예시"></a>
##### 연동 최소 계약과 검토 예시

필요 의미값은 작전/사건 식별, 결과 자격과 확정 사유, 최초확정시각, 시스템별 기간,
목표별 이번 증가량/당시 누적값/달성 여부, 지급 또는 수령 상태의 근거다.
서버가 제공하거나 검증된 조회 조합으로 복구 가능해야 한다. 새 API 필드/경로가 이미
있다고 주장하지 않는다. 클라이언트가 보상금액·XP·기간을 계산해 확정하지 않는다.

설계 검토 예시이며 실행한 테스트가 아니다:

| 조건 | 기대 표시 |
| --- | --- |
| 정상패배7wave, 종료목표 기존0/2, wave목표53/60 | 패배; 종료+1→1/2; wave+7→60/60; 보상상태는 별도 확인 |
| Boss 성공, 종료목표 미완료 | 종료+1; wave 증가 없음 |
| 두 일일 종료목표 이미 달성 | 새 일일 종료XP 없음; 아직 진행 가능한 주간목표만 반영 |
| 목표 반영 지연, 전투 preview 확정 | 목표 진행 확인 중; 전투 보상 받기 가능 |
| 03:59확정/04:02응답 또는 중복응답 | 원기간 내역1회; 새날 카운터 변경 없음 |
| 지원 역할 협력 참가자 | 원참가자 적격 결과 기준; 개인딜0만으로 제외하지 않음 |

검증 범위: 원문 정책 대조, 문서 재읽기, 상대링크/공백 확인만 수행.
UI 구현·API 계약 확정·런타임 테스트·배포·기기검증은 미수행.
다음 구현 전제는 목표 producer/조회·receipt 복구 계약 및 story 패배 자격 확인이다.
