## Combat Survival Budget Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/combat-survival-budget-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `64b815df6104fbe162f36e6c18d1fd398eab5eaebdaf9e41b6b883f9d6be4504`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Normalized survival arithmetic incomplete, pulsedhealingnotconstantDPS; no hiddenenrage/nogachamandatory; no numericdefaults.

<!-- source-body:source-3df32f8f4c261eda:start -->
<a id="source-3df32f8f4c261eda-combat-survival-budget-proposal"></a>
### Combat Survival Budget Proposal

Status: PROPOSED arithmetic probe, NOT actual operator/car/train stats or tested
encounter. Previous composition accepted as first test; preserve design-only scope.

<a id="source-3df32f8f4c261eda-interior-reference"></a>
#### Interior Reference

Normalize a target operator maxHP1000. Illustrative focused incoming post-mitigation
damage30HP/s (e.g. multiple attacks combined), healing200 every20s to same living
target. Without heal, down at33.33s. With perfect targeted heals at20/40s, first
down46.67s, not the50s predicted by replacing pulses with constant10HP/s healing.
This assumes continuous incoming DPS, no shields/CC/retarget or burst. Actual hit
timings and overheal can change outcome, so no promise of exact survival time.
Do not apply1000HP to all15 units; front/rear/role stats remain future real catalog.
Healing availability depends on actual eligible kit, not an invisible free source.

Threat design: ordinary focus provides reaction opportunity; major targeted hit
candidate20-30percent referenceHP before active protection, clearly signalled and
with baseline counter. Do not layer multiple unavoidable bursts on same target.
Heavy attacks/taunts/gap effects need timeline validation, not average DPS alone.
No universal true-percent damage rule introduced: these percentages are balancing
targets, actual ordinary damage follows agreed armor/shield pipeline.

<a id="source-3df32f8f4c261eda-train-reference"></a>
#### Train Reference

Example totalHP5000; effective direct exteriorDPS12 plus resolved carriage-final
damage aggregate20/s x30percent transfer=6/s. Total18/s, once only; operator hits
do not join this sum. Carriage disable/retarget feedback omitted in this probe.
Reference194s:3492gross damage. No repair =>1508remaining. Candidate eligible
repair400 every30s at30/60/90/120/150/180 contributes2400, remaining3908 when no
overheal. Illustrates meaningful manual repair, not actual passive default grant.
No repair plus four hypothetical400damage sabotage pulses causes5092total,
exceeding5000; real defeat depends on pulse timing. A sabotage pulse is authored
damage reduced per rules, not automatically8percent real maxHP in every run.
This is a deliberately incomplete pressure probe, not full survival simulation.

<a id="source-3df32f8f4c261eda-build-fairness"></a>
#### Build Fairness

Survival must not depend on a mandatory healer/car type. Approved baseline emergency
recovery plus damage/control/protection strategies tested, not assumed equivalent.
Repair-heavy builds may trade clear speed for safety; avoid infinite stall by
designing pressure/objectives, but no unapproved hidden timeout/enrage. Actual
train destruction remains result authority, not client damage display.
Repeated deliberate downs can restoreHP; compare time/action loss against healing
and protection before accepting candidate recovery amounts. Automatic recovery
must not trivialize boss patterns or reward skill neglect.

<a id="source-3df32f8f4c261eda-required-measured-cases"></a>
#### Required Measured Cases

Initial eligible5, no-healer viable alternative, manual support used/missed,
concentrated focus burst, three recovery cycles, four sabotage failures, all-car
disable, overheal, wrong heal target and varying lane clear speed. Same-mode real
authority and actor stats required before calling results validated. No tests run.
Next specify actual per-actor stats/skill effects and event-timed encounter model;
do not invent final live balance from normalized examples.

<!-- source-body:source-3df32f8f4c261eda:end -->


<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55"></a>
## Encounter Budget And Pursuit Pressure Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/encounter-budget-pressure-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `e85addc62b6a6421b3e27489670ee9f9ce85388cd76ba5b62eed4bb4974317b8`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Numeric EHP1.30/testpressure only exteriorpursuerbasiccadence; no doubleHP/ATK factor/hiddenHPtax; nextcycle changes notcommitteddeadlines; no liveadoption.

<!-- source-body:source-64b7674243ba4c55:start -->
<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-encounter-budget-and-pursuit-pressure-proposal"></a>
### Encounter Budget And Pursuit Pressure Proposal

2026-09-09 Plan. NEW NUMERIC CANDIDATES, design only, not deployed or accepted
combat balance. Sources: combat-stats-v1, train-loadout-speed-detail-v1,
ordinary-enemy-budget-proposal-20260909 and combat-simulation-acceptance-v1.
No JSON/runtime modification; candidate scenarios must be explicitly selected.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-reference-profile"></a>
#### Reference Profile

Initial five L1/P0/kit1; proposed trainHP profile explicitly selected, not mixed
with legacy TrainCoreCatalog. Default2 Combat+Gun, cruise, engine65/weight60,
speed1.05. Medical/Defense/Cargo absent. Skill effects and actual cadence still
require events; only basic-throughput arithmetic is used for the following budgets.

Interior initial119.714 operatorDPS +15 Combat device =134.714.
Exterior60 locomotive +20 Gun device =80. Old budgets produced ideal158s including
14s gaps/9s entry, not the intended reference3-4min. No extra hidden enemy or idle
delay should be inserted simply to increase elapsed time.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-health-budget-alternatives"></a>
#### Health Budget Alternatives

Compare unchanged1.00, proposed1.30, sensitivity1.50 times prior lane EHP. Recommend
1.30 as the FIRST simulation candidate, not as measured best balance. Keep enemy
count/behavior/armor unchanged to isolate health changes. Do not multiply again
when loading a pre-scaled table.

| Waves | Interior EHP per wave at1.30 | Exterior EHP per wave at1.30 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1-3 | 1040 | 624 |
| 4-6 | 1300 | 780 |
| 7-9 | 1560 | 936 |
| 10-12 | 1820 | 1092 |
| 13-15 | 2080 | 1248 |

Total interior23400/exterior14040 EHP. Simple ideal interior173.701s/exterior175.5s;
parallel plus23s gap/entrance =198.5s. With skills/deaths/overkill/delayed spawns
actual time differs. Even matching this number cannot prove the180..240s P1 target.
At1.00 ideal158s;1.50 ideal225.5s under identical assumptions. Compare events before
adopting any of them. High-growth players may clear faster without time penalties.

Spawn raw HP uses existing armor-weighted allocation:
q = laneBudget / sum(baseHP/(1-armor)); enemyHP=floor(baseHP*q).
Raw HP is NOT EHP; rounding residual recorded. Apply authored mission modifier
and difficultyHP once each, not again to both budget and allocatedHP.
The1.30 candidate is only this reference encounter; not a blanket rewrite of all
six missions or unverified chapter2/3. Mission mappings and reference progression
still need authoring; automatic player-level enemy scaling remains excluded.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-incoming-damage-kept-separate"></a>
#### Incoming Damage Kept Separate

Keep existing candidate enemyATK/interval/major warnings unchanged in the first
health comparison. More HP already extends enemy uptime and incoming damage;
increasing ATK at the same time makes source attribution difficult.
Second pass, if required, compare ATK factors0.85/1.00/1.15 with the selected HP
candidate, keeping warning durations and attack cadence fixed. These are test
variants, not a live difficulty selector or replacement of riskI..V multipliers.

No ordinary fullHP instant death from one disclosed mechanic should be required
for pressure. Recovery/shields/heals measured with effective rather than issued
amounts. Do not nerf all healing just to make the reference end at a chosen HP.
First adjust the offending skill/device and compare offense cost and overgrowth.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-proposed-meaning-of-pursuit-pressure"></a>
#### Proposed Meaning Of Pursuit Pressure

Existing calculator provides multipliers but its actual consumer was not verified.
Choose one narrow proposed meaning: EXTERIOR PURSUER BASIC ATTACK FREQUENCY ONLY.
Alternatives rejected for this candidate: extra hidden spawns (changes counts and
rewards), flat unavoidable HP drain (weak counterplay), multiplying both attack
damage and frequency (double punishment). This is a new design choice, not a
claim that current runtime already behaves this way.

| Current speed index | Pressure multiplier | Railbike nominal1.8s interval after50ms rounding |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| >=1.20 | 0.70 | 2.60s |
| >=1.10 and <1.20 | 0.85 | 2.15s |
| >=1.00 and <1.10 | 1.00 | 1.80s |
| >=0.85 and <1.00 | 1.15 | 1.60s |
| <0.85 | 1.30 | 1.40s |

interval = ceil((baseInterval/pressure)/50ms)*50ms, with minimum interval
max(authoredWindup+recovery,600ms). Only enemy_railbike_marauder is tagged for the
current reference. Do not apply to operators, train weapons, interior enemies,
boss mechanics, sabotage pulse period, shields/heals or cooldowns. Projectile
damage stays22 before risk/armor. No extra score/loot or shorter15wave sequence.

At current speed change, keep committed impact deadline. Recompute following
cycle only; no rescheduling into past or burst from accumulated attack debt.
Use the authoritative speed index with defined integer precision for threshold
comparisons. UI shows pursuit state, not a client-calculated damage bonus.
1.05 reference stays pressure1.00. Default4/core6 speed0.86 yields1.15, but added
Defense/Cargo effects must be simulated before claiming it is harder overall.

Cruise is the baseline. Low/emergency multipliers exist but their input/cost/
duration contract is incomplete: do not introduce a free permanent speed boost
or fourth manual button here. No auto acceleration to rescue a failing case.
World Raid and story boss are excluded from this pressure candidate; their
mechanics/timers must not inherit ordinary pursuit behavior without explicit design.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-ui-and-fairness"></a>
#### UI And Fairness

Before departure show weight/speed and a plain pursuit-state indicator. More
carriages can trade speed for useful devices; no invented overweight ban.
Slow speed cannot secretly shorten a major warning because pressure only affects
pursuer basics. Every basic still has its authored visible windup.
Lower speed does not take away rewards or apply a direct settlement penalty.
In coop, train owner supplies speed/parts; the squad partner does not add another
pressure factor. Server owns the encounter value, clients render the same state.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-proposed-experiment-order"></a>
#### Proposed Experiment Order

1. Correctness invariants with pressure disabled, explicit baseline stats.
2. Compare HP1.00/1.30/1.50 with same input policy/loadout; keep ATK1.00.
3. With selected HP compare incoming ATK candidates only if pressure is wrong.
4. Enable narrow exterior pressure; check all five speed bands and boundary cases.
5. Compare legal2/3/4 car compositions, defensive uptime and healing cost.
6. Test manual/slow/missed-input policies and attainable growth, then economy.

If a case lacks actual mission IDs/loadout entitlement, label synthetic/BLOCKED
for runtime parity, not production-ready. Do not average incompatible versions.
All changes remain versioned encounter candidates until adopted; current
combat-stats-v1.json retains its earlier reference numbers for reproducibility.

<a id="source-64b7674243ba4c55-evidence-and-next-step"></a>
#### Evidence And Next Step

Only source reconciliation and quotient/rounding arithmetic checked in this work.
No event simulation, Unity/server tests, device check, art/video or deployment.
Next detail: resolve legacy vs proposed train durability/armor/fire-control into
one chosen TEST profile, then author actual mission-specific scaling. No assertion
that all combat details or release balance are complete.

<!-- source-body:source-64b7674243ba4c55:end -->


<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117"></a>
## Enemy AI And Wave Execution Detail

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/enemy-ai-wave-execution-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `aa169699ec6770907f64641816cf492ee6b2ef4ee3c5df3df9a308d069bed110`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Enemy/wave statefields/expected-pendingliving/pendingharmful bounded; stable orderedcandidate notnetworkorder; no visualclear; no committedretarget; terminal latch and samebody retries; failuretie/refund predicate open. Numbers and15waves proposal latestJ04.

<!-- source-body:source-354d63ae7f0c9117:start -->
<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-enemy-ai-and-wave-execution-detail"></a>
### Enemy AI And Wave Execution Detail

2026-09-09, Plan. DESIGN PROPOSAL ONLY; no runtime or release change.
Sources: combat-stats-v1.json/.md, enemy-targeting-sabotage-proposal-20260909.md,
realtime-combat-implementation-design-20260909.md. Numeric values are test candidates.
Scope: ordinary15-wave encounters and existing story boss. No new World Raid
release, reward rules, movement system or required recruited counter unit.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-goals"></a>
#### Goals

Concurrent automatic attacks, readable dangerous actions, meaningful focus/skills.
No actor/team turns, no pause during aiming and no dependence on animation callbacks
for damage. Five allies remain in approved left-area formation: rear left3/front
right2; enemies stay in right region. Logical target rules do not move the art.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-actor-state-model"></a>
#### Actor State Model

Entering -> TargetReady -> BasicWindup -> Committed -> Recovery -> TargetReady.
Special path: TargetReady -> Telegraph -> SpecialCommitted -> Recovery.
Saboteur: Telegraph -> Channel -> Recovery. Down/dead transitions override new
actions, but do not undo already applied damage. Ordinary enemy death is permanent
within that wave; operator/carriage recovery follows the mode-specific stat design.

Suggested Entering duration600ms. It is excluded from authored attack timers:
first basic impact is targetableAt + attackMs; first special warning starts
targetableAt + periodMs - warningMs. Entering enemies are visible but untargetable;
no attacks during entrance and no damage quota counted as already defeated.
No arbitrary offscreen stalls: spawning/targetable timestamps are authoritative.
Defining600ms entrance adds9s over15waves to the older ideal194s arithmetic before
other effects. It does not promise an actual203s clear.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-target-selection"></a>
#### Target Selection

At each new attack: actor alive and actionable -> valid compatible taunt -> family
priority -> deterministic tie. Never select down/recovering/entering entities.
Front/rear groups are logical ally slots, not collider overlap or sprite pixel size.
Front target tie order cycles among surviving front slots per accepted basic;
rear similarly cycles. Existing any_ally rotating cursor stays deterministic.
Heal/lowestHP remains ratio-based as in stat design. Enemy ties use stable spawn
sequence then entity ID, not hash-map ordering or fresh random rolls.

Basic attacks can be taunted for assault/heavy/ranged/jammer. Exterior and
sabotage specials ignore taunt and display their train target. Specials already
telegraphed do not change target because of a later taunt or front-slot recovery.
An invalid target before commit can be reacquired for a BASIC attack, restarting
its full windup; no instant hit on the new target. A targeted SPECIAL cancels that
occurrence instead of transferring an unseen hit. Multi-target special loses only
invalid members, never adds unmarked replacements. Cooldown is not refunded.
After commit no retarget. A projectile with invalid target dissipates, no score.

No living ally: assault/ranged/heavy/jammer wait, checking eligibility each tick.
They do not secretly damage train. Authored exterior/sabotage can continue against
eligible train. On an ally return, schedule full windup; no accumulated-hit burst.
An entity with ordinary protection remains a valid target but receives zero
ordinary damage; enemies do not automatically identify immunity and punish another.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-eight-behavior-profiles"></a>
#### Eight Behavior Profiles

Values below reference the stat candidate; damage before mitigation.

| Existing ID | Basic target / interval | Special | Practical counter |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enemy_raider_scout | Front /1.6s | None | Guard/shield, kill focus |
| enemy_railbike_marauder | Train /1.8s | None | Train fire/barrier/repair |
| enemy_scrapshield_brute | Front /2.2s | Mark up to2 front allies;100 each,3s warning,12s period | Shield or interrupt/stun before commit |
| enemy_signal_jammer_drone | Rotating ally /2s | Highest resolvedATK ally slow20%4s,3s warning,14s period | Focus, interrupt or cleanse |
| enemy_spike_cart_gunner | Rear /2s | None; visible target during windup | Protect exposed rear, focus |
| enemy_cinder_hound_mech | Front /1.6s | Train sabotage80 per1s x4,4s warning,14s period | Kill or interrupt source to stop remaining pulses |
| elite_broadcast_executioner | Rotating ally /2.2s | All living allies slow25%5s,3.5s warning,16s period | Focus/interrupt; cleanse chosen ally |
| elite_ironclad_boarder | Front /2.4s | Mark up to2 front allies;140 each,3.5s warning,14s period | Shield/interrupt, no required movement dodge |

HighestATK selection uses frozen resolved stat, not transient damage buffs; ties
stable slot. Special100/140 damage follows riskATK multiplier and normal armor/
shield pipeline. Sabotage direct train damage does not also transfer from carriage.
Stun/interrupt cancels Telegraph or remaining Channel. Mark/armor break alone does
not interrupt. Source death stops later sabotage pulses, not emitted projectiles.
Ordinary special damage/slow does not bypass recovery protection as world mechanic
penalties do. Slow is a status: protection from damage alone does not block slow.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-special-and-basic-scheduling"></a>
#### Special And Basic Scheduling

An actor cannot perform a basic and special simultaneously. The special reserves
the actor only when its warning starts; queued warning waits for a committed basic
and its recovery to finish. Basic deadlines during Telegraph/Channel are skipped,
not replayed. After special completion/cancel, next basic impact is no earlier than
recoveryEnd + basicWindup. Cooldown timestamps continue during control/down.

Nominal special occurrence n is targetableAt+n*periodMs. Scheduler may delay the
warning below; actual impact = actualWarningStart+fullWarningDuration. Next nominal
occurrence is based on nominal time, not sped up to compensate. It still cannot
start until preceding action/channel/recovery completes. Never shorten warnings.
If actor is stunned at warning time, eligible warning can wait within the same
delay budget. A special explicitly interrupted consumes that occurrence.

Danger coordinator proposal: at most ONE major telegraph/channel in interior
lane at a time; at least1500ms between its completion and next major warning.
Ordinary basic attacks remain concurrent. Exterior basic attacks do not occupy
this token. Train-targeting interior sabotage DOES occupy interior danger token.
FIFO by nominalWarningAt then spawn sequence. Maximum warning delay4000ms;
after that skip occurrence, no damage/debuff, no extra cooldown reset or refund.
This controls encounter presentation, not player turns. Log skips for balance QA.

All current ordinary compositions have at most two major-special sources. Future
config that repeatedly starves one pattern must fail authoring review rather than
be called balanced because the skip system suppresses its danger.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-telegraph-presentation-contract"></a>
#### Telegraph Presentation Contract

Each warning carries actionId, sourceEntityId, fixed target IDs/category,
warningStart, commitAt, effect kind, severity and cancel state. UI renders target
ring/icon and countdown using server time; color is not the only discriminator.
Never show a dodge circle when players cannot move units. Mark affected slots,
and expose interruptible status using a distinct icon/text label.
Priority: imminent danger > health/down state > damage number > flavor dialogue.
Effects must not obscure operator skills, train controls or the marked target.
For late snapshots show remaining warning, do not restart it locally. Local visual
prediction cannot cancel a hit or confirm a mechanic until authoritative event.
Network delay fairness requires real device testing;3-4s is not a latency guarantee.

Attack windup/impact art can include lunges, recoil and projectiles but restores
approved anchors. Logical impact is scheduled, not sprite distance/collision.
Animation clip mismatch is a QA failure, not permission to change combat damage time.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-wave-lifecycle"></a>
#### Wave Lifecycle

Idle -> SpawnScheduled -> Entering -> Active -> Cleared -> Gap -> next wave.
Freeze both lane manifests before start. Every wave has explicit expected spawn
count, pending spawn count and living count; zero currently visible actors alone
does not clear a wave. No hidden infinite respawn or unconfigured reinforcements.

Wave clears only when all scheduled enemies in BOTH lanes are resolved dead and
pending damage from the outgoing enemies has resolved or been explicitly canceled
under the same projectile rules. No cross-wave ghost damage. Do not wait for
decorative particles, corpse fade or a healing effect to finish. If an outgoing
projectile is still eligible, show its impact and delay clear; author bounded TTL
at most1500ms for ordinary basic projectiles, full disclosed windup kept separate.

After clear1s gap, retain ally HP, train/carriage HP, cooldowns, down counts,
recovery deadlines and already-active beneficial effects. Clock does not pause.
Manual beneficial skills remain usable during gap. No automatic full heal or
free ultimate refresh. Next wave entrance600ms then targeting; wave15clear ends
ordinary combat. Result/first-clear/reward remain server decisions.

Spawn ID must be stable across retransmissions. Missing asset cannot substitute a
random enemy definition; missing required definition fails content preflight.
Connection/content faults are not silently recorded as player defeat by this design.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-same-tick-conflict-resolution"></a>
#### Same-Tick Conflict Resolution

Earlier architecture suggested a pre-batch simultaneous-damage model; combat-stats
then specified stable sequential effects. This proposal chooses the latter for
implementation review, not claiming the older alternatives are both implemented.
Sequence: attempt deadline -> expire states/recover -> accept commands -> due
effects by (scheduledTime, actionSequence, effectIndex) -> terminal evaluation.
Each damage application immediately marks HP0 and suppresses later invalid-target
heals/hits. Effects committed before source death can still land if target valid.
Server actionSequence assigned once; never client time/dictionary iteration order.
No special global heal-before-hit priority. Test ties explicitly.

If train and final boss both reach0 within the same tick, proposed story outcome
is failure, consistent with prior architecture candidate. This tie-break remains
pending acceptance and must not be assumed an existing backend behavior.
Any terminal outcome stops new attacks/waves and emits one result request only.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-worked-timeline-not-runtime-evidence"></a>
#### Worked Timeline, Not Runtime Evidence

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-terminal-decision-cases---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Terminal Decision Cases - 2026-09-09

Design clarification of the sequential candidate above, not approved deployed
settlement behavior. Same-tick mutual destruction failure remains a recommendation.
Do not equate same rendered frame with the same authoritative simulation tick.

| Case | Proposed decision |
| --- | --- |
| Interior clear but exterior alive | Continue current wave |
| Both lanes clear with eligible pending harmful projectile | Resolve bounded pending effect before clear, per existing wave rule |
| Wave1..14 clear, train alive | One gap/next-wave transition, no full heal or reset |
| Wave15 clear, train alive, no required pending effects | One ordinary success candidate |
| Story bossHP0, train alive after same-tick due effects | One story success candidate |
| TrainHP0 and final enemy/bossHP0 same tick | Failure candidate, not simultaneous success plus failure |
| TrainHP0 then later repair in the ordered tick | Repair cannot resurrect terminal train |
| All five operators down, train alive | Continue with individual recovery timers |
| World deadline reached exactly when damage is due | Existing deadline-first rule, no hit at deadline scored |

Source-death and wave-clear checks must retain their existing distinction: already
committed effects can resolve according to their own validity; corpses/visual debris
cannot keep a wave open. Do not introduce a new wait for beneficial ticks, future
uncommitted attacks, endless particles or a boss death animation. Story candidate
success closes after its same-tick checks; no new post-victory projectile damage.
Terminal status latches once and prevents future gameplay effects/new waves, but
does not erase the frozen evidence needed to verify or retry its result.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-result-submission-and-presentation"></a>
###### Result Submission And Presentation

One result request means one logical settlement identity for the attempt, not a ban
on transport retries. Preserve run identity, frozen outcome/evidence and version;
retry/query existing server recovery contract without inventing a new run or reward.
Do not recalculate the outcome using edited loadouts or new content on retry.

While confirmation is pending, stop gameplay input and show a neutral verification
state. A local boss collapse may finish visually but must not issue confirmed-clear,
first-clear/unlock or refund claims before authoritative acceptance. A lost response
is pending/unknown, not player defeat. Reconnect/account-switch recovery remains
account-scoped; no previous account's result can be claimed by the new account.

On accepted result use its actual preview/claim path. Duplicate replies do not reopen
the battle or grant rewards again. A conflict/invalid result follows the classified
server error path, not a locally fabricated success or automatic compensation.
Story mutual destruction/refund mapping needs explicit contract review: the existing
failure refund predicate may require bossDefeated=false, so do not falsify that field
or promise a refund when both HP values reached0. Tie policy alone does not change it.

Future tests should permute same-time lethal/heal/boss hits with fixed actionSequence,
test both-lane/projectile boundary, one latched terminal state, lost finish response,
duplicate response and account switch. These are specified tests, not executed ones.
This unit reviewed source policies and documentation only. No runtime/deploy changes.

One saboteur targetable at0: first nominal impact14s, warning10..14s.
If uninterrupted, pulses at15/16/17/18s, raw total320 before train mitigation.
Interrupt at13s cancels all pulses; interrupt at16.05s leaves two accepted pulses,
raw160, cancels17/18s. At exactly16s authoritative effect sequence decides whether
second pulse precedes interrupt, not animation arrival. Clear target ID is train.
If full warning delayed to12s, completion16s, pulses17/18/19/20s; no retroactive
14s impact. All times are relative to targetableAt, not encounter opening frame.

With brute nominal warning9s and saboteur10s: brute owns token9..12; release plus
1.5s means saboteur warning starts13.5 (delay3.5<=4), commit17.5, last pulse21.5.
This prolongs the threat but preserves full4s reaction window. If blocked beyond14s
warning-start latest, skip occurrence; never squeeze a4s warning into500ms.

<a id="source-354d63ae7f0c9117-verification-and-next-step"></a>
#### Verification And Next Step

Planning source review and timeline arithmetic only. No combat simulator, Unity,
two-device or server regression ran. Add runtime tests for: front/rear fallback,
taunt before/afterwarning, highestATK ties, all5down, protection, interrupt before
commit/duringchannel/exactpulse, two-telegraph delay/skip, no basic catchup, late
snapshot, missing asset, pending spawn/projectile, bothlanesclear, wave15terminal,
retained cooldown/recovery, duplicate events and simultaneous train/boss0.

Next design: player skill input/target selection and train-operator interaction
priority against these warnings, then an event simulation using initial five to
measure actual kill/heal/repair trajectories. Catalog review and stat proposals
remain outstanding; nothing here certifies balanced combat or authorizes coding.

<!-- source-body:source-354d63ae7f0c9117:end -->


<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7"></a>
## Enemy Targeting And Sabotage Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/enemy-targeting-sabotage-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `f56306cc981a350238937473a3ea3800e1358e289c5d32e4ad889454689cea25`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Behaviorfamily proposal notcatalogmapping; ordinaryall-down waits nohidden trainhit; sabotage stopsfuturepulse only; no mandatoryelitecounter.

<!-- source-body:source-a68fef1d00b562f7:start -->
<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7-enemy-targeting-and-sabotage-proposal"></a>
### Enemy Targeting And Sabotage Proposal

Status: PROPOSED behavior families, not confirmed mapping to enemy IDs or engine.
Sources: approved combat control and health documents. Fixed allied left3/right2;
right2 within allied region are proposed front slots, left3 rear slots. Slot does
not force a class. Validate art perspective without moving approved geometry.

<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7-behavior-families"></a>
#### Behavior Families

- Assault: select a living reachable front-slot operator; rear fallback if no
  front is eligible. Lock through current accepted attack to avoid jitter.
- Ranged: mark a specific eligible operator then attack; rear priority can be
  authored, never assume guard protects all attacks merely by standing in front.
- Heavy: telegraphed operator-area hit with shield/control counterplay. Does not
  automatically damage train as well. No mandatory free-movement dodge.
- Saboteur: visible setup at an interior device then periodic train-integrity
  damage. Eliminate or interrupt the saboteur to stop subsequent pulses; merely
  selecting focus is not a successful interruption. Never an invisible HP tax.
- Jammer/support: explicit operator/train-support debuff with identifiable source;
  do not disable every possible counter simultaneously. Actual effect needs kit.
- Exterior threat: train integrity target, countered by actual train commands;
  no duplicate operator damage unless an explicit separate attack exists.

Every behavior must map to authoritative existing enemy catalog after approval;
this list neither invents six new assets nor claims existing enemies implement it.

<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7-priority-and-telegraph"></a>
#### Priority And Telegraph

Resolve mechanic-specific legal target, then compatible taunt/control if authored,
then family priority, then stable tie-breaker. Dead/down/untargetable excluded.
Death after attack commit follows projectile/skill policy, not arbitrary free
retarget. Random selection, if a kit requires it, is authoritative not client RNG.
Show selected target icon/line and warning before heavy/sabotage attacks. Trial
warning2-3s for major setup; duration not approved and must cover mobile/network
reaction budget. Telegraphs and voice lines never hide essential health or controls.

<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7-squad-down-and-counterplay"></a>
#### Squad Down And Counterplay

When no legal living operator remains, only enemies with authored sabotage or
external-train capability attack integrity. Ordinary assault waits/repositions
without attacking downed units or gaining a hidden instant train strike.
Sabotage still gives warning/setup; no global triple damage or timer penalty.
Recovery does not erase already committed hits; next target selection follows rules.
Each required ordinary pattern needs a counter available to initial5/train kit
under entry conditions, not a mandatory elite pull or consumable. If train/squad
role unavailable, avoid mechanically impossible compulsory two-role resolution.

<a id="source-a68fef1d00b562f7-test-plan"></a>
#### Test Plan

Front/rear fallback, invalid focus, taunt compatibility, committed projectiles,
all-down behavior, sabotage cancel vs later pulses, no duplicate train+operator
damage, concurrent threats and baseline-kit counter availability. No tests run.
Next map families onto existing enemies and design15wave pacing; numeric attack
damage/frequency not finalized by this document.

<!-- source-body:source-a68fef1d00b562f7:end -->


<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235"></a>
## Initial Five Counter Timeline Check V1

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/initial-five-counter-timeline-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `34ad2fdb6b7c5f83e9f1d3006f7e91a337baa4fbbf3aa9b89c5c5ce6df8af292`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: 전투/작전 교차분야 상세 계약. 구형15wave/start package와 새 노드정책은 프로토콜 이행 대조 필요

<!-- source-body:source-841ce36f42ad7235:start -->
<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-initial-five-counter-timeline-check-v1"></a>
### Initial Five Counter Timeline Check V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / arithmetic check, NOT event simulation or balance acceptance.
Sources: combat-stats-v1.json, story-raid-boss-rotation-v1.md,
story-boss-warning-mapping-v1.md. No new ability/cost/stat changes.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-actual-kit-corrections"></a>
#### Actual Kit Corrections

- Kyle active shields lowest-HP ally1, not both marked allies. It is only a B
  mitigation when its resolved recipient matches a marked target. Taunt does not
  redirect this immune boss's already marked attack.
- Eve active heals lowest-HP ally1. It is not guaranteed two-target recovery.
- Sera ACTIVE has interrupt; her ultimate does not. Do not treat ultimate-ready as
  a spare interrupt. The one selected ultimate is not required by this schedule.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-assumptions"></a>
#### Assumptions

Nominal impacts A14/B28/C42 and repeat every42s. C pulses43/44/45/46 per source.
Boss-action scheduling can delay these times; this check excludes such delays.
All relevant actors available, correct boss target, no action lock, no transport
latency, no other use of Sera active or train barrier. Times below are actual CAST
START, not tap times. Cooldown starts there; Sera windup300ms, barrier350ms/6s.
Initial-five kits at skill1, but survival/growth/package stats not evaluated here.

| Pattern | Cast start | Effect | Next ready | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| A impact14 | Barrier12 | Shield12.35..18.35 | 42 | Shield active at hit14; absorption depends on remaining shield |
| B impact28 | Sera25 | Interrupt25.30 | 41 | Within24..28 warning |
| C channel42 | Sera43.50 | Interrupt43.80 | 59.50 | First pulse43 applies;44/45/46 cancelled |
| A impact56 | Barrier54 | Shield54.35..60.35 | 84 |42s reuse interval exceeds30s cooldown |
| B impact70 | Sera67 | Interrupt67.30 | 83 | Repeat with23.50s gap after prior C cast |
| C channel84 | Sera85.50 | Interrupt85.80 | 101.50 |18.50s gap after B; first pulse85 applies |

PowerShell parsed actual Sera kit and checked four cycles through169.50s:
B casts25/67/109/151; C casts43.5/85.5/127.5/169.5. All real inter-cast gaps
alternate18.5/23.5s, above16s cooldown. Initial sentinel gap is not gameplay data.
Barrier42s repetition compared with documented30s cooldown. No runtime executed.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-meaning-and-risks"></a>
#### Meaning And Risks

This is a feasible nominal cooldown assignment, NOT mandatory player choreography.
It intentionally tolerates one C pulse: raw60/66/72 by phase before ordinary defense.
No assumption that this is final HP loss or that healing always covers it.
Barrier availability does not prove full A absorption: prior ordinary hits can
consume it. Fixing cast time earlier is not automatically safer.

Do not teach fixed seconds in the UI. Teach threat recognition and role-appropriate
responses. Exact schedules can move due to boss action locks, down/queue delays,
target changes or player use of Sera to gain damage/mark effects.

A tighter alternative can interrupt C before its first pulse once cooldown returns,
but is not the baseline accessibility requirement. No zero-damage/perfect-response
requirement and no forced selected ultimate or recruited character introduced.

The comparison16s cooldown vs14s special alone is insufficient to prove that every
pair of consecutive warnings is impossible to interrupt: warning windows allow
timing shifts. It does show sustained every-special interruption cannot continue
indefinitely at14s average cadence. Use actual windows, not period-only claims.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-missed-counter-and-recovery-detail"></a>
#### Missed Counter And Recovery Detail

2026-09-09 follow-up: extend the same scenario, not another boss mechanic. Compare
combat-health-recovery-proposal-20260909.md and combat-simulation-acceptance-v1.md.
The following is proposed response guidance, not automatic player AI or a guarantee
of survival. Earlier nominal cast schedule is not a required choreography.

| Failure case | Available follow-up | Explicit limitation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Miss A interrupt | Compatible train shield before actual hit; Mira/manual repair after actual damage | Never apply a late shield retroactively |
| Miss B interrupt | Compatible shield on its resolved living recipient; Eve heal after hit | Kyle/Eve active each target1; no guaranteed protection/heal for both marks |
| Miss C opening | Interrupt during channel to stop remaining pulses; shield pending hits; repair damage | Do not restore damage already taken or restart the pulse sequence |
| Sera down | Continue basic attacks; train defenses against A/C, eligible shields/heals against B | No replacement interrupt added to Reina or Sera ultimate |
| Eve down | Other operators act; compatible shields mitigate, downed allies recover by their own timers | No ordinary heal revives Eve; no guarantee a Medical carriage is owned |
| Mira down | Existing manual train repair if ready, barriers and remaining squad actions | Train repair is not shared with operator healing |
| Several operators down | Remaining entities keep fighting, each downed portrait shows its own return time | No extra whole-squad timer and no instantaneous defeat from all5 down |

Retain existing ordinary/story test baseline: per-operator6/9/12s capped repeated
recovery, return50%HP, existing2s ordinary protection, cooldown continues without
reset. Protection applicability still follows actual damage tags; do not advertise
universal boss immunity. Recovery does not heal other entities or grant a new cast.
Train integrity0 remains ordinary/story failure, unlike World Raid train recovery.
Actor recovery cannot reopen a terminated attempt.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-readability-and-decision-support"></a>
##### Readability And Decision Support

- At down, dim only that actor's controls and show return time; preserve unrelated
  controls. Recovery cue is brief, not a blocking cut-in or auto-cast.
- Show actual HP loss and current warnings; do not show a mandatory corrective popup
  over ongoing combat. Distinguish missed prevention from post-damage recovery.
- Availability hints derive current legal state, not future pattern timing. Do not
  auto-spend a heal/ultimate or enforce the sample12/25/43.5s sequence.
- If all counters are unavailable, do not offer an impossible action. The baseline
  must be evaluated for recoverable damage, not hide missing options with fake UI.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-future-comparison-cases"></a>
##### Future Comparison Cases

Use the existing P1 reactive driver vs one declared missed A, missed B, late C,
Sera unavailable and Eve unavailable. Delay/down fixtures are test interventions,
not new boss targeting rules. Keep growth/loadout/start package and other inputs
fixed; record HP minima, effective shield/heal, remaining pulses and recovery count.
Require the existing single-miss fullHP safety investigation for ordinary mechanics;
do not promise a lowHP actor survives or that repeated failures always clear.
Compare voluntary-down versus matched defensive play before accepting recovery
numbers; no numerical recovery buff is added to fix this without evidence.

Readback/policy comparison only for this follow-up. No additional arithmetic,
simulation or runtime tests. No code, owner assignment, video or deployment.

<a id="source-841ce36f42ad7235-outstanding-verification"></a>
#### Outstanding Verification

Need a bounded event model for basic attack consumption of shields, cast queues,
all targets/HP/down, healing caps, full start package, growth and variable warning
schedule before declaring initial-five viability or boss difficulty. This turn
does not authorize that implementation or modify server/Unity. Candidate numbers
remain proposals. Local uncommitted docs; arithmetic and readback only.

<!-- source-body:source-841ce36f42ad7235:end -->


<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393"></a>
## Operator And Train Kit Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/operator-train-kit-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `ffbd99e11e893e13c1e63e743d67b4b94f1cd511f30dbc4ca15b33fa3c7811db`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Early kitproposal and10%tactic-offerchance notgacha; selectedultimatebaseaccess later supersedesgate; fullscreennopause old superseded04§14. Abilityrowfields preserve.

<!-- source-body:source-1276e6b3e1192393:start -->
<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-operator-and-train-kit-proposal"></a>
### Operator And Train Kit Proposal

Status: PROPOSED detailed design only; no skills/stat changes or owner assignments.
Narrative role reference: act1-operator-voice-guide.md. Its roles/cues are not
authoritative existing combat effects; all effects below are newly proposed.

<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-action-budget"></a>
#### Action Budget

Five primary operator actives on portraits, automatic basic attacks/passives,
one separately selected ultimate slot, up to three distinct train support actions.
Solo sees both compact groups; coop only own-role inputs plus partner readiness.
Avoid nine equally emphasized buttons: primary5 lower row, ultimate distinct,
train actions by exterior panel. Layout remains mockup/device QA candidate.
No use of credits/crystals for these combat commands.

<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-initial-five-proposed-roles"></a>
#### Initial Five Proposed Roles

Kyle: target ally protection and compatible enemy taunt, defensive ultimate.
Reina: focused single-target strike, concentrated damage ultimate.
Eve: living-ally healing, group healing/protection ultimate; no down revival assumed.
Sera: reveal/mark priority threat and sabotage interruption, group focus-window
ultimate. Scout fiction does not require free unit dragging in fixed formation.
Mira: short train repair or train support readiness assistance, combined systems
support ultimate. Full cooldown reset prohibited by default; exact reduction cap
must avoid zero-cooldown loops. Do not assume one skill provides all listed effects.
These kits must be reduced to one precise effect set per ability before coding.
All15 approved operators need eventual exact definitions; this starts with initial5
for baseline counterplay, does not remove ten additional elite operators.

<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-train-support-proposed-slots"></a>
#### Train Support Proposed Slots

Support fire: valid exterior target damage, or explicitly defined interior breach
suppression; do not draw exterior ammunition through closed cabin without matching
fiction/effect. Choose one exact targeting mode in subsequent skill spec.
Defensive system: train barrier; operator protection only if explicitly part of
the support effect, not automatic sharedHP or duplicate damage interception.
Emergency repair: restore train integrity, no revive after story failure. Availability
must follow actual fitted components/default kit, not grant unowned equipment.
Initial loadout needs required ordinary counterplay; extras may improve efficiency
but cannot create a mandatory paid/elite unit dependency.

<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-ultimate-source-conflict"></a>
#### Ultimate Source Conflict

Actual RunSnapshot has one UltimateOperatorId within selected five. Actual
Tactics/UltimateTacticAppearanceRules.cs offers an ultimate tactic when conditionMet
and rollPercent<10. This10percent is tactic-offer chance, NOT recruitment odds.
No actual gauge/cast implementation established by these reads. Do not silently
replace this path with fixed cooldown/shared meter or guarantee an ultimate each run.
Recommended immediate scope: preserve selected slot/legacy gate until user chooses
whether offer chance unlocks, upgrades or is replaced by guaranteed ultimate access.
Basic mandatory mechanics cannot depend on a random ultimate offer. No long pause
or full-screen blocking cinematic even for ultimate.

<a id="source-1276e6b3e1192393-required-final-ability-row"></a>
#### Required Final Ability Row

actorID/skillID/version, normal/passive/ultimate, legal mode/targets/range,
exact effect list/scaling, cooldown and initial state, cast and effect deadlines,
interrupt/refund behavior, duration/stack cap, boss immunity interaction,
visual/audio/localization keys. Validate complete initial5 before extrapolating15.
Future tests: allied heal no revive, barrier specificity, taunt exclusions,
cooldown reduction cap, focus marker expiry, same-hit buff once, ordinary baseline
counterplay and solo/cooperative role permissions. No tests executed.

<!-- source-body:source-1276e6b3e1192393:end -->


<a id="source-af672e8610564410"></a>
## Ordinary Enemy Budget Proposal

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/ordinary-enemy-budget-proposal-20260909.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `7a0582b030f90a68888af4a10661e8e72d23cd64758753abb32a5cc1a2e6d3d7`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Useraccepted FIRSTTEST composition notbalance; EHPvsrawHP, maxlanetimesnot sum; 15wave/counts notnewJ04approval.

<!-- source-body:source-af672e8610564410:start -->
<a id="source-af672e8610564410-ordinary-enemy-budget-proposal"></a>
### Ordinary Enemy Budget Proposal

Status: USER ACCEPTED FIRST TEST COMPOSITION on2026-09-09; design accounting
only, no actual actor stats, runtime validation or changes. Normalized DPS is a
model assumption, not an approved roster stat.
Source: ordinary-wave-recovery-pacing-proposal-20260909.md. First reference encounter,
not same encounter copied into every operation/difficulty and not World Raid.

<a id="source-af672e8610564410-simultaneous-interior-threats"></a>
#### Simultaneous Interior Threats

| Waves | Interior live units candidate | Roles | Reference seconds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1-3 | 2 | assault2 | 8 |
| 4-6 | 3 | assault2+ranged1 | 10 |
| 7-9 | 3 | assault1+ranged1+saboteur1 | 12 |
| 10-12 | 4 | assault1+heavy1+ranged1+jammer1 | 14 |
| 13-15 | 4 | heavy1+ranged1+saboteur1+assault OR jammer1 | 16 |

These are initial composition candidates, not tested simultaneous rendering capacity.
No automatic fifth-wave boss. Major response windows stagger in solo; merely having
multiple enemies alive does not mean every enemy triggers a major mechanic together.
If sequential spawn used, its time counts in reference duration and clear waits for
scheduled spawns; no dead time artificially used to reach target minutes.

<a id="source-af672e8610564410-normalized-health-accounting"></a>
#### Normalized Health Accounting

For comparison ONLY assume interior pre-armor effective attack output100units/s
and exterior60units/s, each sustained on its own targets. Not assigned player DPS.
Ignore burst/overkill/heal/control gaps for this first budget. Enemy EHP measured
against that output includes mitigation: HP=EHP*(1-reduction) for simple armor-only
case. Never set rawHP=EHP then apply armor again and expect same clear time.

| Waves | Interior total EHP per wave | Exterior EHP per wave |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1-3 | 800 | 480 |
| 4-6 | 1000 | 600 |
| 7-9 | 1200 | 720 |
| 10-12 | 1400 | 840 |
| 13-15 | 1600 | 960 |

Both lanes concurrent: time approximately max(interiorEHP/interiorDPS,
exteriorEHP/exteriorDPS), NOT sum. Across15waves interior18000/exterior10800EHP,
each lane180s at assumed outputs,14gaps produce194s total reference. If a wave has
no required exterior enemy, omit that lane budget and let train's actual support
effects enter the interior model explicitly; no invisible target to consume damage.
At2x BOTH outputs ideal clear90s+14gaps=104s; one lane2x alone leaves other lane
as bottleneck. This reveals why support/cross-role skill design matters. No guarantee
of measured clear speed, damage formula or exact carry outcome from these examples.

<a id="source-af672e8610564410-allocation-and-counterplay"></a>
#### Allocation And Counterplay

Proposed health shares for3enemy sabotage wave: assault40/ranged35/saboteur25percent.
At1200EHP that is480/420/300. Lower saboteur health offers focus opportunity but must
be checked against actual target reach, windup, signal lead and burst availability.
Whole-team DPS100 would need3s for300EHP before overkill/travel; telegraph2s is NOT
automatically fair. Required initial-kit interrupt/protection is an alternative;
otherwise lengthen warning/reduceHP. Do not assert counterplay solely from names.
Heavy defense should trade HP/attack rather than quietly lengthen every encounter.
Enemy damage/attack frequency requires next survival budget and accepted healing
outputs; do not fill unspecified attack stats with guessed runtime defaults.

<a id="source-af672e8610564410-validation-gates"></a>
#### Validation Gates

Later simulate real initial5 kit/one selected ultimate/car configuration, no-down
vs recovery, no skills vs legal skills, weak entry and strong carry, single-lane
bottleneck, missed sabotage, and all15wave totals. Check no mandatory paid counter.
Only arithmetic run in Plan. No game engine, device, multiplayer or full economy
tests, no resources generated or assigned to Unity.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c"></a>
## Realtime Combat Implementation Design

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/realtime-combat-implementation-design-20260909.md`
