검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Design architecture local/remote adapters mutuallyexclusive, actor fields clocks/deadlines full snapshot; simultaneousbatch and3sretry oldsupersededlatersequential/fullCD candidate; no genericfullscreennopause override14. Lifecycle/renderpool/audio ownerrelease retained.

<!-- source-body:source-71831ab73bb3248c:start -->
<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-realtime-combat-implementation-design"></a>
### Realtime Combat Implementation Design

Status: DETAILED DESIGN ONLY. User requested implementation-level planning,
explicitly no Unity work while its separate work continues. No code, package,
scene, asset, deployment, migration or capture authorization from this document.
Accepted controls/health are linked below; new architecture/tuning is proposed.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-1-verified-source-and-important-differences"></a>
#### 1. Verified Source And Important Differences

Read on2026-09-09, not runtime-tested:

- Runtime unity-project/Assets/_LASTRAIL/Scripts/Battle/BattleSceneRoot.cs creates
  BattleSession and ticks via unscaledDeltaTime. It is not proof of assembled combat.
- BattleSession.cs registers IBattleSystem instances and forwards clock delta.
  Reuse composition boundary, not a second unrelated scene-wide event framework.
- Operators/OperatorDownRules.cs currently counts per wave,12s/25percent first,
  20s/20percent second, then WaveIncapacitated. NEW accepted trial6/9/12s,
  50percent recovery, attempt-wide count must replace this deliberately by mode/
  version, not coexist as two answers. Inspect all callers/tests before editing.
- Run/RunApiFlowFacade.cs and RunSnapshot.cs retain selected UltimateOperatorId
  and require it among squad members. Therefore preserve selected-ultimate concept
  pending actual kit audit. Skill/ultimate cues and images alone are not effects.
- Runtime server/docs/api/realtime-coop.md and apps/game-api/src/realtime-coop.ts
  exist. Documentation says first skeleton/local contract; unavailable binding
  fails closed. This is not verified live full skill simulation. Earlier September5
  plan saying no room authority is historical, not current absence evidence.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-2-authority-and-modes"></a>
#### 2. Authority And Modes

All modes: server owns authenticated entry, owned loadout validation, frozen rules,
reward/story/unlock/economy and final accepted result. Animation cannot grant.
World Raid solo AND coop: server owns live HP/time/mechanics/buffs/damage/score.
Two-player operations: same server room owns live combat; clients send intentions.
Solo story/ordinary currently has local RunRuntimeState/result-submit path. Do not
silently move it to online room or claim local results trusted. Preserve existing
server-validation contract until explicit solo simulation/validation review.
Design a single command/event presentation boundary with local-preview and remote
adapters. Local preview is test-only unless the existing solo contract accepts its
evidence. In server modes disable local authoritative damage/clock systems entirely.
Do not start both adapters. No peer host authority or offline World Raid scoring.

Architectural choice: data-driven small actor state machines + authoritative combat
model + presentation adapters. Avoid one MonoBehaviour per skill defining damage
and avoid animation/physics overlap as authoritative hit detection. No need for a
large behavior-tree framework for six behavior families unless complexity warrants.
Reuse existing clocks/transports/presenters after call-site audit. Proposed names
below are responsibilities, not claims of installed types.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-3-frozen-data"></a>
#### 3. Frozen Data

Encounter snapshot: attempt/mode/operation identifiers, rule and content versions,
server start/deadline, accepted squad/slots, train configuration and loadout hash.
Persist actual starting stats, not later-edited inventory as historical evidence.
Definitions: operator/skill/enemy IDs, allowed target classes, range/lane rules,
attack period, windup/impact/recovery offsets, cooldown, effect IDs, control tags,
interrupt policy, behavior profile and presentation asset keys. Missing IDs fail
validation before paid entry; no fallback damage/default elite ability.
Actor state: entity ID, side/role/slot, HP/maxHP, logical state, target/focus,
next attack time, cast ID/deadlines, cooldowns, effects, downCount/recovery deadline.
Events contain accepted sequence/eventID/tick, actor/target, effect/result and
presentation cue. Public DTO excludes secrets/private RNG state/hidden loot tables.
Runtime content and balance version compatibility checked before attempt begins;
new catalog rollout never reinterprets an active attempt.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-4-simulation-timing-and-ordering"></a>
#### 4. Simulation Timing And Ordering

Use integer simulation time/fixed-step or ordered deadlines, independent from render
FPS. Initial benchmark candidate50ms simulation step; not a network latency promise
or finalized production budget. Measure room CPU/load/mobile latency before freeze.
Each actor has independent deadlines, so actions overlap: no team turn or global
wait-until-animation-completes queue. Rendering interpolates separately.
Suggested same-tick order: attempt deadline gate; expire timed states/recover eligible
actors; validate queued commands; schedule eligible attacks; collect due effects;
resolve effect batch; down states; victory/failure; next-wave scheduling; publish.
Define boundary precisely: World Raid scoring accepts impacts strictly before end;
at end freeze once. Deduplicate accepted commands and cast/impact events.
Proposed simultaneous due-damage batch uses pre-batch eligibility to avoid entity-ID
last-hit advantage. Healing/shield/CC ordering requires explicit effect priority in
catalog; no dependence on dictionary enumeration or client arrival timestamp.
Proposed story mutual destruction (train0 and final boss0 same batch): failure
priority. This is NEW decision requiring acceptance, not existing server rule.
Continuous gameplay tick keeps room active: hibernation support does not mean active
combat is free or that timers advance while sleeping without catch-up design.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-5-input-pipeline"></a>
#### 5. Input Pipeline

Touch -> input intent -> role/ownership/current-state validation -> accepted cast/
focus event -> authoritative effects -> view update. Command has unique ID, attempt,
actor, action, optional target/area and observed revision. Client cost/damage ignored.
Stale observed revision alone need not reject a still-valid ordinary action; actual
target/cooldown/role eligibility controls. Duplicate command returns same outcome.
Aim preview local and immediate, cancel free before submission. Self skill submits
directly; targeted skill previews then confirms. Neither pauses time. Accepted cast
starts cooldown once. Invalid target rejected with reason and refreshed state.
After submission uncertainty use same command ID/reconcile, never manufacture a
second activation. Input buffering, if later enabled, bounded and explicitly shown;
no invisible unlimited queue of repeated taps.
Focus changes future attacks only. Committed projectile policy fixed at fire: no
free retarget when target disappears. Miss/despawn behavior is visible. Healers
follow ally rules despite enemy focus. Taunts apply only compatible skill tags.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-6-actor-state-machines"></a>
#### 6. Actor State Machines

Operators: Ready -> Windup -> EffectCommitted -> Recovery -> Ready.
Stun/interrupt can enter Disabled; HP0 enters DownWaiting then ProtectedReturn
then Ready. Distinguish disabled from dead/recovery. Animation states mirror, not
drive, model transitions. First6s/second9s/later12s attempt-wide accepted test values,
50percentHP and2s ordinary protection; cooldowns continue while down.
Enemy common states: Entering -> AcquireTarget -> Windup -> Impact -> Recovery.
Saboteur extends with Setup -> Channel/Pulse -> Cooldown; interrupt cancels future
pulses only. Accepted prior pulse is not undone. Ordinary units cannot invent train
sabotage when squad is down. Enemy families remain proposed pending catalog mapping.
Train: Operational / DisabledByEffect / Destroyed for ordinary-story, and separate
World Raid Recovery mode. Never reuse story destruction as World Raid early finish.
Skill interrupted before impact3s lock is still candidate, not accepted universal
refund. Multi-hit/summon/persistent effects require per-kit continuation policy.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-7-logical-space-and-visual-placement"></a>
#### 7. Logical Space And Visual Placement

Fixed allied3left/2right within LEFT interior region, enemy slots RIGHT. Maintain
logical slot IDs, normalized stage anchors and ground/contact points separate from
UI portrait coordinates. Front2/rear3 semantics proposal; roles not forced by slot.
No navigation mesh needed for stationary formation: lunge/return is render offset,
does not temporarily change reachability/taunt/slot unless skill explicitly says so.
Feet anchor stays on actual floor, transparent sprites use correct pivot/contact
shadow. Background perspective must fit anchors; no artificial floating platforms.
Upper moving exterior and lower interior stay visible, with separate health displays.
Object pools for actor visuals/projectiles/VFX; missing required assets block preload,
optional cosmetic misses use explicit logged fallback, never change combat stats.
No full roster loaded just because15 operators exist; load used squad/enemies/cues
through existing Addressables lifetime and release at safe scene exit.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-8-animation-vfx-and-audio"></a>
#### 8. Animation, VFX And Audio

Model AttackStarted drives windup animation. Impact event drives hit/HP/VFX once.
AnimationEvent may sync sound/visual cue, never calculate damage, rewards or score.
Use eventID dedup and bounded presentation buffer. Reconnect skips obsolete flashes,
restores current pose/cooldown instead of replaying entire battle history.
Character-specific timings map to common normalized event markers; art FPS cannot
increase attack rate. Hit reactions layer lightly and do not cancel normal action.
Only explicit CC changes logical action. Limit simultaneous heavy VFX and text;
critical mechanic warnings remain visible. No global hit-stop on real-time authority.
SFX/haptic cues come from presentation events with existing accessibility/settings.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-9-wave-pacing-proposal"></a>
#### 9. Wave Pacing Proposal

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-combat-audio-and-haptic-priority-proposal---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Combat Audio And Haptic Priority Proposal - 2026-09-09

Presentation design only, extending existing event-driven cues without generating
audio or changing combat timing. Existing clip availability/mix not audited here.

| Priority | Cue class | Policy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Highest | Current actionable mechanic warning | Distinguishable brief onset; temporarily lower BGM/routine impact mix |
| High | Confirmed major damage/down or critical state change | Short target/role-identifiable cue, never a perpetual loop per damage tick |
| Medium | Accepted ultimate/skill, successful interrupt | Distinct confirmation; not louder than warnings by default |
| Low | Ordinary hits, incidental movement, partner pings | Limit repeated overlap; may omit cosmetic playback under load |

Avoid inferring a new critical-HP threshold here: use authored/approved severity data
or leave that cue disabled. A requested skill is not an accepted cast; input tap may
sound as UI feedback but cannot play the success/impact sound before confirmation.
Deduplicate event delivery once across audio/visual/haptic. Suppressing a low-priority
sound is not suppressing its combat event, damage number accounting or accepted hit.

Use separate BGM, combat effects and partner-signal controls, plus independent
vibration enable/intensity where supported. A muted effects channel stays muted:
critical priority does not bypass user volume. Partner mute must not mute unmuted
mechanic cues. Core target/role/deadline information remains visible without sound
or vibration; stereo position alone cannot encode required action or lane.

Recommend no vibration for every basic attack, every HoT tick, each countdown digit
or repeated held touch. Use brief distinguishable patterns for warning onset, major
confirmed impact and selected ultimate confirmation. If several happen together,
prioritize one relevant pattern rather than queue a long vibration backlog. Pattern
duration/amplitude and concurrency limits require device tuning, not new constants
in the combat model. Do not assume all Android devices support amplitude control.

Warning priority lowers only presentation mix temporarily and restores current user
settings afterward, not a remembered value that overwrites a change made meanwhile.
Overlapping warning ducking must not repeatedly multiply volume toward silence or
restore early when another current warning still owns the mix priority. Cancelled
or expired warnings retire their cues; never replay them after reconnect.

On app background/audio interruption, stop optional effects/haptics and reconcile
foreground state without replaying missed impacts. This does not pause authoritative
combat or prevent damage. Combat presentation cannot seize audio output or force BGM
autoplay beyond the existing opt-in policy. Device audio-focus integration needs
implementation review separately; no SDK or native bridge change here.

Future QA: dense basic fire+warning, multiple warning events, repeated delivery,
interrupt/cancel, effects/BGM/partner mute combinations, mono output, vibration off,
unsupported vibration capabilities, volume change during ducking and background/
resume. No listening/device tests run. No new clips, mix settings or recording.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-combat-impact-presentation-detail---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Combat Impact Presentation Detail - 2026-09-09

Design extension to section8; no asset generation, runtime or capture work. Preserve
continuous real-time play and fixed grounded formation. No global freeze/slow motion.

| Event | Recommended presentation | Must not imply |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic impact | Short local spark/weapon contact, light additive recoil | New stagger, attack cancellation or critical hit |
| Active skill impact | Distinct source/target cue and stronger localized sound | Full-screen pause or earlier damage than accepted event |
| Selected ultimate | Brief actor emphasis and distinctive effect, both panes readable | Other actors/controls stop, immunity or all5 ultimates available |
| Shield absorbs hit | Shield ripple and remaining shield update | HP healing or ordinary shield countering World failure mechanic |
| Successful interrupt | End that warning/channel with one cancellation cue | Boss defeated, all threats canceled or automatic success buff |
| Actor down/return | Grounded down pose, return cue and current state | New HP grant beyond recovery policy or reset cooldown |

Suggested first visual-only timing ranges: basic contact cue80..120ms, additive
recoil100..160ms, ultimate portrait emphasis250..400ms. These are tuning candidates,
not cast duration, hitbox timing or delays added to simulation. Reduced-motion mode
can remove displacement/portrait motion while preserving hit/target/state cues.
Keep sound and vibration independently optional; no full-screen white flash required.

AttackStarted maps its authoritative windup/commit markers into the authored clip.
If attack speed changes, adapt presentation to the actual schedule; never change
the schedule to finish a clip. Trim/blend cosmetic recovery as needed without
canceling a logically started action. Cosmetic recoil cannot move logical slots,
feet contact baseline, hit targets or the range used for focus validation.

Late impact handling must not play a full overdue windup and then apply HP late.
Reconcile current HP/status from accepted state and use a bounded short cue only
while relevant; skip obsolete cosmetic events after reconnect. Deduplicate by event
identity before SFX/VFX/haptics, not separately with timers that merge distinct hits.
No animation callback may generate a second impact or apply reward/score.

At high density degrade presentation only: warning/target/health state first, then
major skill impacts, then routine numbers/particles. Never drop combat events or
delay authoritative damage to satisfy a VFX pool limit. Numeric merging, if later
adopted, must retain effect kind and accurate sum; no invented crit or multiplier.
Select camera-independent lane-local effects so exterior movement stays legible
while interior attacks occur. UI buttons and warning outlines do not shake.

Future inspection: accelerated basics, slow+windup, overlapping actors, missed or
duplicate impact events, shield-only hit, interruption, down during cast, late
snapshot and reduced-motion/audio-off. Confirm effect arrival against event trace
and actual device frames; no such tests or new video executed in this planning unit.

Ordinary15waves, no ready/confirm button per wave. Clear checks living blockers,
remaining scheduled spawns and outstanding objectives, not simply screen empty.
Candidate1s inter-wave transition with auto advance; no health/cooldown reset.
Long-duration player effects expire normally; old hostile events must be resolved/
cancelled by explicit encounter rules before new wave. No duplicate spawn on retry.
Draft progression:1-3simple assault,4-6ranged/guard pressure,7-9sabotage introduction,
10-12mixed interference,13-15final mixed pressure. Actual enemy IDs/counts/HP and
four operation-category rules remain open. Do not introduce new boss every fifth
wave or confuse wave15 with boss-only story raid. Kill speed can shorten duration;
no untested promise of fixed total minutes. Train0 ends ordinary/story.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-10-networking-and-result"></a>
#### 10. Networking And Result

Reuse existing authenticated command transport after schema review. Distinguish
command ACK from completed effect. Reliable event sequencing plus periodic state
snapshot/resync; bounded queues/backpressure, gap detection and old-connection fence.
Initial send-rate/buffer candidates must be benchmarked, not tied to render60FPS.
Disconnect freezes unauthorized input but not server time; restored snapshot rules
and accepted existing grace apply. No client TimeScale multiplayer fast-forward.
Terminal result sealed once; reward settlement separate idempotent server operation.
Unity result UI displays pending/rejected/confirmed honestly, never guesses reward.
Replay journal/checkpoints enough to restore authoritative attempt state without
duplicating effects; exact persistence cadence/cost and recovery guarantees remain
engineering gates. No token/account/raw combat payload logging in player UI.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-11-delivery-plan-after-separate-implementation-approval"></a>
#### 11. Delivery Plan After Separate Implementation Approval

1. Reconcile existing ability/ultimate/recovery catalogs and mode authority; approve
   unresolved simultaneous outcomes and interruption semantics.
2. Pure model tests with small deterministic fixtures, no real rewards.
3. Command/event adapter integrated into existing BattleSession composition;
   isolate presentation-only scene and verify model drives sprites, not vice versa.
4. One full15wave local accepted-contract run and boss-only case; all status/reset
   boundaries before broader content. No fake prototype claimed production.
5. Two authenticated local clients plus solo World Raid, same server state/result,
   simulated lag/reconnect/duplicate/out-of-order input. No remote deployment implied.
6. Full initial5/all approved operator kit coverage, then device readability and
   performance; only afterward tutorial based on verified controls.

<a id="source-71831ab73bb3248c-12-acceptance-matrix-not-executed"></a>
#### 12. Acceptance Matrix (Not Executed)

- Concurrent actors keep acting during aim/cast; no turn barrier.
- Frame rate30/60 and dropped visual frames do not change authoritative hit count.
- Focus/dead target/taunt/range exceptions, duplicate cast and uncertain response.
- Down count across15waves; recovery at deadline; five down without extra timer.
- Sabotage setup interruption, pulse dedup, no accidental operator+train double hit.
- Simultaneous lethal outcomes under explicit policy; no settlement twice.
- World Raid finite deadline/infiniteHP, solo/two-player equal authority, late hits.
- Version-pinned kits, missing assets, schema rejection and role command permissions.
- Network restoration no duplicate SFX/grants or clock rewind; no raw secret logs.
- Profiling on target Android for memory/GC/frame time/thermal/network, not estimates.

Related approved/draft source docs: combat-control-detail-proposal-20260909.md,
combat-skill-control-proposal-20260909.md, combat-health-recovery-proposal-20260909.md,
enemy-targeting-sabotage-proposal-20260909.md, online-coop-mode-policy.md,
world-raid-rules.md. Later04KST calendar rule supersedes historical05KST text only
after deliberate source reconciliation; this design does not change calendars.

<!-- source-body:source-71831ab73bb3248c:end -->


<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692"></a>
## Start Augment And Tactic Package Detail

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/start-package-selection-detail-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `9eb69b915fdbbc6846074d25bd2c62204d230058b689f4d30af362d795aba927`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Legacy3category+1tactic fullstart no midwave/no rerolls supersededrandommap3cards; NOT40pool. Preserve oldaccepted package refs/START bytes andtyped damage≠ATK heal/once/modifier version no retroactive rewrite.

<!-- source-body:source-2aaef02671c23692:start -->
<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-start-augment-and-tactic-package-detail"></a>
### Start Augment And Tactic Package Detail

2026-09-09 Plan. PROPOSED contents/selection counts; no implementation or live
catalog claim. Source E:/Projects/LASTRAIL/server/docs/api/run-start-augment-package.md.
Ordinary AND story raid start with the authored full package. The old3/6/9/12/15
mid-wave choice checkpoints are explicitly backlog in that contract.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-what-is-known-and-what-is-proposed"></a>
#### What Is Known And What Is Proposed

Verified document refs: startAugmentPackageRef/startTacticPackageRef, example
act1_full_start_package_v1. These refs and finish-echo examples do NOT specify a
complete effect catalog or chosen-slot count. Example augment_rail_bulwark and
tactic_cover_fire found in contracts/tests are not evidence of final magnitudes.
Unity TacticPoolResolver contains older conditional ultimate offering; do not use
that to make selected base ultimate unavailable under the newer combat proposal.
Source scope local docs/selected classes, not complete deployed owner audit.

Recommend one compact pre-departure package: THREE augment choices plus ONE tactic
choice, all effects active from the first wave/boss start. Three category slots
make choice legible without a lengthy draft. This is a NEW design recommendation,
not recovered history or a claim equivalent in strength to fifteen waves of rewards.
All proposed keys below are design-only and must not be submitted to live APIs.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-augment-choices"></a>
#### Augment Choices

Choose exactly one of two per category, no duplicate selection of the same category.
All options available through approved package, not owned/gacha items. No reroll
cost, random offer, paid slot, new inventory or permanent stat grant.

| Category | Design key | Effect for this attempt |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Squad | proposal_aug_squad_fire | Operator damage +8% |
| Squad | proposal_aug_squad_guard | Operator maxHP +8% |
| Train | proposal_aug_train_fire | Locomotive/Gun damage +8%, including support fire |
| Train | proposal_aug_train_guard | Train/carriage maxHP +8% |
| Support | proposal_aug_field_medicine | Operator/Medical healing +10%, excludes train repair |
| Support | proposal_aug_barrier_support | Operator/train shields issued +10% |

Damage effect does not boost healing because skill heals use ATK; it modifies
damage output only, not the baseATK stat. TrainFire excludes Combat interior
device to keep its scope clear. HP augmentation resolves before initialHP assignment;
it is not a heal that can be toggled during battle. Removal/reconnect cannot refill.
Healing and shield bonuses apply once per effect and obey existing target caps.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-one-tactic-choice"></a>
#### One Tactic Choice

| Design key | Effect | Explicit exclusions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| proposal_tactic_precision | Single-target operator ACTIVE skill damage +12% | No basics, AOE, burn ticks or ultimate |
| proposal_tactic_signal | Operator-applied mark duration +2s, cap12s | No stronger mark, new mark, ordinary armor break or boss immunity bypass |
| proposal_tactic_finisher | Selected ultimate damage/heal/shield/repair magnitude +12% | No cooldown reduction, extra use, status-duration or buff-strength increase |

Do not infer single-target by current number of enemies hit: authored target class
must be single-target. An AOE hitting only boss is still AOE. Precision affects
direct damage, not attaching a second multiplier to its burn/mark.
Finisher does not buff Mira's train-damage buff percentage, Signal runner's
train-damage buff, or Lumen's outgoing buff; those kits have no eligible magnitude
and option should be disabled with reason for those selections where appropriate.
Mira repair and Lumen cleanse-plus-buff ultimate must be evaluated effect-wise:
Mira has repair eligible; Lumen has no eligible magnitude. Validate against actual
selected-ultimate kit, not operator rarity. Signal and Precision likewise require
at least one compatible selected squad effect. Never offer a paid or useless pick.

If a whole choice category has no eligible option under a future catalog, reject
that package/loadout combination in preparation with corrective options. Do not
silently grant a substitute effect. Current initial-five lineup has valid options.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-defaults-and-selection-ux"></a>
#### Defaults And Selection UX

Initial proposed preset: SquadGuard + TrainFire + FieldMedicine + Precision.
Eve selected ultimate stays the simulation baseline. Preset is visible/editable,
not a surprise server choice. Before first use show the four effects and confirm
with the existing departure command; no extra forced tutorial or second currency.
Later retain player's preferred IDs as selection preference only, revalidate them
against new package/loadout each time. Do not treat local preference as entitlement.

Change selected ultimate or squad -> recompute eligible tactic, clear invalid pick
with explanation, require replacement before start. No automatic rare-operator
purchase prompt. Party ready state clears when any choice/loadout changes.
Solo chooses all four. Coop proposal: squad player owns Squad augment + tactic,
train player owns Train + Support augments. Both view and confirm combined package;
each category still one choice, never four per player. This role division is new
and requires contract review; no host override or autonomous timeout selection.

No draft window in battle. At start all chosen effects active; no wave reset,
second roll or rank increase at bossphase. Ending attempt removes run-only effects.
Ordinary and story raid use the SAME cardinality/rules; raid does not get another
copy because refs appear in both augment and tactic fields.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-selection-screen-detail---2026-09-09"></a>
#### Selection Screen Detail - 2026-09-09

This refines the proposed3augment+1tactic structure, not approval of numeric balance
or a new implementation order. Render only an actual supported authored package;
do not assume this same catalog is automatically available in World Raid.

Use four labeled unframed sections: Squad, Train, Support, Tactic. Each section
shows selected choice plus eligible alternatives with a single-choice radio/checked
state. No rarity glow, random-card reveal, reroll or timer; this is deliberate
preparation, not a recruitment draw. Summary shows selected count and missing
category; don't use level-up language for temporary run-only effects.

Every option has short effect wording, affected actors/effect type and exclusions
in expandable detail. Important exclusions remain available without hover on mobile.
Selecting one clears only the prior selection in that category. Opening details
does not select or clear shared readiness. Apply actual accepted choice changes
through current preparation revision and reset ready as already specified.

Examples of semantic copy, not new localization IDs or final published strings:
- Squad damage increase is NOT base ATK increase and cannot imply stronger healing.
- Train fire states locomotive/Gun scope; does not imply all interior device damage.
- Healing support excludes train repair; shield support increases issued shield,
  not permanent armor or guaranteed actual absorption.
- Precision states single-target active damage, not basic attack/ultimate damage.
- Signal extends an existing applicable mark; it never grants a missing mark skill.
- Finisher improves eligible magnitude of the selected ultimate, not its cooldown,
  extra activation or a pure buff percentage.

Highlight compatible current squad/ultimate icons from validated effect metadata,
not from rarity or guessed name matches. If no compatible effect, show disabled
choice with specific reason. If compatibility data is unavailable, show checking/
unavailable rather than asserting the option is useless or silently allowing it.
No fictional DPS uplift, combat-power target or purchase advice required here.

Change squad/ultimate: retain valid choices, invalidate only incompatible choice,
focus missing category before Ready/Depart. A remembered preference is not an
entitlement; catalog version change requires validation. Do not hide changed effects
behind the same old label. If no legal option exists in a required category, block
with a configuration reason and corrective path, not an invented substitute.

At the bottom show one compact package summary before departure, not a new forced
confirmation modal per category. Existing departure/ready confirms the complete
current selection. Coop uses prior proposed category ownership and partner read-only
choices; never four choices each or host override. No selection countdown/autopick.

Future checks: no compatible mark, pure-buff ultimate, selected ultimate removal,
valid unrelated selections preserved, duplicate category, stale package response,
long labels and noneditable partner category. Not executed. Policy reads and
document/handoff readback only; local uncommitted, no runtime/art/video/deploy.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-existing-stacking-and-formula"></a>
#### Existing Stacking And Formula

Separate persistent growth/gear/research, frozen runHP modifiers, and timed combat
modifiers. RunHP from this package max8% per applicable entity. It is a separate
run-only bucket, not the persistent20% catalog guard. Apply before finalfloor:
maxHP=floor(base*growth*persistentFactor*1.08). No intermediate repeated rounding.
At Kyle L1 unmodified1400 becomes1512; train5000 becomes5400 if TrainGuard chosen.

Damage augments/tactics enter existing additive outgoing30% capped bucket alongside
conditional damage passives/temporary buffs. Example eligible Precision hit with
SquadFire8% and Precision12% =+20%, not1.08*1.12. Finisher12% plus SquadFire8%
likewise20% for eligible ultimate damage; Precision never adds to ultimate.
Mark multiplier remains separate strongest-slot20% and world mechanic bonus separate.
No extra multiplication of score after damage. World package availability itself
requires separate world event definition, not automatically enabled here.

For heal/shield/repair magnitudes: additive eligible passive+support+finisher
bonuses, proposed category cap30%, then existing target/effect caps. Skill-rank
magnitude remains its separate multiplier. E.g. Eve kit1 active:28*7*(1+.10+.10)
=235.2 ->235 heal before missingHP; not28*7*1.1*1.1. Repair excludes FieldMedicine,
retains Mira passive/eligibleFinisher, capped15%trainHP per effect after modifiers.
Signal changes mark duration only, strongest-source mark rules remain; applying
weaker mark cannot lengthen stronger mark through this tactic.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-start-contract-gap"></a>
#### Start Contract Gap

Existing documented POST runs/start accepts operationPreviewId only; it does not
prove the complete selection choices are validated/pinned before combat. Finish
echo is insufficient for live authoritative damage if choices are only known at end.
Required future design: validate selections as part of server-authored preview
preparation, freeze chosen IDs+packageVersion when starting, and finish only echoes.
Exact endpoint/schema must be owned by Server; do not add undocumented fields to
current start or invent a working preview-mutation route here. If unavailable,
package integration BLOCKED, not client-authoritative fallback.

Preview revalidation covers category counts, eligibility, allowedIDs, actor ownership,
version and unchanged readiness. Invalid selection rejects before entry spending.
Same start replay preserves package/version; new event version cannot change an
active attempt. Admin may display selected IDs/version read-only, no edit/repair.

<a id="source-2aaef02671c23692-simulation-and-evidence"></a>
#### Simulation And Evidence

Compare no-package stripped model vs default vs damage-focused vs survival-focused,
clearly label stripped model non-release. No-package previous158/198.5s estimates
cannot serve as complete start-package balance claims. Effects may further shorten
clear time; do not immediately inflate enemyHP without measuring actual casts.

Verify three category choices/one tactic, duplicate-ref application once, no effect
on inventory/rewards, compatibility change, caps before/after buffs, derived healing,
sameboss AOE, rejected preview without cost, start replay and version freeze.
This unit used source review and effect arithmetic only; no runtime/API/simulation/
device tests, code edits, video or deployment. All effect IDs/counts new proposals.
Next consolidate all approved-versus-proposed combat rows and integration gaps into
one implementation-readiness checklist before assigning or claiming full simulation.

<!-- source-body:source-2aaef02671c23692:end -->

## Story Boss Warning Mapping V1

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/story-boss-warning-mapping-v1.md`

검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: 전투/작전 교차분야 상세 계약. 구형15wave/start package와 새 노드정책은 프로토콜 이행 대조 필요

<!-- source-body:source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd:start -->
<a id="source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd-story-boss-warning-mapping-v1"></a>
### Story Boss Warning Mapping V1

2026-09-09 / Plan / design-only mapping of story-raid-boss-rotation-v1.md.
The previous warning UI direction is accepted for further design following user
go-ahead. This does not approve runtime implementation or every pending tuning value.

| Existing pattern | Target marker | Valid response guidance | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A Impact ram | Train durability and exterior source | Available train barrier before hit; explicit interrupt such as Sera before commit | One train hit or interrupted action; repair is recovery AFTER damage |
| B Boarding sweep | Exact up to2 marked living operator slots | Kyle shield if it covers marked allies, compatible selected ultimate if ready, or explicit interrupt | Each marked target resolves once; heal follows damage, no train damage copy |
| C Coupler overload | Train plus overload source, remaining pulse count | Interrupt warning/channel; train barrier mitigates remaining pulses | Already applied damage stays; interrupt cancels future pulses only |

All three preserve the existing full4s warning and A/B/C rotation candidate. No
new damage numbers, action buttons, simultaneous targeting or world35% penalty.
First special cannot require the ultimate that is not yet ready. Available counters
are alternatives, not a promise that every cooldown will be ready each occurrence.

<a id="source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd-dynamic-guidance"></a>
#### Dynamic Guidance

- Warning always names threat/target; optional action hints use actual selected kit,
  usable cooldown and compatible effect. Never advertise an unowned recruit or
  unselected ultimate as a required answer. When none is available, retain warning
  without a fake counter button; imperfect defense remains ordinary damage.
- Shield applicability is checked per target. A shield reducing damage is not the
  same as interrupting the attack. Healing/repair is not retroactive prevention.
- A boss immune to stun is not interrupted by a stun-only skill. Use explicit
  interrupt capability, not icon similarity or a generic control category.
- If marked B target goes down before the hit, do not silently redirect its hit.
  If no eligible target exists when scheduling B, follow the source skip rule.
- A C pulse counter advances from resolved events. Late/replayed network events
  cannot recreate damage, restore cancelled pulses or restart the warning timer.
- Interrupt text is neutral cancellation, not world mechanic success/buff. Boss
  defeated ends pending attacks through existing terminal ordering.

<a id="source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd-authoring-record-proposal"></a>
#### Authoring Record Proposal

Each pattern needs stable identity/version, encounter mode, source entity, exact
target identities, warning/deadline, explicit supported response capabilities,
resolution type, pulse state when relevant and localized string references.
These are semantic requirements, not an existing endpoint/schema. UI observes
authoritative state where applicable; it does not adjudicate combat outcomes.

World patterns remain separately illustrative until boss-specific task authoring:
pressure relief/anchor release, interception/device defense, exposed weakness.
Do not represent those examples as already implemented playable tasks. Shared-buff
and35% penalty rules do not migrate into this story mapping.

<a id="source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd-verification-and-next"></a>
#### Verification And Next

Compared existing story rotation, world rules and warning UI text; documentation
readback only. No simulation, runtime tests, builds, video, deploy or owner order.
Local/uncommitted. Next validate initial-five response availability across the
authored rotation before adding additional mechanics or asserting balance complete.

<!-- source-body:source-6ac415f6ce5a94cd:end -->


<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1"></a>
## Chapter 1 Story Boss Rotation

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/story-raid-boss-rotation-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `04ec3e5bba738b45bbd31e2847d3de6e36fff4d56572940d6da783f77bbc837d`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: 전투/작전 교차분야 상세 계약. 구형15wave/start package와 새 노드정책은 프로토콜 이행 대조 필요

<!-- source-body:source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1:start -->
<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-chapter-1-story-boss-rotation"></a>
### Chapter 1 Story Boss Rotation

2026-09-09 Plan. DETAILED TEST PROPOSAL, no implementation or launch balance claim.
IDs: raid_raider_king_engine / boss_raider_king_engine. Sources: existing raid
dialogue, chapter1-encounter-curve-v1 and current combat/input/health proposals.
FiniteHP boss-only SOLO encounter,5operators. Not World Raid, no score/ranking,
adds,15waves or hidden time-limit failure introduced.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-reference-and-win-condition"></a>
#### Reference And Win Condition

Reference initial5 L30/P0/kit2, train6, default4; equipment/research off.
Boss candidate24000HP, armor15%, basic120 every2.5s, windup700ms. HP36000/48000
are later comparison cases only. Outcome: bossHP0 with surviving train = victory;
train0 = failure. Same-tick mutual destruction failure remains a proposed tie rule,
not verified existing server behavior. Rewards/refund exclusively existing server
settlement; visual boss defeat never grants an item or marks story progress itself.

No core-overheat instant-loss gauge inferred from narrative urgency. Existing
dialogue about stopping the engine must not accidentally create an unannounced
timer. No guaranteed stamina refund toast before accepted server result.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-one-boss-two-presentation-targets"></a>
#### One Boss, Two Presentation Targets

Propose one authoritative entity/HP with exterior engine and interior boarding-
apparatus target proxies. Interior apparatus art is a presentation requirement,
NOT a second enemy/HP pool or a claim an approved new illustration exists.
The interior proxy permits fixed-position melee and ranged basic/skill attacks;
exterior proxy permits train/Gun fire. Both resolve to the same boss entity.
No basic damage transfer multiplier between proxies; one action/effect can hit
the boss ONCE, even if an area touches both. A target group3 finds only one boss.
Mark, armor break, burn and death belong to shared entity, not separately stackable
per proxy. The view cannot create damage from two collider callbacks.

Keep existing narrative 'braking apparatus' language. Do not require attacking
fuel core while dialogue says not to. Any new boarding-apparatus appearance needs
Direction review later; this document does not invent another named character.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-phase-rules"></a>
#### Phase Rules

| Phase | HP interval | Normal damage factor | Basic speed bonus |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | >60% | 1.00 | 0% |
| 2 | >30% and <=60% | 1.10 | 10% |
| 3 | >0 and <=30% | 1.20 | 20% |

Phase never heals or resets cooldowns/down counts. Threshold crossing updates
next newly committed action, not an already telegraphed attack's damage/targets.
Capture phase modifier at warning/basic windup start for predictable warnings;
normal target armor/shield still resolves at impact. If burst crosses two thresholds,
enter final applicable phase once, no stacked phase attacks/cutscene queue.
No unattackable transition, speed/time pause or surprise extra hit. Existing
armor/broadcast collapse narrative beats are visual cues, not automatic armor0.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-repeating-three-action-rotation"></a>
#### Repeating Three-Action Rotation

Period14s per special occurrence, full4s warning. Relative to boss targetableAt,
nominal impacts14/28/42/56... alternate A/B/C/A... phase does not restart sequence.
One boss action at a time. During warning/channel, basic attacks pause; no catch-up
hits afterward. Finish any already committed basic and recovery before starting
warning; if delayed keep full4s and record actual times, never squeeze warning.
Next nominal schedule remains anchored; cannot overlap previous channel/recovery.

| Pattern | Target fixed at warning | Base effect | Counter without recruitment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A Impact ram | Train | One240 ordinary hit | Train barrier, Sera interrupt before commit, repair afterward |
| B Boarding sweep | Up to2 living front allies, fallback rear | One180 ordinary hit per marked ally | Kyle shield/available ultimate, Eve heal after, Sera interrupt |
| C Coupler overload | Train | Four60 ordinary pulses,1s apart | Interrupt before/during channel, barrier remaining pulses, repair |

These B/C patterns are new alternatives to the prior single240train-hit template,
not additional simultaneous attacks stacked onto it. Base ATK120 remains train-
targeted. Phase factors multiply pattern damage once: A240/264/288; B180/198/216;
C total240/264/288, allocated4 pulses60/66/72. No world35%maxHP penalty here.
Two marked B targets each receive the coefficient; do not also apply it to train.

If no living allies exist for B warning, skip that occurrence; no fallback to
train and no free success buff. If one marked ally becomes down before commit,
that target's hit is lost, never redirects without warning. A/C require train
alive or battle already ends. Incoming damage protection follows ordinary rules.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-interruption-and-fairness"></a>
#### Interruption And Fairness

Boss immune to stun/taunt movement/control; explicitly interruptible Telegraph and
C Channel remain interruptible. Sera/Vex/Signal runner interrupt effects qualify;
Rail stun does not silently become an interrupt against immunity. Damage/mark alone
does not interrupt. Boss kill cancels remaining uncommitted pulses/actions.
Interrupting a special consumes that occurrence; no immediate retry or revenge hit.
Next scheduled special continues, so a cooldown cannot permanently lock the boss.

Sera16sCD versus14s special period means she cannot counter every warning alone.
Barrier30s, Kyle18s, Eve20s, Mira22s are alternatives across successive patterns,
not promises all are ready simultaneously. Initial-five passive healing is not a
mandatory cleanse. Imperfect defense causes ordinary recoverable damage, not
instant wipe/fullHP lethal. Recovery retains previously defined individual timers.
No pattern requires dragging units, two simultaneous pane touches, a second player,
or owning a rare/elite from recruitment.

Selected ultimate remains one-of-five; first ready15s. First special at14s cannot
require ultimate. Kyle active/train barrier/Sera active are available alternatives.
No phase mechanic resets15s first-ready to grant another free ultimate.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-presentation-and-input"></a>
#### Presentation And Input

Warn with icon/target highlight/countdown; A train, B exact ally slots, C coupler
channel/pulse count. Reuse existing short callout style; copy below is proposal,
not a registered localization string or frozen dialogue replacement:
- A: "열차 충돌 경고"
- B: "표시된 요원 방어"
- C: "연결 장치 과부하"

Cancel event visibly ends telegraph; it is not a victory animation. Dangerous cue
priority exceeds flavor dialogue. No blackout/hitstop that freezes actual timing.
Allow both panes to show same bossHP but no duplicate damage numbers from proxies.
Large skill/VFX must not obscure selected target or controls; new asset work requires
separate scope. Ultimate cut-in does not prevent other actors from continuing.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-worked-damage-and-timing"></a>
#### Worked Damage And Timing

Reference train7000HP/10%armor: unshielded A phase1 loses216HP, phase3 floor288*.9
=259HP. Train barrier560 can absorb either one. This is per-hit arithmetic, NOT
evidence whole fight is dangerous enough; basic fire/repair/other timing matters.
Reference C phase1 four60 pulses ->54 each after armor if no shields. Interrupt
after two leaves108 accepted HP damage, not a refund. C phase3 raw72 each ->64
after armor, total256, different from flooring whole288*.9 once. This intentional
per-hit rule must be declared; no concealment of pulse-rounding difference.

With exact nominal schedule: C warning38..42, pulses43/44/45/46. Interrupt44.05
cancels45/46 only; next A nominal56 remains. Phase changes during C do not raise
the already warned pulse damage. Timing is relative to targetableAt, not video0.

<a id="source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1-verification-and-next-design"></a>
#### Verification And Next Design

Plan arithmetic/source checks only, no event simulation or runtime test. Cases:
proxy dedup/AOE onehit, phase skip/noheal, delayed fullwarning, firstultimate unavailable,
interrupt cooldown gaps, C partialcancel, B invalidtarget, all5down, incoming
protection, same-tick terminal priority and one accepted reward request.
Test sustain-heavy near-invulnerability; these relatively small hits vs7000HP may
be too weak. Do not announce balance based on ability to survive alone.
Next compare actual initial-five damage/sustain against this schedule in an approved
simulation slice. Before implementation, confirm target-proxy visual/contract and
story result tie policy. No endless new mechanics needed to begin that comparison.

<!-- source-body:source-8021dbaf7a2b74d1:end -->


<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72"></a>
## Unified Train Combat Test Profile

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/train-combat-test-profile-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `c30c4cbb07ff01d6315bfb5d7213b520da49af70ef9651716776680b37045fcf`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Explicit proposal_train_combat_v1 train5000..8600/10%/6%output vslegacy3000..4080 no stacking; engine65..95 speedonly; selected CE03localsubset adoptedlater105 notrelease. Callerownership rankseparate.

<!-- source-body:source-836281eb9f35fa72:start -->
<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-unified-train-combat-test-profile"></a>
### Unified Train Combat Test Profile

2026-09-09, Plan. RECOMMENDED TEST PROFILE, not approved production balance.
Profile key: proposal_train_combat_v1. Design only; no code/config activation.
Sources: combat-stats-v1, train-loadout-speed-detail-v1, equipment-research-
progression-v1 and inspected Unity TrainCoreDefinition/RunStartSnapshotBuilder.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-decision-for-the-first-simulation"></a>
#### Decision For The First Simulation

Recommend the coherent NEW combat-stat profile: trainHP5000 at1, constant10%
armor, output+6% per level, HP+8% per level. Reuse verified engine output65..95
for speed only. This lets the already-authored skill/device formulas run without
inventing where legacy bonus fields are applied. It is a conscious candidate,
not proof5000 is better than3000 or authorization to rewrite deployed accounts.

Alternative retained for sensitivity: separate legacy-derived HP3000..4080 profile.
It is not a validated legacy runtime replica until base armor/fire-control consumers
are found. Never label a guessed application of those bonuses current gameplay.

Scoped Scripts search found ArmorBonusRatio/FireControlBonusRatio declarations
but no consumers. RunStartSnapshotBuilder accepts engineOutput and freezes speed;
that call is not evidence that the legacy HP/armor/fire-control table is applied.
It also validates using trainCarSlots.Count as unlockedSlotCount; that checks
composition but does not prove server entitlement or actual unlocked slot limit.
Server admission must separately validate those fields. No code fix made here.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-level-table-no-equipment-or-research"></a>
#### Level Table, No Equipment Or Research

HP =5000*(1+0.08*(level-1)); ATK=floor(60*(1+0.06*(level-1))).
No compounding per level, no extra legacy armor/fire-control bonus.

| Level | Train maxHP | Armor | Locomotive ATK /1s | Engine output |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 5000 | 10% | 60 | 65 |
| 2 | 5400 | 10% | 63 | 68 |
| 3 | 5800 | 10% | 67 | 72 |
| 4 | 6200 | 10% | 70 | 75 |
| 5 | 6600 | 10% | 74 | 78 |
| 6 | 7000 | 10% | 78 | 82 |
| 7 | 7400 | 10% | 81 | 86 |
| 8 | 7800 | 10% | 85 | 89 |
| 9 | 8200 | 10% | 88 | 92 |
| 10 | 8600 | 10% | 92 | 95 |

Engine output is NOT weaponATK or fire-control multiplier. Train speed is NOT
attack speed. Weight remains30 plus equipped car weights. A level upgrade affects
next attempt snapshot, never immediately heals or recalculates an active run.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-carriage-and-device-scaling"></a>
#### Carriage And Device Scaling

Each carriage maxHP=floor(its baseHP*(1+0.08*(level-1))). Keep its own armor from
CarriageDurabilityCatalog; do not add locomotive10% to every carriage.
Device raw output=floor(baseAmount*(1+0.06*(level-1))). Intervals/durations fixed.

| Device | Base amount | Level10 amount | Interval |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Combat hit | 24 | 36 | 1.6s |
| Gun hit | 40 | 61 | 2s |
| Medical heal | 80 | 123 | 8s |
| Defense shield | 150 | 231 | 10s, lasts6s |
| Cargo weapon speed | 10% | 10% | 12s, lasts6s |

Amounts at level10 are before optional gear. No direct scaling of Cargo percent,
shield duration, target count or cooldown. Disabled-car device does not pulse.
Level10 default2 exterior pre-armorDPS92+61/2=122.5, not multiplying level1 output
by1.54 again after the table has already resolved it.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-manual-commands-and-cross-role-repair"></a>
#### Manual Commands And Cross-Role Repair

Support fire coefficient4x resolved locomotiveATK,25s cooldown; barrier8% trainHP
for6s,30s cooldown; emergency repair8% trainHP,30s cooldown. No new charges/MP.
At1: support240, barrier400, repair400. At10: support368, barrier688, repair688.
No legacy fire-control or device growth applied again to these derived magnitudes.

Mira active repair uses target trainmaxHP5% and caster kit rank/passive. At kit1,
passive+10% gives275 at train1 or473 at train10, before missingHP clamp. Thus
Mira+manual ideal healing ceiling25.833HP/s at1 or44.433HP/s at10. These are
continuous-use ceilings, not actual effective healing under target availability.
Do not import the train owner's kit rank onto Mira; she belongs to squad owner.
HP-based rank/passive repair cap15% targetmaxHP per effect remains after scaling.

Direct train damage resolves10%armor then train shield. Carriage HP loss transfers
30% once without second armor/shield, per current candidate; operators never
transfer damage to train. Disabling a carriage does not reduce trainmaxHP or
deduct the carriage's full remaining capacity from train a second time.
Ordinary/story train0 is failure. World mode keeps its separate recovery rules.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-optional-persistent-modifiers"></a>
#### Optional Persistent Modifiers

Baseline has equipment/research OFF. For isolated candidate gear tests only:
HP multiplier bucket hull+railResearch up to17% from current proposals, applied
before final floor. Main-gun12% affects locomotive/Gun, not another universal
output factor. Medical12% affects Medical only. Gear speed4% is weapon cadence,
not rail speed. Do not double count faction/partner-account bonuses.
At train10, hull12%+research5% gives10062HP. Main-gun12% yields103 locomotiveATK
from60*1.54*1.12 floored once, not floor92 times1.12 with an extra intermediate
rounding rule. Preserve precision until all persistent stats resolve.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-version-and-ui-contract"></a>
#### Version And UI Contract

One attempt pins one trainStatProfileVersion with its balanceVersion/loadout.
Definition contributes trainlevel, source IDs, resolvedHP/armor/ATK/engine/weight/
speed and device outputs. Server owns validation and source ownership; UI shows
the accepted results and next-level preview supplied through approved contracts.
Do not add a real API field solely because this document names its responsibility.

Player-facing sheet distinguishes durability, armor, weapon attack and rail speed;
do not call all of them combat power. Next-level preview shows changed and unchanged
values accurately. No purchase promise for a stat discarded by a cap. Training
cost table remains launch-economy-v1; no compensation/migration/release action here.

<a id="source-836281eb9f35fa72-acceptance-and-outstanding-work"></a>
#### Acceptance And Outstanding Work

Verify level1/10 and each table row, no double fire-control, armor once, no partner
duplicate contribution, gear before finalfloor, speed threshold exactness, no
midrun upgrade heal, full/empty shields and repair at missingHP0. Test default2
before alternative devices whose entitlements are not verified.

Actual verification in this unit: source reads and exact integer table arithmetic
only. No simulation, runtime/device tests or deployment. Candidate choice is now
explicit for the first future simulation; production adoption remains gated by
event survival/output results and owner contract review.
Next: operation-specific encounter progression and pacing, using this single
candidate rather than mixing legacy/current numbers. Chapter2/3 IDs not invented.

<!-- source-body:source-836281eb9f35fa72:end -->


<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed"></a>
## Train Loadout, Weight And Speed Detail

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/train-loadout-speed-detail-v1.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `1285dd79cbb8698225ce9dd52561132facb0f1c59166511c701d0eb77bcd97cf`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Historical local2/3/4slotcount notfullownership; actual114 rejects nightwithoutwater/Medical; optionalpurchase600/1200/1000/1200 unapproved not13rungear; pressurecalc noverifiedconsumer; speed1.35oldvsnew1.3proposal needsversion.

<!-- source-body:source-d229e22a21c017ed:start -->
<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-train-loadout-weight-and-speed-detail"></a>
### Train Loadout, Weight And Speed Detail

2026-09-09 Plan, design/source audit only. No runtime change or unlock approval.
This resolves some simulation fixture unknowns and records a newly discovered
legacy-vs-proposal stat conflict. It does not certify Server or deployed behavior.

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-verified-local-sources"></a>
#### Verified Local Sources

Inspected E:/Projects/LASTRAIL/unity-project/Assets/_LASTRAIL/Scripts/Train:
CarriageLoadoutRules, ActOneTrainCarUnlockRules, TrainWeightCalculator,
TrainSpeedCalculator, TrainSpeedControlCalculator, PursuitPressureCalculator,
TrainCoreCatalog and TrainCoreDefinition. Scoped Scripts search found speed use
in Run/RunStartSnapshotBuilder.cs and default-loadout use there. No pressure caller
found in that search other than its definition; not a whole-product absence claim.

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-slot-and-default-rules-found-in-code"></a>
#### Slot And Default Rules Found In Code

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-fresh-source-readback---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Fresh Source Readback - 2026-09-09

Plan reread E:/Projects/LASTRAIL/unity-project/Assets/_LASTRAIL/Scripts/Train/
ActOneTrainCarUnlockRules.cs and CarriageLoadoutRules.cs. The former still returns
Combat+Gun by default, adds Cargo after water-stop, and returns all4 including
Defense after night-boarders. The latter validates count and per-type maxima, not
account ownership or instance IDs. No runtime execution or remote verification.

Consequently pin PRE-entry fixtures: missions1..3 use2 defaults; missions4..5 use3;
mission6/story raid use4 only after accepted relevant progression. This agrees with
chapter1-encounter-curve-v1.md, not a new grant. The water-stop attempt cannot depend
on its own Cargo unlock; night-boarders cannot depend on its own Defense unlock.
Lowest-tier initial-five requirement uses growth available before that attempt.

First ordinary simulation can isolate authored mechanics under explicitly labeled
local fixture assumptions. It cannot demonstrate actual server admission/ownership
without the corresponding server contract. Medical and second-instance variants
remain conditional; this readback did not find or exhaustively search their grants.

| Completed operation evidence | Slots | Default IDs |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Neither milestone | 2 | car_combat, car_gun |
| opn_03_water_stop | 3 | car_combat, car_gun, car_cargo |
| opn_05_night_boarders | 4 | car_combat, car_gun, car_cargo, car_defense |

The local function prioritizes night-boarders evidence even if water-stop is
absent. Do not infer this makes an inconsistent server story history legitimate.
Server progress/admission must own the actual entitlement. A local list is not
permission to grant a slot or manufacture completed operation IDs.

All unlocked slots must be filled; Combat exactly1. Gun/Medical/Defense at most2
each, Cargo at most1. Locomotive is separate from these carriage slots.
Medical type has stats but is absent from this default unlock list. Two Gun or
two Defense pass count limits but ownership/unlock of a second instance is NOT
proven by this function. Require authoritative availability before player use.

Recommend retaining default2/3/4 fixtures for initial tests. Alternative legal-by-
count compositions remain synthetic sensitivity fixtures until entitlement checked:
Combat+Gun+Gun+Cargo (offense), Combat+Gun+Medical+Defense (sustain).
Do not add Medical to default onboarding or remove required Combat to fill a test.

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-weight-and-speed"></a>
#### Weight And Speed

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-squad-and-train-complementarity---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Squad And Train Complementarity - 2026-09-09

Planning extension only. Connect combat-simulation-acceptance-v1.md's three proposed
five-member teams to train comparisons. None are verified clears or entitlements.

| Squad candidate | First train reference at same unlocked stage | What to measure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dual interrupt, with Mira | Default2/3/4 appropriate to pre-entry progress | Whether fewer sabotage pulses actually reduce repair need; do not assume every interrupt succeeds |
| Rare interrupt focus, with Mira | Same default as dual-interrupt case | Longer interruption gaps, actual shield absorption/repair and exterior time |
| Interior area, no Mira | Same default at first, especially default4 once unlocked | Whether manual repair and Defense cover train losses; no hidden passive repair added |

Default4 is Combat+Gun+Cargo+Defense, not four selectable extra devices alongside
Combat. Defense provides train shielding, not train healing or operator shielding.
Medical restores operators, not train integrity. Cargo buffs locomotive/Gun basic
weapon speed as defined, not skills or whole-squad speed. Avoid recommendations
that accidentally solve a missing function with a device that cannot perform it.

After squad-only comparison, test train changes separately at fixed squad/growth:

| Conditional four-slot fixture | Intended question | Cost / gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Combat+Gun+Gun+Cargo | Can exterior damage reduce incoming exposure? | Loses Defense shield; second Gun ownership not established |
| Combat+Gun+Medical+Defense | Does operator recovery compensate for slower exterior output? | Loses Cargo speed; Medical availability not established |

These count-valid examples are synthetic until authoritative ownership/unlock is
confirmed. No free extra car, automatic slot unlock or new inventory grant. If not
available, omit the player-facing recommendation and mark the corresponding test
fixture blocked rather than substituting a made-up item. Do not show them as initial
loadouts or compare a four-slot train against an early two-slot account as equal cost.

Record actual lane wait, train minimum HP, absorbed shield, effective repair, disabled
car/device uptime and clear time. More remainingHP alone does not make a better
build; faster kills can also reduce damage. Compare no-Mira squad with its manual
repair trace explicitly, not assuming Medical replaces Mira. Keep pressure OFF for
these first pairs so weight changes do not silently add a second difficulty variable.

Coop uses the train owner's cars and squad owner's five operators. Preparation may
show a role-scoped suggestion but cannot auto-edit the partner's loadout or require
matching account power. Existing readiness and carry eligibility remain unchanged.
This extends composition guidance only, not the four basic operation categories,
new World rules, numeric balance or an implementation order. Source comparison and
document readback only; actual ownership and event validation remain pending.

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-optional-car-acquisition-proposal---2026-09-09"></a>
##### Optional Car Acquisition Proposal - 2026-09-09

New proposal filling the unverified acquisition gap, not recovered policy or existing
runtime behavior. Preserve default2/3/4 and minimum-clear fixtures unchanged.

| Additional option | Proposed availability | Acquisition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First Medical | Accepted water-stop completion | One-time credit purchase |
| Second Gun | Accepted night-boarders completion | One-time credit purchase |
| Second Defense | Night-boarders completed and first Defense owned | One-time credit purchase |
| Second Medical | Night-boarders completed and first Medical owned | One-time credit purchase |

Use existing train/store navigation rather than a new crafting service. No crafting
timer, blueprint inventory, random success, new currency or premium requirement.
Prices remain undecided until compared with income and required growth consumption.
Owning another car does not add a slot or permit equipping one instance twice.
Keep Combat exactly1, filled unlocked slots and existing per-type limits. Recommend
owned cap2 for these three types; no new individual car growth system introduced.

Server query supplies availability, owned count and price. Purchase validates those
and balance, debits once and grants once; retries reconcile the same purchase. Exact
API/storage/instance schema belongs to Server review. A stale price needs renewed
confirmation. No resale/dismantle/refund or repeatable extra-copy banking proposed.
Reconcile legacy equivalent ownership before exposing purchases, not duplicate-grant
or charge again. Buying never auto-equips, changes partner assets or mutates a run.

Insufficient credits must not force crystal exchange. Compare optional purchase with
next required growth at the actual unlock-time wallet, not just positive28day income.
No first-clear depends on its own car reward or paid refill. Default-car lowest-tier
viability remains required; these options broaden builds rather than repair a paywall.

Future tests: milestone boundary, distinct instances, full-slot replacement, duplicate
and concurrent purchase, cap, legacy equivalents and price change. Not run. Scoped
train/economy planning search only, not exhaustive grant-code audit. This policy and
pricing need user adoption/economy/Server review before implementation.

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-optional-car-price-candidates---2026-09-09"></a>
###### Optional Car Price Candidates - 2026-09-09

Compare against docs/ops/launch-economy-v1.json, not a newly activated shop table.
Recommend first Medical600credits, second Gun1200, second Defense1000, second
Medical1200 as first-test prices. Total4000. Same named car's second copy can cost
more because it expands duplicate specialization; no stronger base stats implied.
These are proposed prices pending acquisition-policy adoption and wallet modeling.
Do not modify the approved economy JSON or claim affordability from these examples.

Actual source arithmetic: train3to4 credit cost450 (parts also required); five skill
1to2 steps credit total800 (data also required). Thus600 Medical competes with real
growth, not spare currency by assumption. M3 riskI repeat credits floor(150*1.2*.8)
=144;600 is5 successful-repeat gross-credit equivalents. M5 floor(195*1.4*.8)=218;
1200 is6 and1000 is5 repeat equivalents. These are NOT required extra runs, days to
purchase or fuel feasibility: other income/spending and entry limits are excluded.

Existing28day validator output excludes these purchases. Next accounting comparison
must insert optional purchases at accepted milestone availability, after the same
baseline growth planner, and compare no-purchase, first-Medical-only and all-options
traces. If unaffordable, defer rather than spend negative credits or assume paid
refills. Report actual purchase day and any delayed growth per resource; no success
claim based solely on4000 being below28day surplus. Player may choose a different
spending order; the model's growth-first ordering is not a forced shop restriction.

No computed unlock-day wallet or rerun18-case model in this unit. PowerShell parsed
the economy JSON and checked the arithmetic above only. Prices remain candidates.

Locomotive30; Medical10; Combat12; Cargo14; Gun18; Defense22.
Existing baseSpeed = clamp(1+(engineOutput-totalWeight)*0.01,0.75,1.20).
This is a speed INDEX, not km/h. Inspected count validator has no maximum-weight
rejection: heavy composition slows to floor, not an invented overweight entry gate.
Check Server admission before treating that as a confirmed live rule.

| Fixture | Weight including locomotive | Core level/output | Base speed |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: |

| Default4 | 96 | 10 /95 | 0.99 |

| Synthetic sustain4 | 92 | 6 /82 | 0.90 |

Existing output levels1..10:65/68/72/75/78/82/86/89/92/95.
Speed labels: below0.85 Heavy; below0.95 Slow; below1.05 Standard;
below1.15 Fast; else HighMobility. Boundary1.05 is Fast, not Standard.
Compare using specified precision rather than accidental binary rounding at edge.

Existing cruise multiplier1, low0.70, emergency acceleration1.35, final cap1.50.
Emergency duration/cooldown/availability are NOT established by this calculator.
Do not add a fourth train combat button or remove one of the proposed three to
expose it without a separate control decision. Reference simulation uses cruise,

Proposed UI shows slots/requiredCombat/totalweight/base-speed before departure,
and previews before/after when replacing a carriage. Allow outside-combat edits

<a id="source-d229e22a21c017ed-pressure-and-wave-rules-need-reconciliation"></a>
#### Pressure And Wave Rules Need Reconciliation

Existing pressure multiplier by currentSpeed: >=1.20 ->0.70; >=1.10 ->0.85;
>=1.00 ->1.00; >=0.85 ->1.15; otherwise1.30. This function does not specify WHAT
is multiplied: spawn count, attack rate or pursuit meter. No caller discovered
in inspected Scripts, so do not multiply damage AND spawns speculatively.

Keep pressure effect disabled in the isolated reference simulation, explicitly
label this omission. Runtime parity remains blocked until actual pressure consumer
or design is reconciled. Proposed further interpretation should be reviewed as a
new rule, not as a bugfix to a completed feature. Never change15wave count or

## World Raid Rules
