<!-- source-body:source-f676f54cacce84e4:start -->
<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-world-raid-rules"></a>
### World Raid Rules

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-status"></a>
#### Status

This consolidated specification removes superseded alternatives. Shared solo/cooperative content, invitation, carry, and quest rules are in [online-coop-mode-policy.md](46_COOP_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-29ac58e206039d36). World Raid remains separate from the Act 1 story raid and requires a separate release decision.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-accepted-design-baseline"></a>
#### Accepted Design Baseline

The user accepted these policies. Numeric settings are an accepted first-playtest configuration, not verified production balance or authorization to deploy World Raid. No implementation is claimed by this document.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-chapter-leaders-and-account-specific-dialogue-confirmed-2026-09-06"></a>
##### Chapter Leaders And Account-Specific Dialogue (Confirmed 2026-09-06)

- Act 1 has three chapters. Rotate the three faction leaders associated with those chapters as weekly World Bosses. Chapter-to-mission mapping, leader identities, and rotation order still require narrative reconciliation; existing mission IDs do not establish those mappings.
- Train-focused, operator-focused, and mutual-cooperation-focused encounters are recommended distinctions, not confirmed leader assignments or mechanic specifications.
- An account that meets the common World Raid entry conditions may participate without clearing the associated story chapter. Do not add chapter completion as an entry condition.
- Replace identity-reveal and story-ending dialogue with neutral wording according to each account's own server-authoritative story progress. Each of the two devices applies this independently; a partner's progress cannot reveal the other account's dialogue. Unknown progress uses spoiler-safe wording.
- This is dialogue presentation only. Mechanics, actionable warnings, score rules, and reward rules do not differ by story progress or dialogue variant. Do not invent progress IDs or reveal thresholds before the server contract is confirmed.
- Hiding boss names, portraits, and visual designs is not approved by this decision and remains a separate review item. Dialogue filtering is not a promise of complete spoiler prevention.
- See [World Boss Narrative Visibility Policy](../../../QA/DocumentIntegration-20260921/md-cleanup/semantic/archive.html#doc-88c9300a921a3ca7d08d) for copy guidance, canon conflicts, and validation cases. This decision does not change the frozen Act 1 story fixture, authorize new APIs, or promote World Raid into the launch build.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-tickets-and-weekly-operation"></a>
##### Tickets And Weekly Operation

- Use one common World Raid entry ticket per participant per attempt. Cooperative entry costs one from each account, never two from the host. Ticket stock itself is the common usage limit; add no separate daily attempt counter or per-mode allowance.
- Initial supply: two tickets when an account first becomes eligible, then two per elapsed daily boundary at 05:00 Asia/Seoul (20:00 UTC on the preceding date), capped at ten. No login/claim action is required to accrue supply. Accrual begins at eligibility, not account creation, and is applied idempotently before spending; supply beyond the cap is discarded.
- Tickets carry between weekly events without mode-specific stock, expiration at event reset, or retroactive recovery of overflow. Purchases and additional sources are outside this baseline.
- Run consecutive seven-day event windows from Monday 05:00 Asia/Seoul to the next Monday 05:00. Each event has a fixed boss/configuration version. New event selection and old event settlement use distinct event IDs.
- Stop accepting attempts whose full configured duration cannot finish by the event deadline. Reserve both ticket balances, recheck at server start, then commit both charges together. Rejected starts release both reservations. A valid attempt started before closing belongs only to its original event.
- At event close, freeze server-validated records and assignments before making ranking entitlements claimable. A delayed settlement displays pending and retries without new payouts; do not promise an arbitrary settlement completion minute.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-final-score-and-ranking-rules"></a>
##### Final Score And Ranking Rules

- Score equals the sum of server-validated effective damage to the World Boss during the attempt. One unit of damage is one point; accumulate at the server's fixed precision and round down once at attempt completion. Do not round independently per player/hit to create role-dependent results.
- No direct phase, survival, clear-time, or mechanic-completion points in this baseline. Successful mechanics increase damage via their buff; failures reduce attack opportunity. Damage to adds/devices is not boss score.
- Solo has one account record; cooperative has one record per unordered pair, showing both players and their score-producing loadouts. Roles can change between attempts without creating a new pair. Unlimited pairs are allowed.
- Keep the highest eligible score, never cumulative attempts. Resolve ties by earliest server-recorded completion attaining that score, then stable attempt ID. Neither client clock nor result upload order controls a tie.
- Use separate solo/cooperative boards for each event/boss/rules version, with no selectable difficulty. Preserve the confirmed cooperative duplicate-account reward promotion. Rank distinctions apply only to non-growth cosmetic/prestige rewards under separately defined bands.
- Compute both boards independently. Each eligible account receives the same currency/growth bundle once per event, regardless of rank or mode; appearing on both boards never creates a second currency bundle. Choosing a cosmetic entitlement must not rerun cooperative promotion or vacate an assigned position. Cosmetic cross-mode selection details remain to be specified without currency differences.
- Follow the revised Ranking Reward Policy below. The former rank-scaled resource table is superseded. Cosmetic categories, rank bands and uniform resource quantities require explicit configuration; no specific cosmetic asset or new currency is promised by this document.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-score-and-participation-reward-baseline"></a>
##### Score And Participation Reward Baseline

The following cumulative totals are a seven-day economy test budget using existing currency IDs. Higher tiers grant only the unclaimed difference from these totals; do not sum entire rows. Shared account/event entitlements combine solo and cooperative progress by tier, not raw score. The mode thresholds are initial placeholders for calibration against real combat output, not a claim that cooperative output is exactly double solo output.

| Tier | Solo score minimum | Cooperative team score minimum | Total cur_credits | Total cur_machine_parts | Total cur_tactical_data |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Participation | Eligible participation, score may be zero | Eligible participation, score may be zero | 300 | 20 | 10 |
| Bronze | 200000 | 400000 | 800 | 50 | 25 |
| Silver | 600000 | 1200000 | 1500 | 100 | 50 |
| Gold | 1200000 | 2400000 | 2500 | 160 | 80 |
| Elite | 2400000 | 4800000 | 4000 | 260 | 130 |

- Maintain one World Boss participation objective per weekly event, completed by one eligible attempt in either mode, with no daily duplicate or win/mechanic-success requirement. Its direct reward is the Participation tier above, not a second identical bundle. Do not also create a separately gated World Boss daily quest.
- A valid higher tier includes participation automatically. Repeated attempts/partners do not repay it. Rank rewards are a separate once-per-event bonus in addition to this shared score track.
- A cooperative low-damage support player earns the same team tier if eligible; no division by damage share. Each account only receives amounts it has not already earned elsewhere.
- Tune mode thresholds to comparable achievement effort before release. These numbers do not modify gameplay damage balance or the Act 1 twelve-ticket first-clear/login allocation.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-eligibility-and-exceptional-settlement"></a>
##### Eligibility And Exceptional Settlement

- Adopt the 180-second attempt, 30-second per-disconnect grace, at most 60 seconds of connection-gap grace per account/attempt, and 90 seconds of eligible presence as first-test values. Grace drives takeover/reconnection handling, not automatic personal activity credit. Reconnection remains possible for the original account until the deadline.
- Eligible presence includes connected recovery/incapacitation and legitimate periods without an actionable task. It excludes lobby time, disconnected automatic takeover, and proven unattended time. Require meaningful accepted role input or maintained control state, not a damage quota or continuous tapping. Exact instrumentation must be validated against both roles; do not auto-ban using this eligibility rule.
- A finalized attempt plus eligibility can count even with zero score or a brief final disconnect. Explicit voluntary abandonment forfeits that account's participation, score-tier, and ranking entitlement. Server-valid contributions already made are not retroactively subtracted from the team's damage.
- At normal time completion, retain a server-valid team record if at least one participant is eligible; mark an ineligible teammate as ineligible for rewards before promotion. Assign reward positions only to eligible unassigned accounts. Keep two names/roles in the historical team record without exposing private disconnection diagnostics. If neither is eligible, preserve diagnostics but do not rank or reward the attempt.
- After partner grace expires, an eligible remaining player may continue or accept the offered early end. Early end stores a partial diagnostic score but creates no ranked result or score-threshold payout. With at least 90 eligible seconds, that remaining player receives only the weekly participation entitlement. It is not classified as their voluntary abandonment. No normal early-end refund.
- No rank conversion to solo, new-player substitution, free timer reset, or new ticket charge on reconnect. Use only declared baseline takeover actions; auto-generated mechanics/buffs or superior takeover play are not allowed.
- A server-confirmed invalid attempt produces no score/quest/reward eligibility and restores each original ticket charge exactly once, without an additional allowance counter. Retrying the refund does not duplicate it; an owed refund must not be lost to the normal regeneration cap. Refunds may temporarily put stock above ten, with normal regeneration paused until below cap.
- Server-invalid results, ordinary low scores, recoverable failure, and user-reported network loss are distinct. A valid retained result cannot also receive an invalid-attempt refund.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-remaining-validation-not-new-feature-decisions"></a>
##### Remaining Validation, Not New Feature Decisions

- Verify ticket accrual across resets, event boundaries, concurrent requests, stock caps, and exact start deadlines.
- Validate meaningful activity detection without penalizing recovery, support builds, poor damage, or a legitimate idle role. Test deliberate disconnect/takeover and alternate-account carry cases.
- Simulate promoted positions with overlapping teams and ineligible members, deterministic ties, late invalidation, and cross-mode one-payout selection. Settlement must use frozen eligible records and account assignments, never claim order.
- Playtest initial damage, buff, recovery, threshold, and reward budgets. Changes take effect in a new event rules version, not midway through an open competition.
- Actual release date and deployment remain separate approval gates; accepting this design does not promote World Raid into the existing Act 1 launch build.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-core-mode-definition"></a>
#### Core Mode Definition

- World Raid runs during a scheduled event window.
- Players enter the raid and attempt to earn score against a raid boss.
- The raid does not require every player to defeat the boss to count as successful participation.
- Each combat attempt has a fixed time limit. The World Raid boss has unlimited health and cannot be defeated by exhausting HP; damage remains measurable for scoring. Story raid bosses retain finite health and require defeat.
- World Raid offers solo and online two-player modes. Story content and the Act 1 story raid remain solo-only.
- Confirmed: World Raid has no selectable difficulty tiers. Players select the event boss and solo/two-player mode; all attempts within a mode/event/rules version share the same encounter configuration. Solo and cooperative mechanic execution can differ.
- The top-two-difficulty carry-entry restriction belongs to ordinary operations, not World Raid. World Raid requires its common content-entry eligibility; random matchmaking matches the same event/boss and complementary roles, not power or difficulty tiers.
- Solo and two-player scores use separate leaderboards; scores are never pooled across the modes.
- Train HP/durability and operator HP/down states remain separate existing systems in both modes. Do not merge them or reuse ordinary-wave recovery policy as World Raid recovery.
- When the event window ends, the World Raid is settled.
- Participating players are treated as successful participants for event settlement.
- Rewards come from two sources:
  - Score bracket rewards.
  - Ranking bracket rewards.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-story-raid-versus-world-raid"></a>
#### Story Raid Versus World Raid

| Area | Act 1 Story Raid | World Raid |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Purpose | Story progression boss encounter | Competitive live-service event |
| Timing | Part of Act 1 progression | Scheduled event window |
| Success | Verified boss defeat | Event participation plus score settlement |
| Failure | Stamina refund | Attempt can score low or zero, but event settlement still succeeds for participants |
| Operators | 5, same as ordinary operations | Default 5 unless future event rules override |
| Rewards | Story raid reward/first clear | Score bracket + ranking bracket |
| Ranking | None | Required |
| Scope | Launch story content | Future/backlog until promoted |

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-timed-phase-and-mechanic-test-configuration"></a>
#### Timed Phase And Mechanic Test Configuration

These accepted initial test settings require combat validation before production. They do not change story raid behavior or authorize a World Raid release.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-timeline"></a>
##### Timeline

First-test baseline: 180 seconds, three phases, with the same duration and phase boundaries in solo and two-player variants of this test encounter.

| Remaining time R | State | Encounter purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 120 < R <= 180 seconds | Phase 1 | Introduce external pressure relief and internal release actions |
| 60 < R <= 120 seconds | Phase 2 | Combine external defense with internal device defense |
| 0 < R <= 60 seconds | Phase 3 | Combine learned mechanics to create a final damage-buff opportunity |
| R <= 0 seconds | Attempt ended | Stop gameplay scoring and finalize the server result |

- The server derives remaining time from the attempt start/deadline. Local countdown display cannot advance a phase or extend scoring.
- Incapacitation, recovery, disconnection, and presentation animations do not pause the timer.
- Reconnection uses the current phase and active mechanic state; it does not replay missed mechanics or grant missed buffs.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-mode-specific-mechanic-examples"></a>
##### Mode-Specific Mechanic Examples

These are illustrative patterns to adapt to a defined boss, not new canonical boss identities or finalized mechanics.

| Phase | Solo version | Two-player version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1: Release restraint | Request train pressure relief, then release the interior anchor; the first result stays available for the follow-up window | Train player relieves pressure while squad player releases the anchor within the shared opportunity window |
| 2: Restore power | Request external interception, then defend the interior control device | Train player intercepts the external threat while squad player protects the device |
| 3: Expose weakness | Complete external support and interior control actions sequentially, then use the resulting damage window | Both roles complete complementary actions to expose the weakness and receive the shared damage buff |

- Solo required support actions must be available for the mechanic and cannot depend on simultaneous precision input in both areas.
- A successful mechanic grants the configured temporary damage buff; merely reaching a phase does not.
- Failure applies the mechanic's declared health/durability damage. It does not directly subtract score or force instant death; accumulated damage can cause recovery downtime.
- Initial damage, buff, and recovery settings are specified below. Boss-specific mechanic schedules still require implementation-level design and testing.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-initial-mechanic-balance-tuning-draft"></a>
##### Initial Mechanic Balance (Tuning Draft)

Use these candidates for the 180-second prototype in both solo and two-player modes. They are not changes to ordinary-operation or story-raid recovery rules. Do not apply an extra cooperative multiplier simply because there are two players.

| Parameter | Initial candidate |
| --- | --- |
| Mechanic failure damage | 35% of the declared target's maximum HP/durability |
| Phase 1 mechanic success | Boss damage x1.25 for 12 seconds |
| Phase 2 mechanic success | Boss damage x1.35 for 12 seconds |
| Phase 3 mechanic success | Boss damage x1.50 for 15 seconds |
| First incapacitation recovery | 8 seconds |
| Second incapacitation recovery | 12 seconds |
| Third and subsequent recoveries | 16 seconds each; capped for the attempt |
| HP/durability on recovery | 60% of that target's maximum |
| Post-recovery protection | 3 seconds against ordinary incoming damage |

Failure resolution:

- The 35% value is a proposed final mechanic penalty, independent of armor, dodge, critical hits, and ordinary shields. It needs playtest validation and must be communicated as mechanic damage, not an ordinary hit silently bypassing defenses. Normal combat damage and healing retain their own rules.
- Declare the affected target during the warning. An external failure targets train durability; an internal failure targets the explicitly marked operator(s). Do not damage every operator by default.
- A shared mechanic has one declared failure outcome, not a separate copy from each player's failure report. If both areas are deliberately targeted, each target and penalty must be shown in advance.
- Apply an external train penalty once; do not additionally route the same event through carriage-to-train damage transfer. Round nonzero penalties upward to the supported HP unit and clamp remaining HP to zero.
- At full HP with no healing, mitigation, or other damage, failures leave approximately 65%, 30%, then 0%. A low-health target can fall on its next failure. This is damage-based incapacitation, not an instant-death flag.

Buff resolution:

- Apply the buff to boss damage from both train and operators in solo, and to both roles in cooperative play. Do not separately multiply the resulting score or apply the modifier twice to the same hit.
- Start the window only when the boss can actually receive damage after mechanic completion. A player must not be able to hold the start indefinitely. The phase schedule must leave enough usable time before the attempt deadline.
- Use one shared mechanic-buff slot per attempt. The buff does not stack or add durations. A repeated event is ignored; a distinct equal/stronger success replaces the slot with its configured multiplier and full duration, while a weaker success cannot extend a stronger active buff.
- Resolve the modifier when damage is applied. An already-fired projectile receives the modifier only if it lands while the buff is active. Summoned enemies/device damage is not multiplied by this boss-specific buff.
- Incapacitation does not pause or restart an already earned buff. Its remaining server duration continues for the active role; the recovered role receives only any time still remaining.

Recovery resolution:

- Count incapacitations per operator and separately for the train over the entire attempt, not per phase and not per account. A phase change/reconnection does not reset the count.
- Only the incapacitated entity loses its attack/actions; surviving operators and the other available role continue. HP-zero entities cannot receive repeated down events or extra failure damage during recovery.
- Recovery is automatic at the individual entity's server recovery deadline, while the attempt is still active, and does not require a recruited recovery skill or consumable. Simultaneous squad incapacitation preserves the individual recovery deadlines; it does not add a second squad-wide wait.
- The proposed 3-second protection does not cleanse an already committed mechanic. Avoid issuing mandatory new tasks to a recovering entity; a task interrupted by incapacitation must follow an explicitly defined cancellation/recovery rule rather than silently granting success.
- No direct score deduction is added for incapacitation. Recovery time loses damage opportunity, with no additional survival-score deduction or bonus.
- Do not add free HP resets through role swapping, reconnecting, or phase changes. Whether healing and 60% recovery create an intentional-failure advantage must be checked in combat playtests before accepting these values.

Balance acceptance checks:

- Verify three unmitigated failures from full HP cause incapacitation, one does not, and healing/normal incoming damage change that sequence transparently.
- Verify solo and cooperative targets receive one penalty per resolved mechanic, without double transfer or duplicate success buffs.
- Verify 8/12/16-second recovery progression remains capped across phases and reconnects, and ordinary/story recovery is unchanged.
- Verify the final 15-second buff has a usable damage window, and no damage or expired buff can score beyond the attempt deadline.
- Compare successful, repeated-failure, healing-heavy, and deliberate-incapacitation runs. No mathematical or user-experience balance claim is made until those playtests exist.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-boundary-and-recovery-handling"></a>
##### Boundary And Recovery Handling

Proposed handling to verify in the prototype:

- Stop scheduling a mechanic when there is insufficient time to provide its complete warning, solo/cooperative action window, and resulting damage-buff window before the next phase boundary or attempt deadline.
- At a phase boundary, retire an unfinished mechanic without an automatic success/failure, damage, buff, or score grant. A failure deadline actually reached before that boundary still resolves normally.
- Preserve an already earned buff until its own expiry or attempt end; a phase transition alone neither removes nor refreshes it. Avoid a new unattackable transition that wastes the earned window.
- Continue phases during recovery, but do not schedule a mandatory two-role mechanic while a required role is unavailable. Use a defined recoverable pattern or defer the mechanic without extending the attempt deadline. Missed mechanics are not later rewarded or replayed.
- At the attempt deadline, freeze score once. Recovery, damage-over-time, projectiles, callbacks, and reconnection cannot add post-deadline score. Exact server simulation ordering must be specified before implementation.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-prototype-review-checks"></a>
##### Prototype Review Checks

- Check boundaries at exactly 120, 60, and 0 seconds and confirm both clients display the same server phase.
- Exercise solo sequential completion and both cooperative roles without requiring particular recruited operators.
- Verify phase boundaries and recovery never create unavoidable repeated mechanic failures.
- Verify earned buffs have a usable attack window and phase changes do not duplicate success grants.
- Compare damage opportunities across recovery/disconnection cases and ensure deliberately becoming unavailable cannot improve scoring opportunities.
- No direct phase/survival/time bonus; only validated boss damage scores.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-public-records-and-reward-promotion"></a>
#### Public Records And Reward Promotion

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-public-record-loadouts-confirmed"></a>
##### Public Record Loadouts (Confirmed)

- A ranked record exposes the train/installed parts used by the train-role player and the five-operator composition used by the squad-role player. Show which player owned each role.
- Capture a server-validated loadout snapshot for the score-producing attempt; never render the current account loadout as if it produced a historical score. Later equipment changes or upgrades do not rewrite the record.
- Recommended details include public part/operator IDs and localized names, occupied slots, and relevant levels/upgrades needed to interpret the build. Exclude unrelated inventory, internal account IDs, authentication data, and private diagnostics.
- The row can show a compact composition preview with a detail view. When a higher-scoring attempt replaces a team record, replace its score and loadout snapshot together; no mixing of attempts.
- Include the event/boss/mode/rules version so a historical build is not presented as evidence under a different balance version.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-unlimited-ranked-partnerships-confirmed"></a>
##### Unlimited Ranked Partnerships (Confirmed)

- Do not limit the number of partners or ranked teams per account. The earlier three-team cap, registration slots, and event-long partnership locks are rejected.
- Valid teams can appear on the leaderboard even when one participant already appears in a higher-ranked team. Normal entry tickets and shared usage allowance still apply.
- Each account receives one ranking payout based on its highest eligible ranking entitlement, never a payout for every team entry.
- Confirmed reward promotion: keep all public team records, but skip reward-position occupancy only when both participants already have a reward position assigned in this settlement.
- Scan the frozen, deterministically ordered eligible team records from highest to lowest. Start the next reward position at 1 with no assigned accounts. For each row, find participants without an assigned position. If none remain, skip the row without advancing the position. Otherwise assign the current position to all unassigned participants in that row and advance it exactly once. Never replace an earlier assignment or issue another reward to an already assigned account.
- Assignment means inclusion in the server settlement ledger, not whether a player has opened mail or claimed a reward. Claim order cannot affect promotion. Compute all assignments before making rewards claimable; retries reuse the same finalized settlement.
- Example in descending score order: A+B, A+C, B+C, D+E. Reward positions are A=1, B=1, C=2, D=3, E=3. The third public row is entirely duplicate and consumes no reward position; public rank 4 therefore receives reward position 3.
- A repeated top player with different, previously unassigned partners does not by itself cause those team rows to be skipped. Their new partners retain their earned reward positions.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-ranking-reward-policy--revised-2026-09-14"></a>
#### Ranking Reward Policy — revised 2026-09-14

User decision supersedes the former position-dependent credits/parts/tactical-data test table. For the same event and eligibility, every qualifying account receives the same currency and growth-resource bundle regardless of rank. Rank distinctions are limited to non-performance, non-growth cosmetics/prestige. No stat bonuses or conversion into growth resources through cosmetic rewards.

The uniform quantities and cosmetic rank bands are not yet set; do not infer them from the former top/bottom/average amounts. Keep server eligibility, cooperative assignment, idempotency and once-per-event cross-mode protection. Rank selection must not create different currency amounts. Existing score-threshold rewards are a separate track and are not changed by this decision. Do not retroactively rewrite settled grants.

Authoritative change record: [Ranking reward policy](47_ECONOMY_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-e146be10f59741ea). World Raid release remains a separate decision; this does not authorize deployment or live payout.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-event-state-machine"></a>
#### Event State Machine

Scheduled -> Open -> Closing -> Settling -> Settled -> Archived.

Closing rejects starts that cannot fit the event deadline. Settling freezes eligible records and assignments before reward availability. Archived records are read-only. Client claim order never changes a finalized settlement.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-server-ownership"></a>
#### Server Ownership

Server owns:

- Event schedule.
- Active event state.
- Attempt validation.
- Score calculation or score acceptance policy.
- Ranking freeze and settlement.
- Reward generation and claim state.
- Anti-abuse and idempotency.

Server should not store or trust:

- Raw animation timelines.
- Client-side VFX/SFX/camera data.
- Client-side probability or RNG material.
- Client-provided reward quantities.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-unity-ownership"></a>
#### Unity Ownership

Unity owns:

- World Raid event entry UI.
- Boss fight presentation.
- Score progress display.
- Result presentation.
- Ranking preview display from server data.
- Reward claim presentation from server data.

Unity does not calculate ranking truth, reward truth, or final economy mutation.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-admin-ownership"></a>
#### Admin Ownership

Admin owns read-only visibility:

- Event status.
- Account participation.
- Best score.
- Ranking bracket.
- Score bracket.
- Claim state.
- Ops errors and support evidence.

Admin mutation controls are future-only:

- Manual score correction.
- Reward repair.
- Ranking reprocess.
- Event force-settlement.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-launch-boundary"></a>
#### Launch Boundary

Not included in Act 1 launch unless explicitly promoted:

- World Raid event schedule APIs.
- Ranking tables.
- Score settlement jobs.
- World Raid reward grants.
- Admin score correction or reprocessing.
- Public leaderboard UI.
- Cross-season archive.

<a id="source-f676f54cacce84e4-implementation-dependencies"></a>
#### Implementation Dependencies

- Authoritative combat and boss-specific schedules, cross-role buff catalogs, and participation evidence instrumentation must be implemented and tested; assets/view fixtures do not establish these capabilities.
- Tie ordering, assignment, and payouts use finalized eligible records, not client submission order or reward claim order.
- Post-settlement invalidation requires an explicit operational correction procedure; no manual Admin mutation is authorized here.
- First-test thresholds and amounts must be calibrated with real solo/cooperative combat output, and cannot change mid-event without a new rules version.

## CE03 local combat entry contract and implementation plan

원출처: `WorkspaceRepo/docs/ops/combat-entry-ce03-server-20260911.md`

<!-- source-body:source-b6574859c764e5cc:start -->
<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-ce03-local-combat-entry-contract-and-implementation-plan"></a>
### CE03 local combat entry contract and implementation plan

Goal: prepare one reproducible local lobby→accepted run→combat consumer→finish→reward receipt→lobby path without opening public combat admission on missing content. Base commit94349cf77582c62a86ca3bd2b35bfd8793c5ceb4. Plan delegation2026-09-11 and canonical combat-entry-next-slice-20260910.md are authority. Local implementation only; no remote DB, seed, deployment or real payment.

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-evidence-and-boundaries"></a>
#### Evidence and boundaries

- Server departure.ts issue/startDeparture already pins owned five operators, selected squad leader, loadout/growth facts, balance quote and fuel. Run snapshot and original start response commit with one debit. HTTP index.ts retains unconditional combat_not_ready for new departure admissions; original committed replay precedes it.
- index.ts finish reads runs.balance_config_version→balance_config_versions.config_json, parses runRewards and calls calculateRunRewardPreview. Its operation dictionary is the real reward source. No rewardTableId catalog exists. prepareLaunchRewards additionally enforces first-clear entitlement/conversion at finish and claim; a base reward reference is not an unconditional final grant promise.
- packages/balance/src/index.ts scales base reward by operation/risk/outcome/wave BPS then Math.floor, with separate unchanged first-clear lines. Existing launch-economy binding and account entitlement checks stay authoritative.
- Unity E:/Projects/LASTRAIL/unity-project/Assets/_LASTRAIL/Scripts/Core/Simulation/RunRandom.cs implements uint32 xorshift13/17/5, zero→0x6D2B79F5, Range=min+NextUInt()%span. This is a simulation PRNG, not seed generation or recruitment RNG.
- Unity RunStartSnapshotBuilder.BuildActOne has default-roster/Kyle/carriage fallbacks. CE03 must use explicit server-owned selection and strict consumer; BuildActOne defaults are not allowed for this path.
- Canonical train-combat-test-profile-v1.md is RECOMMENDED TEST PROFILE, proposal_train_combat_v1; it explicitly says no code/config activation. Source growth facts in admission are not effective stats.
- Durable run/checkpoint/final-result/reward-preview tables exist, but an accepted run is not proof of content loaded or a durable Unity consumer checkpoint. Existing reward preview expires24h; this work does not extend it or invent compensation.

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-exact-foundation-dtos"></a>
#### Exact foundation DTOs

`rewardReference:{version:"run-reward-ref-v1",balanceVersion:string,operationId:string,risk:"I"|"II"|"III"|"IV"|"V",scope:"BASE_RUN_REWARDS",hashAlgorithm:"SHA-256",canonicalization:"canonical-json-v1",configSha256:lowercaseHex64}`. Hash input is UTF8 canonicalJson(parseRunRewardsConfig(config.runRewards)), using the repository canonicalJson sorted-object implementation; arrays preserve order. This includes outcome/risk/operation reward policy, not account-specific first-clear eligibility. No fabricated table ID. It is returned with a new preview, persisted in preview and accepted start snapshot, checked against the same balance policy at start/finish. Old accepted starts without a reference retain their original shape and legacy finish behavior. Existing finish/claim APIs still calculate and pay; Unity does not award from the hash.

Seed protocol candidate for coordinated local fixture adoption: `{version:"combat-seed-local-v1",value:uint32,generation:"WEB_CRYPTO_UINT32",simulation:"XORSHIFT32_13_17_5_V1",purpose:"LOCAL_COMBAT_SIMULATION",issuedAt:unixMs,byteOrder:"LITTLE_ENDIAN",lifetime:"ORIGINAL_RUN",zeroNormalization:1831565813}`. Generation draws fresh four bytes via crypto.getRandomValues, independently of runId/time/account/gacha. Simulation exactly follows existing Unity unsigned wrap and logical right shift; Range retains modulo bias for parity, not cryptographic use. Generate once when creating an accepted fixture run, persist in the same start transaction, return the exact original on replay/restart. A rejected/rolled-back tentative generation is never an accepted seed. No wall-clock expiry/reseed for an existing run; new run needs new seed. Continuation requires a complete checkpoint or a separately proven full deterministic replay profile; seed and ordered inputs alone are insufficient with the existing variable-float simulation clock; reinitializing from original seed halfway is invalid. This candidate is implemented/tested as an isolated protocol helper first, not silently injected into public start or declared adopted production policy.

`GET /v1/runs/:runId/lifecycle` implemented read-only foundation: auth/no-store, no body/query; account-owned run plus original start snapshot, final result and reward receipt from one DB read. Fields `version:"run-lifecycle-v1",runId,runStatus,startResponse,finish:{status:"NOT_RECORDED"|"RECORDED",outcome,submittedAt},reward:{status:"NOT_AVAILABLE"|"CLAIMABLE"|"CLAIMED"|"EXPIRED"|"UNAVAILABLE",rewardPreviewId,expiresAt,claimId,receipt},nextAction`. Read does not submit finish, claim, refund, renew TTL, mark battle complete or authorize reentry. Original start-result/start-state routes remain available. nextAction guides recovery only: RECOVER_COMBAT_CONSUMER,RESUME_FINISH,REWARD_REVIEW,RETURN_TO_LOBBY,REVIEW_REQUIRED. Missing snapshots/unknown or quarantined state must use REVIEW_REQUIRED.

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-effective-stats--engine-test-adoption-proposal-not-live-binding"></a>
#### Effective stats / engine test adoption proposal, not live binding

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-consumer-review-amendments-binding-for-this-foundation"></a>
##### Consumer review amendments (binding for this foundation)

Existing `/v1/balance-config/:version` returns `{version,schemaVersion,requiredContentVersion,checksum,publishedAt,payload}` from the historical balance row, including payload.runRewards. Reuse it; no policy endpoint is added. Client hash verification additionally requires the same parseRunRewardsConfig projection (schemaVersion,riskMultipliersBps,operationProgressionMultipliersBps,outcomePolicy,operations,integrityPolicy) and canonical serializer: recursively sort object keys by ordinal UTF16, preserve array order, compact JSON/UTF8. Server published checksum is not automatically the reward hash. Until that exact policy/projection/serializer is implemented and obtained, Unity preserves an OPAQUE_SERVER_PIN and must not report local hash validation. Final finish validates against the run's historical version, not newly active policy.

Seed JSON is an unsigned decimal integer0..4294967295, never parsed through int32. Exactly four CSPRNG bytes are decoded little-endian via DataView.getUint32(0,true). Byte vectors00000000→0,00000080→2147483648,FFFFFFFF→4294967295. Seed0 initialization normalizes to1831565813; checkpoint PRNG state0 is invalid and restoreLocalCombatRandom rejects it. Accepted restoration range is1..4294967295. Range(min,max) accepts int32 integers with max>min and span<=2147483647; negative min is allowed only within that safe span. It returns min+NextUInt()%span; no floating random or rejection sampling. Seed1 outputs270369,67634689,2647435461 for the first three draws; Range(10,20) first draw=19. This is PRNG parity only, not complete battle determinism.

Reuse PlayerEntryRuntime.Runs/DurableRunClient/EncryptedRunOperationJournal and its HandoffAsync durable-sink ACK-before-delete. AccountActionJournal owns the new departure start request until a single durable combat sink ACKs the same account/run/original receipt identity. Never have both journals resend the same start/finish or construct a second accepted run from the legacy builder. No new journal/send transport is proposed. BattleSession only ticks; its full state restore owner remains Unity work.

A coherent checkpoint needs version/profile/content/snapshot hashes, checkpoint revision, fixed tick/step or exact delta history, system execution order, input watermark, all PRNG stream states and entity-ID counters, complete entities/positions/HP/shields, train/carriage/operator state, cooldowns/casts/targets, buffs/stacks/expiry, projectiles/pending effects, spawn/wave timers/cursors, boss phase and tactics/augments. Capture atomically at a simulation tick boundary. Neither the existing variable float clock nor seed+input ordering establishes replay equivalence. No checkpoint DTO/whole-battle restoration implementation is claimed by this server foundation.

Lifecycle time fields serverTime,finish.submittedAt,reward.expiresAt are UTC Unix milliseconds. submittedAt/outcome are null when no final result; rewardPreviewId is null when no preview and is repeated in finish to recover lost finish responses. claimId/receipt are null before claim; missing/corrupt claimed receipt produces UNAVAILABLE. startResponse is the original envelope or null when unavailable. CLAIMED receipt remains CLAIMED after expiresAt. `uiReturnAllowed:true` permits returning to the lobby UI with the run, original journals and disposition retained; `newAttemptAuthorized:false` always means this read grants no new-entry authority. disposition is REWARDED,EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,REVIEW_REQUIRED or PENDING. Even REVIEW_REQUIRED must not force a permanent lobby UI lock; it also does not clear run/journal blockers or permit a free restart.

reward.receipt is the persisted transaction evidence `{rewardTransactionId,runId,serverClaimedAt:unixMs,rewardPlan}`. rewardPlan is the original stored reward_transactions.reward_json with rewardLines/calculation; it is not reconstructed current balances or a claim that the old HTTP claim envelope was stored verbatim. The original claim journal/replay remains the source for that HTTP response. Malformed/nonobject stored plan or absent rewardLines is UNAVAILABLE, not successful recovery.

| runStatus | finish | reward | nextAction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ACTIVE, valid snapshot | NOT_RECORDED | NOT_AVAILABLE | RECOVER_COMBAT_CONSUMER (does not prove checkpoint exists) |
| FINISH_PENDING, valid snapshot | NOT_RECORDED | NOT_AVAILABLE | RESUME_FINISH (original journal only) |
| COMPLETED/FAILED/ABANDONED, valid snapshot | RECORDED | CLAIMABLE | REWARD_REVIEW, explicit user claim required |
| COMPLETED/FAILED/ABANDONED, valid snapshot | RECORDED | CLAIMED with receipt | RETURN_TO_LOBBY |
| terminal run | RECORDED | EXPIRED | REVIEW_REQUIRED; EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED retained, UI return allowed |
| any with missing start snapshot, QUARANTINED, invalid combination, missing receipt or EXPIRED run | any | any | REVIEW_REQUIRED |

REVIEW_REQUIRED and UI return are separate from successful completion and new admission. No compensation, reward renewal/mail conversion, new-run creation or checkpoint reset is performed.

Shared candidate profile ID `ce03-local-profile-v1` remains TEST_ADOPTION_PROPOSED until Plan/Unity explicitly select the same fixture. Pin `profileId,profileSha256,engineProfileVersion,effectiveStatsVersion,roundingVersion,sourceOwnership,snapshotSha256` in a future accepted local manifest. Server owns account/slot/operator/train/carriage IDs, levels/revisions, ownership and final snapshot; Unity verifies versions/hash and consumes resolved values, never recalculates from later account state.

Candidate train-only arithmetic reuses proposal_train_combat_v1: engine output levels1–10=[65,68,72,75,78,82,86,89,92,95], used only for rail speed. TrainHP=5000*(100+8*(level-1))/100; locomotiveATK=floor(60*(100+6*(level-1))/100), armor1000BPS. No gear/research/faction multipliers for this candidate. All nonnegative integer magnitudes use final floor after the complete rational product, never intermediate float rounding. Engine output is not weapon ATK or attack speed. Operator/carriage/ability/wave complete profile is not established by this train subset; do not manufacture missing values. Actual content/binding hashes remain required from Direction/Unity, and no test fixture is registered in the launch catalog.

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-durable-consumer-and-recovery-state-transitions"></a>
#### Durable consumer and recovery state transitions

Before start: validated/downloaded exact binding/profile/assets → locally persist original start body/key/account/preview → POST start. Unknown start response: start-result lookup with original key/preview; NOT_FOUND is not permission to invent a successful run. Committed response is durably stored as an immutable handoff keyed account/run/snapshot hash before loading battle. Only one consumer may claim that handoff locally; reload restores the same run and hashes. Server acceptance does not certify loaded content.

Unity durable consumer states proposed: ACCEPTED_UNCONSUMED→LOADING→RUNNING→FINISH_PENDING→RESULT_PENDING→REWARD_REVIEW→CLAIM_PENDING→RESULT_RECEIVED→RETURNED. Store original seed plus checkpoint PRNG state/input sequence/content+engine hashes. Crash during LOADING retries the same handoff; RUNNING requires a compatible complete checkpoint or an independently validated deterministic replay profile. Existing BattleSession does not implement this restoration. If neither exists, show recovery unavailable, do not reset into a free new attempt or claim fake success. FINISH_PENDING persists exact finish body/key before network; resend/lookup until committed. Server run.status FINISH_PENDING and local submission pending are separate: current API does not durably set server FINISH_PENDING merely when the client prepares a body.

Existing finish idempotency/final result creates a reward preview; RESULT_PENDING reads/replays original finish and enters REWARD_REVIEW. Only the user's explicit claim action enters CLAIM_PENDING and sends the persisted exact claim body/key; CLAIMABLE never automatically claims. Existing duplicate finish returns DUPLICATE_REPLAY/accepted:false with the same rewardPreviewId, not an identical success envelope. RESULT_RECEIVED requires actual server reward receipt; returning to lobby refreshes account state without another start/finish/claim. Engine/content mismatch, quarantine, expired unclaimed reward or missing receipt is an explicit blocked/review state. No new TTL/refund/compensation policy is inferred. Complete Unity handoff/checkpoint persistence and real scene consumer are Unity-owned implementation still required.

<a id="source-b6574859c764e5cc-implementation-order-and-tests"></a>
#### Implementation order and tests

- [x] First send this exact contract/profile proposal to Plan for Unity coordination; canonical mirror/readback if permitted.
- [x] Add server combat-reward-reference.ts: strict hash builder/validator, shared canonical test vectors; modify departure.ts to pin actual reward reference and index.ts to verify only newly pinned finishes. Test exact replay, old run compatibility, changed policy rejection before payout, existing actual finish/claim and fuel one-time behavior. No migration needed.
- [x] Add isolated combat-seed-protocol.ts matching existing Unity RunRandom, test unsigned boundaries/zero normalization/known sequence/Range and independent CSPRNG generation. Do not activate public seed or stat/profile bindings while test adoption is pending.
- [x] Add read-only run lifecycle recovery using existing DB records; test ownership/no writes, active/finish_pending/quarantined/terminal states, actual reward receipt and24h expiry, original start snapshot preservation. Do not fake loaded/running/checkpoint state.
- [x] Run focused regressions, full suite, game/async types/lint and independent review; fix findings, commit code and this contract together. Report exact tests and unsupported scene/assets/stats/consumer work to Plan. New end-to-end local HTTP admission/profile activation requires an explicit shared test profile and actual bound content, not client-ready flags.

The first deliverable is interoperable foundation and a reproducible protocol test profile, not proof that a battle scene has played. Full local end-to-end acceptance additionally requires Unity's real durable consumer and actual assets, verified on the same immutable profile/contract revision.

Verification:86files/579tests PASS (20.83s), game-api/async-worker TypeScript and source ESLint PASS; independent review found no high-impact foundation defect. CE03 focused tests are combat-ce03.test.ts and combat-seed-protocol.test.ts. Public combat gate remains closed, no live seed/profile/catalog or full Unity checkpoint was activated. No new migration; existing0001–0035 baseline unchanged.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-explicit-completion-order-prepared-verified-destination-retry-rejected--2026-09-11"></a>
#### Explicit Completion Order Prepared; Verified-Destination Retry Rejected — 2026-09-11

Unity relays user explicit instruction to assign all remaining work to existing owners, implement/verify/QA and report back without repeating completed work. - 20actualHTTP/읽기 DB hash/5 runtime mirror/독립 scoped review/인증 fixture 정리는 담당 보고이며 Plan 독립 재검증 아님. 최초 fixture preview 누락 실패 후 수정 회귀 PASS는 담당 기록. 새 dialog 시각 촬영은 미수행 보고. 조회 기반 부분 완료이며 전체 CE03 완료가 아니다.
- Unity에 기존 후속인 native reward preview→명시 claim, 원 finish body/key 복구 UI 실제 연결·검증 요청 SENT(isError=false). DUPLICATE_REPLAY/accepted:false의 같은 rewardPreviewId 실제 adapter/HTTP 회귀, 자동 claim 없음, TTL/claim transaction과 HTTP 응답 구분, 계정 격리, UI 복귀와 새 출발 잠금 분리, 로컬 시각 QA 포함. 이전 duplicate-finish adapter가 이번 검증됐다는 주장은 하지 않는다.
- 남음: 결과 복구·명시 수령 UI, 단일 durable battle sink/완전 checkpoint, 실제 manifest/전체 profile. Seed helper/train-only live 채택 및 READY/원격 활성화 없음. 다음 Unity 결과 복구 고정 결과와 Direction 최소 manifest 수신. Plan 제품 변경/테스트 재실행 없음. 문서3개 로컬 미커밋 exact readback 검증.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-ce03-server-fixed-foundation-routed--2026-09-11"></a>
#### CE03 Server Fixed Foundation Routed — 2026-09-11

- Server 고정 7ad482ce9624508903995bb1d9299c0394820d5c의 server/docs/api/combat-entry-ce03.md를 Plan이 git show로 직접 읽었다. 원본 ops/combat-entry-ce03-server-20260911.md SHA256 D5409CD42648ACB46E33075DEFB716EC5AA9AD0269BA7FC94BFB67193CE4FC18 직접 일치 확인. Server canonical 현재 완료 기록도 직접 읽음. 86파일579PASS/tsc/lint/diff/독립 검토는 담당 보고이며 Plan 테스트 재실행 아님.
- 실제 parsed runRewards의 rewardReference/hash pin과 historical balance finish 검증, 원 start replay/finish DUPLICATE_REPLAY 및 같은 rewardPreviewId, 소유자 단일읽기 lifecycle 계약 확보. hash 로컬 검증은 historical balance-config의 같은 parser projection/canonicalization 확보 전 OPAQUE_SERVER_PIN만 유지. transaction receipt는 원 claim HTTP envelope와 구분한다.
- Unity에 같은 고정 source/DTO 기반 실제 adapter/lifecycle/복구 연결 및 검증 요청 정상 SENT(isError=false). 명시 REWARD_REVIEW→사용자 claim, TTL 후 CLAIMED receipt 보존, expired/unavailable UI 복귀와 새 출발 권한 분리, 기존 journal/단일 sink ACK 전 삭제금지·이중 송신금지를 유지했다. 기존 배정 후속이며 별도 중복 담당 없음.
- 격리 WebCrypto little-endian uint32/xorshift 후보는 구현·시험 보고이나 live start seed/stat/profile 미채택. train-only TEST_ADOPTION_PROPOSED는 전체 전투 profile이 아니다. 실제 자산/ability/stat binding, 전체 checkpoint/tick/entity 복원 및 Direction 최소 manifest는 남아 있다.
- 새 migration 없음(0001–0035), public combat_not_ready 유지. 원격 DB/seed/deploy/payment·전체 소스 동기화 없음. Server 기반 로컬 완료이며 CE03 실제 플레이 E2E 완료가 아니다.
- 다음: Unity 고정 계약 기반 연결 결과와 Direction 최소 manifest 수신 후 전체 로컬 profile의 빠진 입력/채택 결정을 대조한다. 본 기록과 작업표/CE문서는 로컬 미커밋, 저장 exact readback 검증. Plan 제품 코드/테스트 변경 없음.

Unity의다음실제연결요청에따른Plan작업정의. 최신출발/복구기준eef4885,
이문서는새전투수치를승인하거나실플레이READY를허용하지않는다.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-ce03-local-combat-round-trip-assigned--2026-09-11"></a>
#### CE03 Local Combat Round Trip Assigned — 2026-09-11

- Unity가 사용자의 우선순위 승인(로비 출발→전투→결과→복귀 로컬 완성)을 전달했다. 기존 CE01/02와94349cf까지 연동을 유지하며 CE03 계약/콘텐츠 작업을 현재 Server·Direction에 정상 배정하고 Unity에도 배정 결과/소비자 경계 준비를 정상 전달했다. 새 task/원격 권한 생성 없음.
- Server: 실제 balanceVersion+operationId reward 참조, 서버 seed 생성과 시뮬레이션 알고리즘 구분/수명/replay, engine/effective stats 계산·반올림·snapshot, durable handoff/finish/result/복귀의 정확 schema·시험profile·구현순서를 문서로 먼저 제시하고 기존 승인 기반 구현을 이어가도록 요청.
- Direction: 실제 operation/content 및 asset 경로/type/dependency/version/hash를 대조하여 가장 작은 작전1개 완주 slice 추천·manifest를 구체화. 없는 자산은 명시하고 필요한 최소 시험콘텐츠 제작안을 별도 보고. proposed 수치를 출시승인으로 바꾸지 않는다.
- Unity: 다운로드/검증→원자입장→durable consumer ACK→동일run/seed 복구→원finish receipt 확인→결과/로비 갱신의 실제 코드 경계 대조. ACK 전 원journal 삭제, 무조건 gate해제, client ready 신뢰, 가짜 결과/임의환불 없음.
- Plan은 brainstorming 스킬과 기존 combat-entry-next-slice 문서를 읽고 구조 설계 작업으로 분류했다. 기존 사용자 승인된 로컬 완주 의도 안에서 계약 구체화를 배정했으며 신규 출시 수치/자산/권리 승인은 미정 그대로다. 이번 Plan 제품 변경/테스트/배포 없음.
- 다음은 Server 계약안·Direction 실제 자산/시험 slice·Unity consumer 경계안을 대조해 동일 버전 통합계약으로 전달. 인계/작업표/CE문서 로컬 미커밋 exact readback 검증. 원격 DB/seed/deploy/실결제 제한 유지.
<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-사용자-노출-용어--분대장-선택"></a>
#### 사용자 노출 용어 — 분대장 선택

2026-09-10 Unity 사용자 확정 보고를 반영한다. CE01의 사용자 노출 명칭은
'분대장 선택', 기능 설명은 '분대장의 궁극기를 전투에서 사용할 수 있습니다'.
기존 ultimate API/필드 및 선택·출발 pinning 동작은 유지한다.
정확한 문구는 [분대장 선택 용어](../../../QA/DocumentIntegration-20260921/md-cleanup/semantic/archive.html#doc-700868d6cb64f3134521)를 따른다.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-확인한기획근거"></a>
#### 확인한기획근거

- [궁극기정책](../../../QA/DocumentIntegration-20260921/md-cleanup/semantic/archive.html#doc-700868d6cb64f3134521): 사용자승인설계,
  실제편성5명중1명출발전선택·시도중교체없음·무작위전술획득전제없이기본접근.
  15/45초는승인시험기준이며측정된출시밸런스아님. 문서당시구현미승인은새화면연결
  작업요청과구분하고,여기서는선택저장/검증/인계만구현한다. 궁극기전투효과는범위밖.
- [전투수치](44_COMBAT_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-5bcf7c7f9134d9bc) 및JSON은 PROPOSED NUMERIC BASELINE.
  파싱가능함만으로승인카탈로그/계정능력치로사용하지않는다.
- [전투준비색인](../../../QA/DocumentIntegration-20260921/md-cleanup/semantic/archive.html#doc-c59aaad9ea86bbff78a1): 콘텐츠검증/다운로드와
  accepted입장/장면준비/전투시작분리,다운로드는차감전. 수치/코드/승인분리.
- [적/웨이브](44_COMBAT_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-354d63ae7f0c9117)는명시적제안. 실제wavePlan
  binding으로활성화할근거아님.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-ce01--선택한궁극기대원의저장과불변고정"></a>
#### CE01 — 선택한궁극기대원의저장과불변고정

Server담당: 현재활성편성의소유5명중선택1명을계정에저장/조회하고독립revision 또는
일관된편성revision으로CAS/멱등보장. 자동Kyle/첫슬롯기본값없음. 최초선택없음은
명시null과미선택사유. 구체endpoint/schema는Server가동일commit문서로정의한다.

활성편성변경후기존선택자가새5명에없으면새편성과동일transaction에서선택해제/null,
새동료자동선택없음. 비활성preset저장은현재선택을바꾸지않는다. selected당사자가
계속포함되면선택보존. active/finish_pending/quarantined run 중변경은기존잠금과일치.
preview발급과start검증은선택/소유/편성·revision을검사하고run에선택을고정한다.
다른미확정combat필드가있으므로궁극기선택만으로READY를만들지않는다.

Unity담당:활성5명중명시선택·현재선택/미선택표시·저장/409초안보존·원body/key복구.
확정후새preview 필요,서버에저장되지않은로컬선택을전투snapshot에넣지않는다.
구전투builder fallback은새연결경로에서사용하지않는다.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-ce02--타입이-명시된-콘텐츠-검증로딩-기반"></a>
#### CE02 — 타입이 명시된 콘텐츠 검증·로딩 기반

Unity담당:기존AddressableContentBackend/ApprovedCatalogSafety의승인locator/hash검사를
재사용하는별도typed combat resolver와loader입구를구현. 현재screen/scene resolver를
전투카탈로그로오인하지않는다. 실제참조가없으면정확한Missing/Unsupported/Invalid/
LoadFailed 상태로돌려주고ready=false. 메인UI는짧은안내,개발진단은필드별원인.

입력은현재server requiredContent의operation/content/package/encounter/boss refs 및
향후확정binding version/hash. 승인된binding없음은실제content부재와구분한다.
구체manifest schema/type는Server와field표를맞추고확정된같은버전문서로공유한다.
테스트용manifest/수치는테스트fixture로만주입하며shippingcatalog에등록하지않는다.

이단위의성공은실제전투재생이아니라엄격한typed로드/검증·기존승인resource조회재사용·
미지원상태및계정/요청전환취소다. 실제loaded content 없이는Loaded/READY 표시없음.
궁극기저장과독립적으로구현가능하며통합새commit계약도착전추정DTO를배포하지않는다.

<a id="source-d7dfeb371afbbf2c-ce03--승인자료가필요한잔여표"></a>
#### CE03 — 승인자료가필요한잔여표

| 항목 | 현재상태 | 다음필요한결과 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| operation+content→faction/wave | 실제binding미확보 | 기존ID/asset근거또는명시적신규콘텐츠설계 |
| reward reference | 실제balanceVersion+operation키존재,legacytableId없음 | 이구조화키소비로adapter개선가능성검토,가짜tableId금지 |
| 전투seed | uintconsumer뿐발급규칙없음 | 목적/알고리즘/수명/replay정의의신규정책안 |
| engine/effective stats | 명시시험제안 | version·반올림포함수치채택결정 |
| 궁극기선택 | 상위규칙승인 | CE01 실제저장/고정계약 |
| durable전투consumer | 원요청보존중 | 실제loader/전투준비후원run인계/중복진입방지 |

Server는CE01을실제구현하고CE02필드/버전계약및reward구조화참조의기존근거를검토한다.
Unity는CE02를진행하며CE01확정계약수신후화면연결. 다른4가지미확정수치를이문서로
자동채택하지않는다. scope별코드/테스트/고정commit과실전투미완료경계를보고한다.
원격migration/seed/deploy차단유지. Plan원문대조·문서readback외제품검증미수행.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-객차-파손복구-운영-연결-세부안"></a>
### 객차 파손·복구 운영 연결 세부안

2026-09-15 / Plan_5. 사용자 요청에 따른 밸런스·연결 제안. 기존 승인 규칙과 신규 제안값을 구분한다. 수치 채택·운영 반영·실제 전투 검증 완료가 아니다.

근거: [피해 기획](44_COMBAT_DETAIL_CONTRACTS.md#source-d25448b3ff1afe52), [Unity 연결 조사](../../../QA/DocumentIntegration-20260921/md-cleanup/semantic/archive.html#doc-ec8471c224c8b9bc43d9).

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-첫-적용-범위"></a>
#### 첫 적용 범위

- 첫 연결은 현재 지원이 확인된 Combat/Gun 객차와 로컬 준비 프로필에서 검증한다. 의료/방어/화물까지 이름만으로 처리하지 않는다. 서버가 제공하는 실제 지원 타입·편성 ID·순서·장치와 표시를 1:1로 맞춘다.
- 일반/스토리 복구 시작안을 사용한다. 월드레이드 별도 복구·점수·종료 정책에는 자동 적용하지 않는다. 온라인 권위 저장·재접속 검증은 별도 통합 단계다.
- QA 모델의 틱 숫자를 운영 초로 복사하지 않는다. 실제 전투의 권위 시계와 불변 설정을 사용한다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-복구-수치-제안"></a>
#### 복구 수치 제안

| 항목 | 추천 시작값 | 의미 |
|---|---|---|
| 같은 객차의 첫 파손 | 10초 | 초반 한 번의 실수를 복구 가능하게 함 |
| 두 번째 파손 | 15초 | 반복 피격으로 장치 공백 증가 |
| 세 번째 이후 | 20초 | 불이익은 유지하되 무한 증가 방지 |
| 복구 직후 체력 | 최대 HP의40%, 정수내림·최소1 | 다시 활동할 수 있지만 완전 회복은 아님 |
| 복구 직후 피해 보호 | 2초 | 복구 순간 다시 파손되는 반복 방지 |
| 장치 재가동 | 복구 후 기존 정상 주기1회 대기 | 즉시 무료 발동·밀린 발동 없음 |

단축 대안(5/8/10초)은 장치 중단의 의미가 약하고, 장기 대안(15/25/30초)은 연속 피격 때 관망 시간이 길다. 기존 후보10/15/20초를 첫 검증안으로 추천하며 실제 전투 길이·파손 빈도로 조정한다.

- 파손 횟수는 객차별로 저장한다. 웨이브·선로 변경·재접속·열차 수리로 초기화하지 않고 새 전투에서 초기화한다.
- 실제 장치가 별도로 제공하는 상시 패시브·기존 방어막·이미 발사한 탄을 임의 제거하지 않는다. 파손은 해당 장치의 미래 발동만 중지한다.
- 전 객차가 파손돼도 열차 HP가 남아 있으면 독립 복구와 지휘관 지원은 유지한다. 객차 파손을 열차 전체 패배로 대신 판정하지 않는다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-보호와-시간"></a>
#### 보호와 시간

- 보호 중 객차는 기존 격리 검증처럼 표적으로 남되 HP 손실과30% 전이를0으로 처리하는 안을 제안한다. 보호 표시는 별도 상태 효과로 보여준다.
- 보호된 타격도 사건은 소비한다. 보호 종료 뒤 같은 사건을 다시 적용하지 않는다. 객차 보호는 열차 직접 피해·다른 객차·요원을 보호하지 않는다.
- 피해 보호 중 객차 방어막 자원은 소비하지 않는 안을 제안한다. 피해 경로 입구에서 보호를 판정하고 방어 계산 전에 끝낸다. 실제 방어막 계약과 신규 회귀로 확인해야 하며 기존 fixture PASS로 입증된 사항은 아니다.
- 물리 충돌 감속은 보호와 별개다. 피해0이라도 유효 충돌에 설정된 감속은 한 번 발생한다.
- 복구·보호·장치 주기는 권위 전투 시계를 사용한다. 50ms 고정 스텝을 유지할 경우10/15/20초는200/300/400틱, 보호2초는40틱이다. 설정 경계에서 단위를 명시한다.
- 일반 저속/고속 스로틀은 주행 거리만 바꾸므로 복구 시간을 늘리거나 줄이지 않는다. 시뮬레이션 배속과 일시정지는 기존 전투 시간 계약을 따른다.
- 증강 선택의1% 시간에서는 복구도1%로 진행한다. 현실 시간을 기다려 복구를 완료하는 우회는 허용하지 않는다. 이 문서가 기존 선택 시간 배율 자체를 변경하지 않는다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-승인된-피해-규칙의-연결"></a>
#### 승인된 피해 규칙의 연결

1. 객차 조준 타격은 해당 객차의 허용 방어를 한 번 처리한다.
2. 실제 HP 감소량만 산출한다. 과잉 피해와 방어막 흡수량은 객차 손실이 아니다.
3. `floor(실제 객차 손실 × 0.3)`을 열차 HP에 내부 손실로 한 번 반영한다. 열차 장갑·방어막을 다시 적용하지 않는다. 기존 열차 직접 공격의 방어 처리는 유지한다.
4. 열차 HP0 또는 종료 확정이면 복구·수리·신규 발사를 금지한다. 남은 포탄 연출 정리 때문에 Outcome이 아직 Running이어도 회생하지 않는다.
5. 살아 있을 때만 새 객차 파손과 복구 예약을 생성한다. 이미 파손된 객차의 늦은 탄은 손실/전이0이고 다른 객차로 재조준하지 않는다.

기관차/전체 열차 직접 타격은 열차 방어 한 번을 거친다. 한 사건이 직접 열차 피해와 객차 전이를 동시에 주지 않는다. 긴급수리는 전체 열차만 회복하며 객차 체력이나 복구 시간을 바꾸지 않는다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-파손-객차에-닿는-물리-위험"></a>
#### 파손 객차에 닿는 물리 위험

- 이미 파손된 객차에 새 낙석이 최초 접촉하면 명시된 DirectTrain 경로를 사용한다. 같은 낙석으로 방금 파손된 경우에는 추가 직접 피해를 주지 않는다.
- 보편 고정 피해·보편 계수를 이번에 만들지 않는다. 위험 정의에 직접 열차 피해 기준과 속도/잔여 장애물 상태 계산을 명시한 항목만 활성화한다. 값이 없으면 오류로 드러내고0이나 객차 피해량으로 몰래 대체하지 않는다.
- 이 값은 별도 미확정으로 남는다. 객차 수명/일반 피해 통합은 먼저 할 수 있지만, 물리 위험 전체 완료를 선언할 수는 없다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-같은-틱-경계-제안"></a>
#### 같은 틱 경계 제안

- 기존 전체 스케줄러를 뒤집지 않고 객차 복구를 기존 복구 단계에 삽입한다. 단계 시작에 열차 HP0/종료 보류를 먼저 차단한다.
- 살아 있고 복구 예정 틱에 도달했다면 복구·보호 상태를 적용한 뒤 그 틱의 입력/피격을 처리한다. 보호 구간은 `[복구틱, 보호종료틱)`이며 종료틱의 피해는 정상 적용한다.
- 해당 틱의 피해 처리로 패배하면 이후 복구 예약·수리·신규 공격이 상태를 되돌릴 수 없다. 기존 포탄 정리는 피해/회생과 분리한다.
- 여러 피해 사건은 권위 순서와 고유ID로 처리하며 표시 프레임/도착한 네트워크 콜백 순서를 쓰지 않는다. 정확한 스케줄 삽입 위치는 Unity/Server 계약 대조 후 고정한다.

<a id="source-4f3510ed1133dec9-화면과-검수"></a>
#### 화면과 검수

- 전체 내구도 바는 생존, 별도 객차 상태는 장치 가동 상태를 표시한다. 실제 모델에 없는 장식 객차에 가짜 HP를 만들지 않는다.
- 파손 시 해당 객차의 연기·상태 표시와 남은 복구시간, 복구 시 짧은 점등과2초 보호 표시를 사용한다. 숫자·게이지·장치 아이콘·프레임·효과는 독립 조합한다.
- 남은 시간은 음수 없이 올림 표시하여 완료 전0초가 길게 뜨지 않게 한다. 표시시간이 복구 판정을 대신하지 않는다. 요원 카드·궁극기 상태를 객차 파손으로 덮지 않는다.
- 검수: 개별 반복 파손/최종단계 상한, 두 객차의 다른 복구시각, 보호 직전/종료틱, 방어막 중복흡수 없음, 장치1주기대기, 전객차 파손, HP0+OutcomeRunning, 저장실패/복원후중복,50ms/1%/일시정지 시간.
- 밸런스 관찰: 파손 횟수, 장치 비가동 비율, 보호 종료 직후 재파손 비율, 열차 사망 원인별 비중. 실제 플레이 근거 없이 균형이 맞는다고 주장하지 않는다.

남은 승인/계약: 위 복구·보호 수치/상세 동작, 타입별 Producer 프로필, 물리 위험 직접 피해값, 같은 틱 정확한 실행 순서, 저장 버전과 호환 정책. 현재 객차 격리 테스트 통과와 구분한다.

<!-- source-body:source-4f3510ed1133dec9:end -->

## 비전투 최종시안 일치 작업 우선 완료

원출처: `docs/design/NONCOMBAT-FIRST-CLOSURE-20260915.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `89e8b9df5a238c9e92bb0f7976afa79eb590fc2cf4f106ef6d055bad49a334fd`  
검토·적용 경계: Still relevant user execution priority and full visual closure gates; scoped old PASS does not close it.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-비전투-최종시안-일치-작업-우선-완료"></a>
### 비전투 최종시안 일치 작업 우선 완료

사용자 최신 지시: “일단 전투제외 다른 화면 최종시안이랑 맞추고있는거부터 완료후에 전투화면 연결하게 해당부분 체크해봐”.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-우선순위"></a>
#### 우선순위

1. 비전투 화면 승인본과 현재 Unity 구현 대조 및 차이 수정.
2. 독립 리소스·동적 상태·실제 화면 진입/입력 검수와 최신 캡처 정리.
3. 비전투 전체 범위의 완료/잔여 결과 확인 후 전투 화면 및 증강·선로·속도 기능 연결 재개.

진행 중 전투 변경은 보존하고 신규 연결은 보류한다. TitleWear01 등의 기존 결과를 되돌리지 않는다. 새 승인 절차를 추가하는 것이 아니라 사용자 지정 순서를 따른다.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-확인된-현재-상태"></a>
#### 확인된 현재 상태

근거: QA/ResourceComposition-20260914/Unity/NONCOMBAT-CHECKPOINT-20260914.md, 역할별 D 인계 및 실제 작업 기록 조회.

- 10 네트워크 오류,19 튜토리얼,20 지휘관/지원 선택,21 패배/보상 결과,27 룰렛의 요청된 특정 수정은 scoped 검수 종료 기록이 있다.
- Noncombat-Checkpoint02 427/427, FinalTargeted01 28/28은 과거 기능 검증 근거다. 전체 승인 화면의 시각 일치/현재 최신 코드 검증을 대신하지 않는다.
- 해당 checkpoint는 전체 reference composition/material equivalence를 명시적으로 주장하지 않는다. 비전투 전체 완료 상태로 보고할 수 없다.
- 21 과거 run의 웨이브/시간/참여자 정보는 당시 공급 데이터에 없었다. 시안 숫자나 현재 편성으로 대체하지 말고 실제 현재 계약과 상태를 재확인한다.
- Unity/Direction의 최근 작업은 전투 타이틀바였으며 비전투 전체 최신 대조표는 이번 재개 작업의 첫 산출물이다.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-범위와-완료-근거"></a>
#### 범위와 완료 근거

GALLERY-DECISIONS-20260914.md의1~27,25폐기/24대체를 그대로 따른다. 28은 전투 배경이 아닌 중앙 일시정지 팝업 자체만 공통 UI 검수 대상으로 분리한다. 새 전투 화면/증강은 이번 우선 작업 범위 밖이다.

각 행은 번호·화면명·정확 승인 이미지·실제 캡처·소스/상태·차이·수정결과·독립요소 검수·잔여/완료를 포함한다. 이미 통과한 수정은 재사용하되 변경 영향과 현재 캡처로 필요한 범위만 재확인한다. 로딩/빈값/오류/비활성/수령가능 상태는 기능에 해당하는 화면만 검수한다.

리소스가 존재하는 것, 합성 이미지가 비슷한 것, 테스트가 통과하는 것을 실제 최종 조합 일치로 간주하지 않는다. 승인본 식별 불가와 서버 데이터 누락은 별도 잔여로 남긴다. 실제 운영 시작/보상 지급/배포는 수행하지 않는다.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-담당-지시-전송"></a>
#### 담당 지시 전송

- Unity_2: 비전투 전체 대조표 작성→누락 수정→실제 캡처/입력 확인, 전투 신규 연결 보류.
- Direction_2: 승인본 대조와 자산·상태 시각 검수, Unity에 필요한 요소/수정 전달.
- SERVER_2: 전투 신규 연결 보류, 비전투 기존 읽기/결과 상태 계약 확인 지원.

2026-09-15 세 기존 작업에 send_message_to_thread 성공 응답을 확인했다. 지시 전달은 작업 완료 증거가 아니다. 각 담당의 인계와 결과로 후속 완료를 확인한다.

<a id="source-1dfaba3a727da855-인증0506-계약-조사-후속"></a>
#### 인증05/06 계약 조사 후속
Server 근거: QA/ResourceComposition-20260914/Server/AUTH-05-06-CONTRACT-20260915.md. 05는 기존API로 승인4필드배치 복원 가능하며 필수 이메일코드 검증 유지 및 비밀번호 수명 처리가 필요하다. 06은ID+email필수로 email-only는 서버프로토콜 변경이 필요하므로 현재 비전투시각수정에서 임의변경하지 않고 캡처와 예외로 보고한다. 약관보기 미연결도 실제문서 존재여부 확인 대상으로 추가했다. 새법률문서/동의영수증/운영인증요청 생성 지시가 아니다.


<!-- source-body:source-1dfaba3a727da855:end -->

## 피해 대상·객차 파손·복구 상세 기획안

원출처: `docs/design/TRAIN-DAMAGE-CARRIAGE-REPAIR-20260914.md`

New targeting excludesbroken; committedhit broken0. Recovery10/15/20s40%2s proposal. No resurrection.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-피해-대상객차-파손복구-상세-기획안"></a>
### 피해 대상·객차 파손·복구 상세 기획안

사용자 후속 ‘ㄱㄱ’ 승인 반영: 본문 추천 방향으로 격리 검증을 진행한다. 실제 감소량30%내림, 사건별 단일피해경로, 파손장치정지/독립복구/열차수리 분리 기준을 채택한다. 파손객차 물리위험의 직접피해 계수와 복구 운영 수치는 미확정으로 유지하며 명시 테스트 설정만 사용한다.

2026-09-14 사용자 세부 기획 진행 요청. 일반/스토리 전투 기준. 기존 합의는 계승하며 새 타깃·파손 대상·기술 판정 정책은 아래 제안으로 구분한다. 이번 문서가 실제 피해 기능 구현이나 신규 수치 승인인 것은 아니다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-1-이미-합의된-기본-구조"></a>
#### 1. 이미 합의된 기본 구조

근거: CARRIAGE-HP-HISTORY-20260914.md의 원대화 승인 기록, WorkspaceRepo/docs/design/carriage-disable-repair-proposal-20260909.md, combat-stats-v1.md.

- 요원 HP, 각 객차 HP, 열차 전체 내구도를 별도로 관리한다.
- 객차 피해의30%가 열차 전체 내구도로 한 번 전이된다. 최신 상세 문서는 실제 객차HP 감소량의30% 내림을 명시한다.
- 객차HP0은 해당 객차의 장치를 정지한다. 요원은 계속 싸우며 획득 보상/인벤토리가 사라지지 않는다.
- 독립 비상 복구가 존재한다. 이미 발사한 탄과 발동한 효과는 유지하며 복구 때 밀린 동작을 몰아 실행하지 않는다.
- 객차 수리가 열차 전체 피해를 환급하지 않는다. 전체 내구도0은 일반/스토리 패배이며 늦은 수리로 되살리지 않는다.

새 설계에서 이 구조를 바꾸지 않는다. 기관차에 별도HP를 추가하지 않고 기관차 피격은 전체 내구도 경로로 연결하는 것을 추천한다. 월드레이드의 별도 복구/종료 정책에는 자동 적용하지 않는다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-2-타격마다-피해-경로는-하나"></a>
#### 2. 타격마다 피해 경로는 하나

| 사건 | 추천 1차 피해 대상 | 전체 내구도 처리 |
|---|---|---|
| 기관차를 조준한 포탄·외부 공격 | 열차 전체 | 전체 방어 후 직접 차감 |
| 특정 객차를 조준한 포탄·외부 공격 | 조준된 객차 | 객차 실제 손실의30%만 전이 |
| 낙석이 기관차에 최초 접촉 | 열차 전체 | 낙석 피해를 직접 처리 |
| 낙석이 객차에 최초 접촉 | 최초 접촉 객차 하나 | 객차 실제 손실의30%만 전이 |
| 파괴하지 못한 선로 잔해 돌파 | 열차 전체 | 선두 충돌 피해 및 감속1회 |
| 객실 안 적이 요원 공격 | 해당 요원 | 전이 없음 |
| 객실 안 적이 설비 파괴 행동 | 해당 객차 | 그 공격에 설비 타깃 규칙이 있을 때만30%전이 |

객실의 일반 적 공격을 자동으로 요원HP와 객차HP 양쪽에 적용하지 않는다. 설비 공격형 적은 명확한 조준·동작·표식이 있는 별도 행동으로 추가한다. 기존 적 전체에 숨은 객차 피해를 부여하지 않는다.

하나의 사건에 `DirectTrain`과 `CarriageWithTransfer`를 동시에 실행하지 않는다. 같은 포탄의 시각 폭발이 여러 객차에 걸쳐도 첫 버전은 대상 하나다. 다중 객차 광역 피해는 별도 설계 전까지 제외한다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-3-조준접촉-대상-결정"></a>
#### 3. 조준·접촉 대상 결정

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-포탄과-추격자"></a>
##### 포탄과 추격자

표적 획득 시 정상 객차/기관차 중 해당 공격이 허용하는 대상만 고른다. 표적객차에 예고 표식을 표시하고 발사 때 대상ID와 명중 정책을 고정한다. 특정 방어 객차의 도발이나 유도 기능은 별도 승인 없이 추가하지 않는다.

이미 발사한 포탄은 표적 파손 때문에 갑자기 다른 정상 객차로 꺾지 않는다. 기존 명중 정책이 표적 추적이면 해당 객차 위치로, 지점 공격이면 예고한 위치로 진행한다. 회피·적중 보장은 각 기존 공격 계약을 따른다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-낙석"></a>
##### 낙석

시간 교차 판정은 TRAIN-ROCKFALL-TIME-OVERLAP-20260914.md의 새 격리 검증 결과를 참고한다. 전체 편성 점유는 피격 후보이고, 이후 실제 차량별 몸체 구간을 사용해 접촉 대상 하나를 찾는다.

대상은 낙하 활성 중 가장 먼저 실제 몸체가 접촉한 차량이다. 이미 여러 차량이 구역 안에 있는 순간 낙하가 시작되면 전방 차량부터 우선하는 고정 편성 순서를 제안한다. 여러 객차 피해를 합산하지 않는다. 연결부 빈 공간만 겹치면 차체 접촉으로 간주하지 않고 낙하/잔해 상태를 계속 처리한다.

동일 사건의 후속 객차·동일 바위 잔해는 이미 처리된 피해/감속을 반복하지 않는다. 피해가 방어막에 모두 흡수돼도 사건 처리는 완료되며 물리 감속은 지정된 충돌 규칙대로1회다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-선로-잔해"></a>
##### 선로 잔해

선두 접촉을 기준으로 전체 내구도 피해 경로를 사용한다. 차량 수가 많다고 충돌 횟수를 늘리지 않는다. 장애물의 잔여HP·실제 접촉 속도가 피해와 감속을 결정하는 기존 장애물 설계를 따른다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-4-30-전이와-방어-순서"></a>
#### 4. 30% 전이와 방어 순서

추천: 최신 combat-stats-v1의 실제HP 손실 기준을 유지한다. 초기 문서의 방어 후 전체타격/overkill 전이 제안은 이번안에서 채택하지 않는다. 선택한 기준을 구현 계약과 테스트에 한 번만 기록한다.

`객차 손실 C = min(피격 직전 객차HP, 객차 방어 처리 후 유효피해)`
`전이 T = floor(C × 30 / 100)`

1. 해당 타격의 허용 방어막·장갑을 기존 규칙 순서대로 한 번 처리한다.
2. 실제 객차HP를 C만큼 줄인다.
3. T를 열차 전체에 한 번 적용하며 전체 장갑/방어막으로 다시 줄이지 않는다.
4. 전체 내구도0이면 패배를 먼저 확정한다. 생존했으면 객차0 전이에 따른 파손/복구 예약을 처리한다.

직접 열차 타격은 전체 열차의 방어를 한 번 거친다. 공유 열차 방어막이 객차도 보호하는지는 기존 스킬의 대상 범위 계약에 따른다. 이 문서가 전체전용 방어막을 객차전용/요원전용까지 자동 확대하지 않는다.

| 예시: 방어 후 유효피해100 | 객차 손실 | 전체 전이 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 객차HP500 | 100 | 30 |
| 객차HP20 | 20, 파손 | 6 |
| 방어막이 피해 전부 흡수 | 0 | 0 |

예시는 규칙 설명이며 실제 공격력100 설정이 아니다. 현재 내림 규칙을 유지하므로 소수 전이 이월은 추가하지 않는다. 하나의 논리타격을 VFX/프레임 조각으로 분할해 전이량이 바뀌지 않게 한다. 다단히트의 각 타격은 기존 공격 정의를 따른다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-5-이미-파손된-객차와-피해-무효화-방지"></a>
#### 5. 이미 파손된 객차와 피해 무효화 방지

여기에는 선택지가 있다. 초과타격까지 전이하면 파손이 강한 전체 피해를 유발하지만 최신 실제손실 기준과 충돌한다. 파손객차에 무한히 재조준을 허용하면 안전한 방패가 된다. 추천은 실제손실 기준을 유지하면서 새 타깃 획득을 제한하는 방식이다.

- 새 공격은 파손/복구중 객차를 일반HP 타깃으로 선택하지 않는다. 허용된 다른 정상대상이나 명시된 전체열차 공격으로 재획득한다.
- 파손되기 전에 이미 발사된 탄이 그 객차에 도달하면 도착 시 실제HP 손실 기준으로 처리한다. 여전히0이면 손실/전이0, 재파손/복구타이머 초기화 없음. 무한 유도 표적은 아니며 유한한 기존 발사체만 해당한다.
- 전 객차가 파손돼도 전체열차를 공격하는 적 행동과 맵위험은 유지한다. 지원·비상복구도 살아 있어야 한다. 특정 객차 장치 정지를 전체 전투 시스템 정지로 연결하지 않는다.
- 낙석처럼 조준을 피할 수 없는 물리위험이 이미 파손된 객차에 최초 접촉하면, 사건을 처리하지 않다가 사라지는 허점을 막기 위해 `DirectTrain` 구조물 타격으로 처리하는 것을 제안한다. 이 경우 객차30%전이는 없다. 별도 직접타격 계수를 콘텐츠에 명시하고 경고에 반영한다. 계수는 아직 미확정이며 일반 객차 타격 값을 그대로 확정 복사하지 않는다.
- 앞 타격으로 방금 파손된 객차의 같은 낙석 사건은 consumed이므로 위 fallback을 다시 실행하지 않는다. 별개 사건만 대상이 된다.

파손 순간 객차를 분리하거나 레일 밖으로 떨어뜨리지 않는다. 객차 수·열차 길이·장착HP 보너스가 갑자기 줄어 연쇄 패배하지 않게 한다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-6-장치-정지와-복구"></a>
#### 6. 장치 정지와 복구

정상(HP>0) → 파손(HP0) → 비상복구 진행 → 정상. 손상 외형 단계는 표시이며 임의 출력 감소를 추가하지 않는다.

| 종류 | 파손 중 중단 | 유지 |
|---|---|---|
| 전투/포격 객차 | 해당 객차의 다음 자동 발사/시전 | 이미 발사된 탄, 다른 객차 장치 |
| 의료 객차 | 해당 장치의 다음 치료 주기 | 독립 비상복구, 다른 치료원 |
| 방어 객차 | 해당 장치의 다음 방어막 생성 | 이미 생성된 방어막의 기존 수명 |
| 화물 객차 | 해당 장치의 다음 지원 효과 발동 | 소유 아이템·획득 보상·편성 길이 |

실제 타입→장치ID 매핑이 기준이다. 이름만 보고 모든 공격력/방어력 버프를 삭제하지 않는다. 정지 장치가 소유하지 않은 지휘관 지원 쿨다운까지 멈추지 않는다.

복구 시간은 권위 시뮬레이션 시간으로 진행하며 일시정지에는 정지한다. 증강 선택 중에는 기존1% 시간 정책을 따르고 현실 시간으로 완전 복구하지 않는다. 웨이브/재접속으로 복구 카운터나 파손 횟수를 초기화하지 않는다.

기존 combat-stats-v1의 일반/스토리 후보 수치(객차10/15/20초,40%HP,보호2초)는 비교용 시작안으로 보존한다. 이 값의 운영 승인/현재 적용은 별도 확인하며 새로 확정했다고 주장하지 않는다. 4번째 이후 반복파손은 마지막 단계시간 유지 제안이며 무한 시간 증가를 넣지 않는다.

복구 완료 때 해당 장치는 다음 정상 주기를 시작한다. 즉시 무료 발사/치료 또는 밀린 동작 일괄 실행은 없다. 이미 지정된 보호기간이 있으면 보호 표식을 표시하며 피해/타깃 가능 규칙을 명시해야 한다. 보호가 물리충돌 감속까지 면제하는 것은 아니다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-7-수리-조작과-화면"></a>
#### 7. 수리 조작과 화면

- 기존 우측 긴급수리의 기본 대상은 전체열차HP로 유지한다. 객차 자동복구가 별도로 작동하므로 버튼 하나가 둘을 모두 치유하지 않는다.
- 객차 게이지 터치는 객차 이름/HP/멈춘장치/남은복구시간 정보를 표시하는 용도로 제안한다. 추가 상시 수리 버튼이나 새 재화소비를 만들지 않는다.
- 긴급수리로 객차 복구를 앞당기는 기능은 별도 스킬 정의가 승인된 경우에만 추가한다. 이 기획에서 숨은 이중효과로 넣지 않는다.
- 전체 바는 생존, 객차 바는 기능 가동 상태를 보여준다. 피해 차량의 짧은 강조/연기와 전체전이를 각각 표시하되 큰 피해숫자 두 개로 서로 다른 공격처럼 보이게 하지 않는다.
- 객차 파손은 `복구 중`과 남은 시간, 정지장치 기호를 표시한다. 요원 초상화/HP/궁극기는 파손 표시로 덮지 않는다.
- 프레임/게이지/채움/문구/복구시간/장치아이콘/연기/피격광은 기존 독립 리소스 정책을 따른다. 3차 전체 UI 배치를 유지한다.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-8-사건저장검증-경계"></a>
#### 8. 사건·저장·검증 경계

논리사건에는 사건ID,공격/위험ID,선택 피해경로,대상차량ID,방어전피해,방어후피해,실제HP손실,전이량,파손전이,소비기록을 남긴다. 동일사건 적용/기록을 하나의 권위 모델 변경으로 묶고 재전송/복원에서 중복 적용하지 않는다. 표시 콜백이 피해/복구를 실행하지 않는다.

동일틱 여러사건은 권위 발생순서 및 고정ID 순서로 처리한다. 뒤 사건은 앞 사건의 파손 결과를 읽는다. 충돌·탄착·복구완료의 상호 우선순위는 실제 기존 틱 파이프라인과 대조 후 별도 명시하며 이 문서가 임의로 기존순서를 덮어쓰지 않는다. 최소한 패배가 확정된 후 수리로 회생시키지 않는다.

필수 검증: 객차100손실→전체30,20남은객차100피해→전이6,완전방어0,이미파손발사체0,새공격파손타깃제외,파손물리위험별도직접경로,낙석다객차단일사건,막차경계,전객차파손비상복구,장치정지/기발사유지,복구주기몰아실행없음,수리중복없음,패배와수리경합,사건소비복원 및 재접속동일결과.

<a id="source-d25448b3ff1afe52-9-현재-구현과-차이"></a>
#### 9. 현재 구현과 차이

현재 ProducerCombatAdapter의 carriageDamageEvents는 UNSUPPORTED다. CarriageDurabilityCatalog와 TrainDamageCalculator 정의가 있다는 사실만으로 이 흐름이 동작한다고 볼 수 없다. 현재 calculator는 float30%이며 내림/실제손실을 호출자가 보장하는지도 확인 필요하다. 따라서 다음은 새 통합 항목이다.

1. 위 새 타깃/파손위험/수리범위를 검토해 기준을 확정.
2. 실제 차량점유·사건피해 경로·방어/반올림 계약을 Unity/Server 공동 명세화.
3. 순수 모델 검증 후 별도 Unity QA에 객차HP/파손/복구 연결.
4. 통과 후 기존 전투 파이프라인과 HUD 연결. 운영 수치와 월드레이드 적용은 별도 승인된 자료로 진행.

<!-- source-body:source-d25448b3ff1afe52:end -->


<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95"></a>
## Durable Run Operations

원출처: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-durable-run-operations.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `e85c982f3b5c27a95af31c7fed9fc82a6d2cf2b474b6ebb082af5cc87c5d1907`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Immutable START/FINISH bytes/key/build/time; first-dispatch capture, encrypted save-before-POST and confirmed-save-before-publish; account/capacity/corruption and durable handoff fences.

<!-- source-body:source-e894b886198cfc95:start -->
<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95-durable-run-operations"></a>
### Durable Run Operations

<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95-approved-scope"></a>
#### Approved Scope

Preserve existing start/finish logical bodies, keys, composed build and timestamp
across restart. Do not rebuild a finish body from runtime state on retry. Preserve
existing dirty work and receipt/update completion. No new combat/formation UX.

Server confirmed: snapshots are captured at first accepted dispatch, not composition.
An accepted B request replayed from C returns B; a request composed but never sent
on B is first accepted under C. Current installed admission headers must remain C.
There is no original-build request field and no old-admission spoofing contract.

<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95-design"></a>
#### Design

- Separate encrypted run file/domain. Receipt metadata-only schema stays unchanged.
- Immutable PendingRunOperation stores kind/account/target/key/exact BodyJson,
  composed build/time and optionally the first durable accepted response JSON.
- No tokens, Authorization headers or arbitrary endpoint URLs are persisted.
- Journal saves before POST and atomically saves confirmed response before the
  client reports durable completion. Confirmed records are not pending POSTs.
- Reads fail explicitly for corruption/key loss. Foreign records never dispatch.
- Same logical identity cannot change body/build; new instances retry stored bytes.
- Bounded journal rejects new work at capacity, preserving every existing record.
- Explicit handoff invokes a caller-provided durable sink before removing a
  confirmed journal record. Failed handoff/delete retains the original receipt.
- Production auth runtime owns the run client, restores current-account metadata
  after readiness and exposes existing typed start/finish request entry points.
  Restoration does not automatically POST. Retry is an explicit operation.
- Existing facade accepts a frozen finish request overload, so callers can retain
  an already-created request rather than recapturing completion time.

<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95-work"></a>
#### Work

1. Parent: immutable operation, encrypted journal/domain, strict persistence RED/GREEN.
2. Client owner: account/generation fenced durable client, explicit retry/handoff,
   storage failure and restart RED/GREEN.
3. Integration owner: installed display-version header coverage, actual local
   start/finish accepted-loss/replay and Admin stored snapshot evidence.
4. Parent: auth runtime composition and focused/full regression. Use one runner,
   frozen C# writers and existing wrapper. Device evidence remains separate.

<a id="source-e894b886198cfc95-shared-api"></a>
#### Shared API

Namespace LastRail.Run:

```csharp
enum PendingRunKind { Start, Finish }
sealed class PendingRunOperation {
  // get-only Kind, AccountId, TargetId, IdempotencyKey, BodyJson, Build,
  // ComposedAt, AcceptedResponseJson; EndpointPath derived from validated kind/id.
  static PendingRunOperation Start(string account, RunStartRequest request, AppBuildSnapshot build, DateTimeOffset composedAt);
  static PendingRunOperation Finish(string account, RunResultSubmitRequest request, AppBuildSnapshot build, DateTimeOffset composedAt);
  PendingRunOperation Confirmed(string acceptedResponseJson);
}
interface IRunOperationJournal {
  Task<IReadOnlyList<PendingRunOperation>> ReadAsync(string account);
  Task<bool> PutAsync(PendingRunOperation operation);
  Task<bool> ConfirmAsync(PendingRunOperation operation, string responseJson);
  Task<bool> RemoveConfirmedAsync(string account, PendingRunKind kind, string key);
}
```

Only the parent owns these shared declarations and storage implementation.

<!-- source-body:source-e894b886198cfc95:end -->


<a id="source-491cfbace9035662"></a>
## Receipt Restart Recovery Implementation Plan

원출처: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-receipt-restart-recovery.md`  
원문 SHA-256: `0572ba0c90bef14441a7176a86306983f6873578a50af7cf4ad00ee68b46bc0f`  
검토·적용 경계: Retain active pending actual consolidation or explicit current-vs-candidate review: Exact metadata journal PutAsync/ReadAsync/RemoveAsync, encrypted separate Keystore storage, restore GET-only, 404 retention, account fencing and 64-entry capacity behavior.

<!-- source-body:source-491cfbace9035662:start -->
<a id="source-491cfbace9035662-receipt-restart-recovery-implementation-plan"></a>
### Receipt Restart Recovery Implementation Plan

> For agentic workers: use disjoint ownership, test-first checkpoints and one
> parent-owned Unity runner. Preserve the dirty worktree; do not commit unrelated work.

**Goal:** Recover uncertain support/error receipts after restart without storing
sensitive bodies or reattributing old-process errors.

**Architecture:** A shared encrypted metadata journal records original account,
idempotency key, category, build and timestamps before POST. Android Keystore
encrypts a separate atomic receipt file, never the auth payload slot. Restored
support entries are receipt-only; restored error entries can only issue GET receipt.

**Tech Stack:** Existing Keystore port, Newtonsoft JSON, Unity main-thread async
clients, NUnit, actual isolated Hono/sql.js HTTP harness.

**Spec:** Plan delegation, `server/docs/api/support.md`,
`server/docs/api/ops-error-logs.md`, and the slice-1 verification report.

<a id="source-491cfbace9035662-invariants"></a>
#### Invariants

- No draft/body, log text/stack, token or event HTTP body is persisted in this journal.
- Persist immutable metadata before the first network dispatch; save failures block POST.
- Preserve same account/key/metadata across retries; changed metadata for a key is rejected.
- Same-account refresh can use a new Bearer; another account cannot query the entry.
- Restored support has no body and cannot POST, edit into a new key or claim rejection.
- Old-process error data is never reloaded into the current-session POST queue.
- FOUND permits metadata deletion; failed/404 lookup remains held, not a new submission.
- No invented server TTL or purge guarantee. Bounded capacity fails closed.
- Native encryption availability is required in the default device composition;
  injected test stores are explicitly non-device evidence, not a production fallback.

<a id="source-491cfbace9035662-shared-api"></a>
#### Shared API

Namespace `LastRail.Submissions`:

```csharp
public enum PendingReceiptKind { Support, ClientError }
public sealed class PendingReceipt {
  public PendingReceipt(PendingReceiptKind kind, string accountId, string idempotencyKey,
    string category, AppBuildSnapshot build, DateTimeOffset composedAt, DateTimeOffset submittedAt);
  // get-only Kind, AccountId, IdempotencyKey, Category, Build, ComposedAt, SubmittedAt
}
public interface IPendingReceiptJournal {
  Task<bool> PutAsync(PendingReceipt record);
  Task<IReadOnlyList<PendingReceipt>> ReadAsync(string accountId);
  Task<bool> RemoveAsync(string accountId, PendingReceiptKind kind, string key);
}
```

Reads fail explicitly on unavailable/corrupt storage, never silently appear empty.
Total journal capacity is 64. An unresolved receipt cannot block the whole account:
the UI must retain/hold it while allowing an explicitly new independent inquiry
with an empty body, never an automatic resubmission of the previous inquiry.
At capacity, new dispatch fails closed and an explicit metadata-only deletion path
must not represent deletion as server rejection or cancellation. Until that UI and
policy are verified, restart recovery remains an incomplete release gate.

<a id="source-491cfbace9035662-tasks"></a>
#### Tasks

- [ ] Parent: reflection RED tests for strict metadata validation, roundtrip through
  new journal instance, corruption/unavailability, changed-key metadata, bounded
  capacity, account filtering and no body/token persistence. Implement
  PendingReceipt/EncryptedPendingReceiptJournal and separate encrypted file port.
- [ ] Support owner: RED tests, then receipt-tracking client wrapper and restoration
  into the existing controller. Keep original in-memory body only within process;
  restored metadata registers a GET-only lookup and disables submit/edit.
- [ ] Error owner: RED tests, then journal-before-send integration and explicit
  same-account receipt recovery. Do not load old metadata into event POST requests.
- [ ] Parent: default native composition, runtime support-open restoration and
  error receipt lookup with owner/lifecycle fences. Keep injected constructors
  backwards compatible and label their evidence accurately.
- [ ] Serial unit/integration runs, actual HTTP receipt recovery through new
  client/journal instances, full regression and independent review.
- [ ] Report UI/HTTP/DB/new-instance recovery/native-device O/X separately.

<a id="source-491cfbace9035662-out-of-scope"></a>
#### Out of Scope

Run pending snapshots and content-state baselines follow this slice. No real email,
remote deployment, account merging, old-process event reingestion or video capture.

<!-- source-body:source-491cfbace9035662:end -->
